programme.title: Ride, Vaquero
programme.desc: After the Civil War, King Cameron (Howard Keel) moves to Texas, purchases a cattle ranch and settles down with his wife, Cordelia (Ava Gardner). They find themselves at the mercy of Jose Esqueda (Anthony Quinn), a local bandit who has terrorized the town with his adoptive brother, Rio (Robert Taylor). Rio is kidnapped when he tries to mount an attack on the ranch and agrees to work for Cameron so he can be close to Cordelia. Though he's incensed at Rio's betrayal, Jose vows to get him back.

programme.title: Rough Night in Jericho
programme.desc: The only business in the Wild West town of Jericho that corrupt sheriff Alex Flood (Dean Martin) doesn't control behind the scenes is the stagecoach owned by tough-willed widow Molly Lang (Jean Simmons) and her right-hand man, Hickman (John McIntire). Former marshal Dolan (George Peppard), recently hired by Lang and Hickman as a driver, wants to stay out of the mess, but when he sees Flood's henchman Yarbrough (Slim Pickens) assault Lang, he steps up to fight the corruption.

programme.title: The Last Trophy
programme.desc: Two British socialites find that they still have a lot to learn when they visit their friends, the Cartwrights.

programme.title: San Francisco

programme.title: The Return Of An Outlaw
programme.desc: After receiving a gunshot wound while running from Hollister's posse, a bank robber seeks medical attention and shelter.

programme.title: Mail-Order Groom
programme.desc: Brothers threaten a spinster's fiancé.

programme.title: A Case of Identity
programme.desc: Two tough private detectives appear in North Fork looking for a boy.

programme.title: The Visitor
programme.desc: Unhappy heirs threaten a young widow.

programme.title: The Hero
programme.desc: A boy is accused of shooting an outlaw.

programme.title: Farmer With a Badge
programme.desc: A farmer-turned-marshal rescues Bat after bandits leave him for dead; Bat helps the lawman find confidence in his new position as peacekeeper.

programme.title: The Fatal Garment
programme.desc: Wyatt Earp hires Bat as a bodyguard at his casino in El Paso; robbers distract Bat with an expensive shirt as they make off with $13,000 of Earp's money.

programme.title: A Bullet For Bridget
programme.desc: Madame Francine's cousin gets kidnapped.

programme.title: The Belle from Boston
programme.desc: The New Orleans underworld conspires to rub out administrator Colton.

programme.title: John Wesley Hardin
programme.desc: Two Osage Indians are murdered.

programme.title: The Corner
programme.desc: Josh is accused of killing one of his best friends for a bounty reward.

programme.title: Eager Man
programme.desc: Josh befriends a fugitive who agrees to give himself up on one condition.

programme.title: Crossfire Trail
programme.desc: Rafe Covington (Tom Selleck), a hardened drifter, makes a promise to a dying friend to care for his Wyoming ranch and his wife, Anne (Virginia Madsen). Covington travels to Wyoming with his friends, Rock Mullaney (David O'Hara) and J.T. Langston (Christian Kane), where he tells Anne of her husband's death. They begin rehabilitating the ranch, but after a fatal gunfight, Covington and his men are given an ultimatum: leave town in three days or suffer the consequences.

programme.title: Conagher
programme.desc: Pioneer woman Evie Teale is headed west with her family to start a new life, only to have her husband, Jacob, tragically die during the journey. Left to fend for herself and her two children in the middle of nowhere, Evie strikes up a friendship with cowboy Conn Conagher, who passes by while she's working as a food server. And Conagher certainly can help, as the area is under constant threat of attack, be it from Apaches or local bandits.

programme.title: The Thicket
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter and a band of unlikely heroes pursue a brutal killer, they find themselves in a deadly no-man's-land known as the Thicket.

programme.desc: A sheriff retires to pursue a desperado.

programme.desc: Killer escapes hanging.

programme.title: Backtrail
programme.desc: An anthology series based on the novels of Zane Grey.

programme.title: Dangerous Orders
programme.desc: A Southerner serving in the Union army has his loyalty questioned.

programme.title: Necessary Breed
programme.desc: A man is the victim of his own greed when he becomes a bounty hunter.

programme.title: Hop-Along Cassidy
programme.desc: An evil ranch foreman tries to provoke a range war by playing two cattlemen against each other while helping a gang to rustle the cattle; each cattleman ends up blaming the other for missing cattle.

programme.title: The Eagle's Brood
programme.desc: When the outlaw El Toro saves Hoppy's life, Hoppy agrees to find his missing grandson.

programme.title: Shanghai Queen
programme.desc: Matt almost lands at the bottom of the bay while trying to catch a gang of shanghaiing sailors.

programme.title: Bridal Bouquet
programme.desc: Dolph Parker gets more than he bargained for when he imports a bride from the East.

programme.title: Carson City
programme.desc: After one too many successful stick-ups of the Carson City stagecoach by the Champagne Bandits, the local banker decides to build a railroad track through town. To do so, he'll need to employ the help of "Silent" Jeff Kincaid (Randolph Scott), the only man who can tunnel through the mountainous region. Unfortunately, Kincaid has more than just the mountains to deal with -- neither the locals nor the Champagne Bandits are happy about the new railway.

programme.title: Buchanan Rides Alone
programme.desc: Journeying from Mexico back home to West Texas, mercenary Tom Buchanan takes a break for the night in the border town of Agry. He soon discovers that almost every resident -- from the crooked sheriff to the shifty-eyed innkeeper -- is a member of the prominent Agry family. When Buchanan defends Juan de la Vega, a young man about to be lynched for shooting the town drunk, he himself is accused of murder and must struggle to escape town alive.

programme.title: Fort Worth
programme.desc: Reformed gunman Ned Britt (Randolph Scott) travels to Fort Worth, Texas, to take over the abandoned newspaper. Crooked trail boss Gabe Clevenger (Ray Teal), a former antagonist of Ned's, challenges him on the trail. Ned refuses to fight, which disappoints fellow passenger Flora Talbot (Phyllis Thaxter), who had taken a liking to him but now sees him as weak. In Fort Worth, Ned discovers Clevenger is battling the burgeoning railroad and decides to fight back using the power of the press.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Jim Kipp (Randolph Scott) is a bounty hunter hired to find three robbers who committed a daring heist three years ago. When he arrives in a small town near the robbery, he senses that the thieves may be living there. However, many of the townspeople -- including Dr. Spencer (Harry Antrim), his daughter, Julie (Dolores Dorn), and barmaid Alice (Marie Windsor) -- are put on edge by Kipp's presence and want him gone. Kipp perseveres, hatching a plan that he thinks will draw out the bandits.

programme.title: Apache Rifles
programme.desc: A U.S. Cavalry officer (Audie Murphy) falls in love with a part-Indian missionary (Linda Lawson) in Arizona.

programme.title: The Tall Stranger
programme.desc: Union vet Ned (Joel McCrea), gunned down by some tough cattle rustlers, comes to in a wagon train under the care of kindly widow Ellen (Virginia Mayo). But, as he heals, he senses all is not well, and realizes that the suspicious men leading the train are taking the settlers to land owned by his estranged half-brother, an embittered man who will shoot any strangers. Ned then tries to warn the pioneers, while preparing to face the sibling who harbors a deep-seated grudge against him.

programme.title: Stranger on Horseback
programme.desc: A circuit judge (Joel McCrea) rides in to break a ruthless cattle baron's stranglehold on a frontier town.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: The story of the notorious outlaw William "Billy the Kid" Bonney. Billy joins a group of outlaws in a South West town when he meets old friend Jim Sherwood, now the town's marshal. He tries to change his ways but when a friend is murdered he falls back into the life of a bandit.

programme.title: Village of Fear
programme.desc: A peddler outwits a gang of killers.

programme.title: Black Creek Encounter
programme.desc: A gunman lays down his arms.

programme.desc: A bitter young man takes up cattle rustling to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: Fugitive
programme.desc: Fate isolates a man.

programme.desc: Saloon girls help would-be murderer.

programme.desc: A Civil War veteran searches for the man who killed his wife.

programme.title: Badge of Honor
programme.desc: A disillusioned Confederate veteran encounters a power-mad colonel.

programme.title: Decision at Wilson's Creek
programme.desc: A Civil War officer faces disdain.

programme.title: Westbound
programme.desc: A former Union officer, John Hayes (Randolph Scott) now manages a stagecoach company. However, Clay Putnam (Andrew Duggan), a businessman still loyal to the South, is intent on robbing the coaches operated by Hayes, which transport gold to the North from California. Hoping to heist the treasure as a way to revive the Confederacy, Putnam also has a grudge against Hayes, since his wife, Norma (Virginia Mayo), was once involved with the handsome Union soldier.

programme.title: Major Dundee
programme.desc: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

programme.title: The Mountain Men
programme.desc: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

programme.title: The Violent Men
programme.desc: Former Union soldier John Parrish (Glenn Ford) wants to sell his ranch and start a new life by settling down out east. However, the ruthless tactics of Lew Wilkison (Edward G. Robinson), the scheming businessman interested in his property, make Parrish reconsider the move, especially after one of his ranch hands is murdered. Adding to the increasingly tense conflict is Wilkison's wife, Martha (Barbara Stanwyck), who is cheating on her husband with his brother, Cole (Brian Keith).

programme.title: The Tin Star
programme.desc: Morgan Hickman is a tough gunslinger with a knack for keeping his cool in tense situations. When he wanders into a town where the local lawman has been killed, he finds callow but eager Ben Owens temporarily acting as sheriff. Soon Ben, who wants to keep his new position, is looking to Morgan for guidance. Though the bounty hunter has his own issues with law enforcement, he admires Ben's enthusiasm and decides to train him to be an effective sheriff.

programme.title: Joe Kidd
programme.desc: In New Mexico, one-time bounty hunter Joe Kidd owns a ranch where a nearby group of Mexican revolutionaries, led by Luis Chama, fights for their rightful land after the U.S. government denies their claims. In response, a greedy landowner gathers a posse to capture Chama and solicits Kidd's assistance. Kidd, who has no interest in the matter, changes his mind when he discovers Chama has stolen a horse and roughed up a worker from his ranch.

programme.title: Cooper
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a terrier mix that might be the perfect companion for a retired woman and her handicapped daughter. But transforming this untrained street dog into a well-mannered family member will require a lot of work.

programme.title: Milo
programme.desc: Brandon turns to hand signals to train a deaf dog for a busy hotel executive. But, before he'll "sign-off" on the adoption, he must be completely confident that Milos manners and temperament will result in more than just an overnight stay.

programme.title: Henry
programme.desc: Scarred by a previous dog attack, a married couple closes the door on future pet adoptions. But, if Brandon can teach a 2-year-old mini-poodle mix, named Henry, how to ring the bell to their hearts, they could open up their home to a new furry friend.

programme.title: Barnaby
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a tiny terrier named Barnaby.

programme.title: Chance
programme.desc: From red collar to white collar. Marketing Executive Christina wants to adopt a puppy she can take to her office. But if Chance, the Pointer Mix, wants to join the work force, he'll need to learn "get to work" on potty training.

programme.title: Life Changers
programme.desc: We revisit five of Lucky Dogs most lifesaving and life-changing adoptions, including a hearing-impaired Poodle mix that learns sign language and a Labrador that answers the call of duty for a diabetic veteran.

programme.title: Lolita
programme.desc: A single dad and his three young boys adopt Lolita, a smart, sweet Chihuahua, who helps bring new life to the household. When Brandon learns Lolitas bad habit of dashing out the front door, he teaches her about boundaries.

programme.title: Sparky
programme.desc: After a spaniel mix that has been living on the streets is found, it must be tested to see if it can get along with other animals before being adopted.

programme.title: Out of the Box
programme.desc: Some of Brandons most creative and surprising training moments are featured.

programme.title: Best of: Overcoming Obstacles
programme.desc: Age. Experience. Physical limitation. Every dog faces its own unique hurdles in training. But with Brandons guidance, they're all capable of achieving new heights.

programme.title: Best of: Home Improvement
programme.desc: Even during some major construction at the Lucky Dog Ranch, Charlotte, Spirit, and three other dogs undergo life-changing renovations of their own.

programme.title: Two's Company
programme.desc: Discover how some of Brandons rescued pups find additional purpose and extra challenges when they are paired with other dogs.

programme.title: Cosmo
programme.desc: While a new family transforms their home to welcome a Yorkie mix, Brandon discovers a dark truth about the dogs past that changes the course of its training.

programme.title: A Special Purpose
programme.desc: Brandon rescues five dogs and trains them to aid and comfort adopters who have themselves been through their own harrowing journeys.

programme.title: Hazel
programme.desc: Step up! A couple reaches out to Brandon in hopes of finding the perfect companion for their current dog. But before Hazel, a friendly terrier mix, can step into her new role, she'll need to conquer her own fear of stairs.

programme.title: Ollie
programme.desc: A middle-aged underdog gets a second chance with an empty-nester looking to spread her own wings. But will a history of neglect keep Ollie from embracing his adventurous new life?

programme.title: Hershey
programme.desc: A dachshund mix is rescued and adopted by a family, but they worry that the small dog will have difficulty climbing the stairs in their two-story home.

programme.title: Evan
programme.desc: A family consider adopting a 4-year-old black Labrador mix.

programme.title: Daisy
programme.desc: A family hope to adopt Daisy, a terrier-poodle mix. The mom hopes that the dog will teach her daughter the responsibilities of having a pet. However, Daisy has a barking problem that Brandon must resolve to get her ready for her new home.

programme.title: Motu
programme.desc: A cancer survivor with a passion for the ocean finds a kindred spirit in Motu, a spunky Maltese mix facing his own physical challenge. But before Motu can sail off into the sunset with Julie, he'll need to hone his kayaking skills with Brandon.

programme.title: Junior
programme.desc: Dance Fever! After the sudden passing of his former companion, a retired vet hopes a six-month old Chihuahua mix will mend his broken heart. But when Juniors lack of motivation proves problematic, Brandon relies on his "bag of tricks" for inspiration.

programme.title: Stark
programme.desc: Hoping to incorporate a new dog into their upcoming nuptials, Niki and Vien set their sights on a one-year-old Lhasa Apso mix named Stark. But before Stark can say "I do" to his new life, he'll need to stop objecting to his training.

programme.title: For Every Problem, Theres a Solution
programme.desc: Brandon works with a skittish dog that is frightened of its own shadow and with a cantankerous canine that barks incessantly

programme.title: Grover
programme.desc: Diamond in the Ruff! Grover, the two-year-old Poodle mix, might just be the perfect gem for an antique jewelry dealer looking for a new companion. But his deep-seated abandonment issues threaten to smudge his chance at a forever home.

programme.title: Bobo
programme.desc: Bobo, a spaniel mix, must have cataract surgery before he can be trained to be a companion dog for Vivian and her special-needs son Frankie.

programme.title: Best of : Pairing Up
programme.desc: Dogs are social animals that crave connection. But while some bonds come quickly, others take a little effort. So embrace the pack mentality, because today we're "pairing up".

programme.title: Magnolia
programme.desc: To prepare a Newfoundland mix for a schoolteacher hoping to bring her new dog to school with her, Brandon will have to make sure the dog has the control to be around children and distractions.

programme.title: Wednesday
programme.desc: Before a young Doberman Pinscher can become the best friend of a little boy with Autism, Brandon must make sure that the dog has the right temperament and training to help bring the boy out of his shell and assist him through life.

programme.title: Best of: Transformations
programme.desc: From makeovers to mindsets -every Lucky Dog goes through its own unique metamorphosis. Today we look back at some of this seasons most dramatic, and heartwarming, "transformations."

programme.title: Maggie
programme.desc: A spaniel mix named Maggie could be the perfect companion for a couple that recently lost their beloved golden retriever. But when Maggies crippling fear of abandonment fails to respond to training, Brandon must turn to an outside source for help.

programme.title: Dodger
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a calm schnauzer mix in hopes of placing him in a home with two autistic boys. But before Dodger gets called up to his new family, this underdog will need to prove that hes a team player.

programme.title: Ginger
programme.desc: A young Terrier mix might be the best friend a nine-year-old boy has been hoping for. But Brandon is in for a lot of work if hes going to transform this untrained dog into a well-mannered family member thats good with power tools, hover-boards, and cats.

programme.title: Flash
programme.desc: A 6-month-old Chihuahua is rescued and taught the art of running alongside a bike.

programme.title: Riley
programme.desc: Brandon transforms an "untrainable" two-year-old spaniel mix into one of the most talented agility dogs in Lucky Dog history. But will Rileys high-octane energy level prove too much for his potential mom, who suffers from chronic fatigue syndrome.

programme.title: Jemma
programme.desc: An outgoing German Shepherd/Lab mix named Jemma could be the perfect canine ambassador for one womans bed and breakfast. But before this seven-month-old puppy can assume her new role, she'll need to check her immaturity at the door.

programme.title: Sadie
programme.desc: Brandon faces one of his biggest challenges yet. He must find the perfect shelter dog to assist a woman with very special needs. And he'll have to devise a new form of training in order to make the match successful.

programme.title: Max
programme.desc: A previously bitten Miniature Poodle shows signs of aggression towards large dogs. Before hes ready to be adopted, Brandon has to help him move past his fear and aggression.

programme.title: Polly
programme.desc: Polly, a timid German Shepherd mix, gets Brandons help to be adopted by a couple with seven- and nine-year-old daughters.

programme.title: Mitzi
programme.desc: A rescued Maltipoo puppy could be the perfect dog to help children during therapy. But, before she can take on this new role, she'll need to leave behind a bad jumping habit and arm herself with a new bag of tricks

programme.title: Murphy
programme.desc: All work and no play! When a mischievous ten-month-old lab mix proves difficult to train, Brandon turns to toys to get results.

programme.title: Bean
programme.desc: When a Spaniel mix poses a unique opportunity for a high school student to develop her talents, Brandon realizes that won't happen if he can't get the dog under control.

programme.title: Best of:New Skills
programme.desc: For five lucky shelter dogs, a forever home is right around the corner. But before they can step into their new lives, they'll all need to embrace "new skills".

programme.title: Leah
programme.desc: Teachers Pet. A special education teacher hopes to adopt a Golden Corgi mix for his family. But before Leah can go to her new home, she'll need to excel in and out of the classroom.

programme.title: Best of: Where Are They Now
programme.desc: When Brandon and his Lucky Dog team join a local parade to raise awareness for animal rescue, some of his former students show up to support the cause.

programme.title: Zeus
programme.desc: After surviving what could have only been canine distemper, a four-year Spaniel mix gets a second chance at Lucky Dog Ranch. But will the physical and neurological effects of the disease affect Zeus' ability to learn the common commands and find a forever home?

programme.title: Lola
programme.desc: When conventional training methods fail to pull a timid Welsh terrier mix named Lola out of her shell, Brandon recruits another "Lucky Dog in Training" to build Lolas confidence.

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: Brandon teaches balance and water safety to Evie, a Chihuahua mix, so she can fit right in with a water-loving family.

programme.title: Dakota
programme.desc: Before a rescued Malamute mix can provide comfort to a teenager with anxiety, Brandon must first help the dog overcome his own emotional issues.

programme.title: Best of: Friendships
programme.desc: They're called "Mans Best Friend", but for these five dogs, companionship defies age, size, gender and even species. Today we look back at some of this years most heartwarming, and surprising, "friendships".

programme.title: Spirit
programme.desc: A street smart stray could strike the right chord with a rock n' roll family. But even if Brandon takes Spirit off the street, can he take the street out of Spirit?

programme.title: Coco
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a border collie mix that is fearful of everyone.

programme.title: Nikki
programme.desc: Brandon tries to earn the trust of a Wheaten Terrier mix who shows difficulty adjusting to life outside of a cage in order to prepare it for a life in the busy tourist town of Solvang, Cal.

programme.title: Skye
programme.desc: A game of trust. With Brandons help, a skittish White Shepherd mix learns to embrace the world around her. But before Skye settles into her forever home, she'll need to forge an unlikely friendship with her new owners horse.

programme.title: Jingles
programme.desc: A pointer mix suffering from a bad case of kennel stress learns to shed anxiety and become an off-leash pet for an outdoor-loving family. Meanwhile, the familys daughter tries to overcome her personal fear of dogs.

programme.title: Maverick
programme.desc: A devoted mother reaches out to Brandon in hopes of finding a support animal for her autistic son. But before one-year- old Maverick can officially become Dustins wingman, he'll need to prove he has the temperament and social skills needed for his new role

programme.title: On the Mend
programme.desc: Brandon rescues five dogs who all face lengthy recoveries from various afflictions. But with patience and love, they are soon trained and united with their new forever families.

programme.title: Estella
programme.desc: Brandon trains 5-year-old mystery mutt Estella to join a family with two 7-year-old boys, Max and Finn, and one dog, Pluto (see episode 2.5), a Tibetan terrier.

programme.title: Arts & Entertainment
programme.desc: Becoming a photographic model requires special training for a spaniel mix named Bean. The same is true for preparing Buddy, Lolly, Sheela and Dakota for their new lives in the world of arts and entertainment.

programme.title: Best of: Special Connections
programme.desc: Being pack animals, dogs possess an instinctual need to bond...but some bonds run deeper than others. To honor "mans best friend", we look back at some of this seasons most heartwarming and inspirational connections.

programme.title: Roxy
programme.desc: A family selects a rescue dog that Brandon trains.

programme.title: A Family Affair!
programme.desc: Brandon revisits some of his best family-inspired training moments.

programme.title: Sandy
programme.desc: A golden retriever answers the call of duty for a wounded warrior whos in need. But to earn his service dog badge, Sandy must successfully complete Brandons boot camp.

programme.title: Brando
programme.desc: Brando, the nine-month-old Rottweiler mix, gets a job offer he can't refuse. But preparing this eighty-pound puppy for office life could spell disaster.

programme.title: Lucky

programme.desc: The scout elves have some trouble tuning up Santa's sleigh, so Duff Goldman asks the teams to create a sleigh design that will wow Mr. Claus; two teams build inventive snow forts for a snowball fight between judges Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt.

programme.title: It's Not Goodbye Forever
programme.desc: The scout elves fly over their favorite places as they return to the North Pole, so Duff Goldman challenges the finalists to elf-ify a famous landmark; Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt award their Ambassadors of Confectionery Concoctions with $25,000.

programme.title: Holiday: Cartoon Christmas
programme.desc: Buddy and Duff face off with Christmas cakes inspired by Charlie Brown.

programme.title: Holiday: Santa's Workshop
programme.desc: Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman go head-to-head with cakes portraying Santa's workshop; Team Buddy creates a nighttime scene with a napping Santa surrounded by toys and elves; Team Duff builds a realistic tree that morphs into a finished toy train.

programme.title: Holiday: The Nutcracker
programme.desc: Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman create cakes capturing scenes from the classic Christmas ballet, "The Nutcracker"; both teams feature the Rat King in their creations.

programme.title: Holiday: Winter Wonderland
programme.desc: For their final battle, Buddy and Duff create their own winter wonderlands; the teams construct arctic creatures and their habitats to decide the contest winner.

programme.title: When the Elves Call in Sick
programme.desc: Three teams of confectionery artists face off to see who can make a holiday display that shows who steps in to save the day after Santa's elves call in sick on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: Stealing the Naughty List
programme.desc: Jonathan Bennett asks the five teams to create a jolly depiction of a heist involving the world's naughtiest kids stealing Santa's famous Naughty List.

programme.title: Elf Auditions
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of cake masters and sugar artists create their most festive vision of how Santa Claus auditions his next crop of elves.

programme.title: Santa's New Gig
programme.desc: Jonathan Bennett challenges the three remaining teams of cake and sugar artists to show how Santa celebrates the off-season with a side job.

programme.title: Elves vs. Reindeer
programme.desc: The two remaining teams of cake masters and sugar artists face off for their final festive battle for a grand prize of $25,000.

programme.title: Surprise Holiday Parade
programme.desc: Five teams of cake and sugar artists compete to impress the judges as Santa makes a spur-of-the-moment decision to throw a holiday parade.

programme.title: Santa to the Rescue!
programme.desc: Five teams of cake and sugar artists must imagine what happens outside the North Pole and make a creation symbolizing Santa Claus as a world hero.

programme.title: The Great Turkey Escape
programme.desc: Five teams of master cake and sugar artists create what happens when all the Thanksgiving turkeys decide to make a break for it.

programme.title: When Toys Come Alive
programme.desc: The five teams show the judges what happens when too much holiday magic happens and newly minted toys come alive, escape from their boxes and go crazy.

programme.title: Critter Christmas
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of cake and sugar artists must create the most bizarre visions of a Christmas party in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: North Pole Wedding
programme.desc: Raven-Symoné challenges the four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists to imagine the most romantic wedding the world has ever seen at the North Pole; judges Shinmin Li and Erin Acevedo decide which team will go home with $25,000.

programme.title: Reindeer Auditions
programme.desc: In the first qualifying round, the three teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase an unlikely understudy who dreams of winning a spot to pull Santa's sleigh; two teams move on in the competition and the judges send one team home.

programme.title: A Cake-mas Carol
programme.desc: In the second qualifying round, three teams are challenged to showcase Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol" in a way the world has never seen before by completely reimagining the iconic ghost of Christmas past, present or future.

programme.title: Wild Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the final qualifying round, three teams have to showcase how two animals that don't ordinarily get along can celebrate Thanksgiving together in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: The Ultimate Snowball Fight
programme.desc: With the qualifying rounds complete, six teams of masterful cake and sugar artists face off in a challenge to imagine the perfect way to win the ultimate snowball fight.

programme.title: Intergalactic Holidays
programme.desc: The five remaining teams of cake and sugar artists are challenged to imagine friendly aliens celebrating their own holidays on another planet; at the end of the face-off, the field of competition narrows with one team's elimination.

programme.title: Holiday Sing-Along
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of master cake and sugar artists are challenged to bring the story of a carol to life using their imagination, with cake.

programme.title: Merry Grinchmas!
programme.desc: In the penultimate battle, three teams of master cake and sugar artists bring Dr. Seuss' iconic "How the Grinch Stole Christmas" to life by re-imagining the world-famous story as a big-screen epic in a whole new movie genre.

programme.title: Santa's New Ride
programme.desc: With $25,000 and the title of Holiday Wars Champion at stake, the last two teams of cake and sugar artists must showcase the wildest, most powerful, modernization imaginable for Santa's new ride.

programme.title: Champion Cake Off
programme.desc: The reigning champions of "Halloween Wars" and "Holiday Wars" face off in a New Year's themed battle involving team mascots and champagne-inspired cakes; the winning team gets a trip to New York City for the biggest New Year's party in the world.

programme.title: Elf's Downhill Derby
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro welcomes three teams to the first qualifying round; the talented cake and sugar artists must create a derby car fit for Santa's elves; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move on and who heads home for the holidays.

programme.title: Hanging with Old St. Nick
programme.desc: Three new teams face off in the second qualifying round as Jeff Mauro challenges them to imagine how Santa spends time with his BFF; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira send two more teams to the main competition and one group goes dashing home.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Turkey Trot
programme.desc: In the final qualifier, Jeff Mauro tasks three new teams with crafting a turkey and rider to race in the first annual Turkey Trot; Judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide whose Thanksgiving creations will move on and whose will not.

programme.title: Reindeer's New Hobby
programme.desc: The six remaining teams face off as Jeff challenges them to envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira judge the designs before flying one team home.

programme.title: Ugly Sweater Party
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature that is throwing an ugly sweater party for all its forest friends; at the end of the festive fiesta, judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira eliminate one more team.

programme.title: Time Travelin Santa
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.

programme.title: A Very Peanuts Christmas Tree
programme.desc: Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.

programme.title: Discovery

programme.title: Random's Child

programme.title: An Occupational Hazard
programme.desc: Rose Murphy is sexually assaulted at work by her boss and, fending off another attack, she kills him.

programme.title: Last Rights
programme.desc: Morphine tablets have been disappearing from Newton General Hospital and Tibbs investigates.

programme.title: When The Music Stopped
programme.desc: Bubba learns the disappointing truth that the country singer he idolizes might have stolen his biggest hit.

programme.title: Flowers From A Lady
programme.desc: The victim of an armed robbery becomes obsessed with Bubba when she misinterprets his kindness for romance.

programme.title: Private Sessions
programme.desc: When a drowned body is found washed up on a riverbank, Tibbs' law school buddy is the prime suspect.

programme.title: Judgement Day
programme.desc: When a judge running for Congress refuses to grant his wife a divorce, she's found dead as part of a robbery.

programme.title: Falsely Accused
programme.desc: Officer Wilson Sweet is accused of allegedly soliciting a bribe when he arrests a shady car salesman.

programme.title: A Step Removed
programme.desc: An imperfect stepfather is suspected of murdering his ex-boss after losing his job.

programme.title: Deadly Affection
programme.desc: A nasty slumlord threatening to evict a single mother and her daughter is suspected of murder.

programme.title: The Leftover Man (Part 1)

programme.title: The Leftover Man (Part 2)
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs continue their investigation into politician George Deschamps and his cronies.

programme.title: A Dish Best Served Cold
programme.desc: When an embezzler returns to Sparta after many years away, it stirs up old resentments.

programme.title: Legacy
programme.desc: A landowner is visited by a distant cousin who claims her grandfather was cheated out of the family estate.

programme.title: Even Nice People
programme.desc: An impending trial will force Gillespie's daughter to face her attackers.

programme.title: Lake Winahatchee
programme.desc: Gillespie's daughter continues to defend her home from her mother's greedy ex-boyfriend and his mob.

programme.title: A Correct Settling
programme.desc: Harriet DeLong's son teams up with a prison pastor to get his father off death row.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: The town council decides not to renew Bill Gillespie's contract, pushing him into a sudden retirement.

programme.title: Hatton's Turn (Part 1)
programme.desc: Bill Gillespie and Hampton Forbes begin their new roles as Sheriff of Newman County and Sparta Chief of Police

programme.title: Hatton's Turn (Part 2)
programme.desc: After a robbery and tragic triple murder, one thief is missing, one is dead and one is on the run.

programme.title: A Depraved Heart
programme.desc: Bubba is set on indicting a man for knowingly transmitting HIV to his friend. But, the man is found murdered.

programme.title: Incident At Brewer's Pond
programme.desc: A mischievous cowboy and his buddies try to steal watermelons for a party, but the night ends in murder.

programme.title: A Love Lost
programme.desc: Bill Gillespie's daughter learns that her old flame has arrived in Sparta and may be illegally running guns.

programme.title: Singin' The Blues
programme.desc: A singer discovers her boyfriend's nightclub is being used as a cover to sell Ecstasy.

programme.title: Virgil Tibbs: Attorney At Law

programme.title: Every Man's Family

programme.title: A Baby Called Rocket
programme.desc: Sgt. Corbin takes temporary custody of an abandoned baby boy found at a crack house after a drive-by shooting.

programme.title: Little Girl Lost
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes Sparta when a young alcoholic woman kills a child in a hit-and-run accident.

programme.title: Your Own Kind

programme.title: Good Cop, Bad Cop

programme.title: Maybelle Returns

programme.title: The Last Round

programme.title: Ches And The Grand Lady
programme.desc: A blues singer starts receiving racist death threats after spending time with Lt. Jamison's wealthy aunt.

programme.title: Conspiracy Of One
programme.desc: Soon after Virgil Tibbs is hired by a local law firm, he investigates a suspicious car accident.

programme.title: The Rabbi

programme.title: Hard Choices

programme.title: Time's Long Shadow

programme.title: Poor Relations

programme.title: Dangerous Engagement

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: Give Me Your Life
programme.desc: Gillespie, Forbes and the Sparta police investigate allegations of child abuse in a mysterious religious cult.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: A Matter Of Justice

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: By Duty Bound
programme.desc: With Gillespie's term as Sheriff coming to an end, it becomes a case of political intrigue and murder.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night: Grow Old Along With Me
programme.desc: Gillespie and Forbes get involved in the case of an alcohol-infused driver in this made for TV movie.

programme.title: Pilot (Part 1)
programme.desc: When Virgil Tibbs joins the Sparta, MI, police, resentment festers in Chief of Police Bill Gillespie.

programme.title: Road Kill
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs are at odds when Tibbs suspects that Gillespie's old friend, Sonny Mims, killed his wife.

programme.title: Fate
programme.desc: Emotions run high when a black businessman (Randy Brooks) comes to Sparta to buy the town's newspaper.

programme.title: Blind Spot (Part 1)

programme.desc: When a wealthy bigamist (Ted Lange) turns up dead in his cell, which of his wives turns out to be a murderer?

programme.title: Country Mouse, City Mouse
programme.desc: Virgil Tibbs's niece and Bubba Skinner's nephew find common ground -- and trouble -- in Sparta.

programme.title: The 12 Step Job

programme.title: The First David Job
programme.desc: The team targets the CEO who denied Nate's son medical treatment.

programme.title: The Second David Job
programme.desc: Nate comes out of hiding and tries to get his team back together to directly challenge Sterling and Blackpoole.

programme.title: The Beantown Bailout Job
programme.desc: Nate reassembles the team to pit the local Irish mob against a banker who is gaming a government bailout.

programme.title: The Tap-Out Job

programme.title: The Order 23 Job
programme.desc: The team goes after a shady hedge-fund manager; the mark is in the custody of the U.S. Marshals and is being hunted by the Armenian mob.

programme.title: The Fairy Godparents Job
programme.desc: A clinic is forced to close because its funds were lost in a Ponzi scheme; the team goes after a corrupt investment banker who has money hidden from the authorities.

programme.title: The Three Days of the Hunter Job
programme.desc: A TV host claims a school-bus driver caused an accident that left two children dead; Sophie takes the lead as the team sets out to put the host in her place.

programme.title: The Top Hat Job
programme.desc: The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

programme.title: Building a 4-Link Suspension to Conquer the Trails
programme.desc: Our '78 Postal Jeep gets an upgraded suspension that can handle the trails. We'll start by fabricating our axles and frame for a 4 link setup.

programme.title: Burnt Junkyard 6.4L Gen III HEMI Rises From The Ashes
programme.desc: A burned-up 6.4L Gen III HEMI is revived with some old school hot rod parts.

programme.title: Turbocharged Ford 300 Inline Six Makes Over 500 HP on the Dyno
programme.desc: Ford's inline six industrial engine gets what you've been asking for...a turbo!

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 1
programme.desc: We're getting the rear racing suspension installed in our 2002 Ford Ranger!

programme.title: Valvoline Camaro Part 2
programme.desc: 'The Valvoline Sweepstakes Camaro is completed and readied to be given to a lucky viewer.

programme.title: Building a Baja Style Bug With a VW Beetle and A Stock Can-Am Maverick X3
programme.desc: What do you get when you combine a Bug and a UTV? The answer: BajAwesome. The Carcass team builds a baja style bug with a left for dead VW Beetle and a stock Can-Am Maverick X3. This is part 1 of a 3 part BajAwesome build.

programme.title: C10 Teardown and K1500 Goes Rally Racing
programme.desc: LT and Austin start the teardown process and make some upgrade decisions for Project Lo 'n Slo.

programme.title: Artistry In Motion - Project UnSanctioned Part 5
programme.desc: Our 2001 BMW race car, Project Unsanctioned, heads to the paint booth to paint the roll cage. Then we'll head back into the shop for a stylistic wrap and some artistic freedom, before finally assembly and taking it to the track.

programme.title: How to Build a High Power Diesel Beast
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make high power starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.

programme.title: Tune & Tone
programme.desc: Is custom exhaust worth it on a budget build? The age-old question - does tone matter when dollars do? Will our custom exhaust take our Lexus IS250 up a notch, or will we have to cut back to finish our build.

programme.title: Fabricating an Aggressive Rear Spoiler for a Buick Regal
programme.desc: Our '85 Buick gets a new spoiler to help keep the rear on the ground. Plus, HEMI fans get a treat to a visit at Arrington Performance.

programme.title: 1977 F-150 Gets Some Much Needed Upgrades
programme.desc: We open the mailbox and answer some long-awaited viewer questions. We'll also hit the road to rescue a 1977 Ford F150 in need of repair.

programme.title: Adding An EFI Setup To The C1500 Chevy
programme.desc: We bring our C1500 Abandoned Chevy back into the shop for an easy to install EFI setup that will allow for more boost and power. Plus we head out to Mid-Ohio Sports Car Course to compete with our Spec Panther race car.

programme.title: Swapping In A Performance Clutch On The Spec Miata Racecar - Part 3
programme.desc: The crew starts tearing into the drivetrain and suspension of their Spec Mazda Miata racecar to help it perform better on the track.

programme.title: OBS Chevy C1500 Gets a Cantilevered Rear Suspension
programme.desc: We work on the suspension of a 1989 OBS Chevy C1500 truck. It's an upgrade for the front IFS and a fabricated custom rear suspension to get all that LS Power to the ground.

programme.title: '74 Bronco Chills with Aftermarket Air Conditioning
programme.desc: We wrap up the assembly of our Bronco as it gets a fuel system, exhaust, brakes, trim, gauges, and new air conditioning.

programme.title: Flogging a Stock Jeep JK Before Adding Performance Mods
programme.desc: Our new project Jeep debuts in a junkyard to crush some cars. Then, it's back in the shop to cut fenders for bigger wheels and tires and a lift install.

programme.title: OBS 632 SS Part 7 Refresh and Reuse
programme.desc: Our Silverado 632 SS project is getting close to completion. We relocate our battery and start wiring so we can power our systems. We refurbish some interior pieces to match our new color scheme, then add some extra grip with a traction control module.

programme.title: How To Lift And Level Your Truck For More Clearance
programme.desc: When adding bigger wheels and tires to your vehicle may cause some problems with clearance. We show you some quick solutions to get you rolling again.

programme.title: Driveway Rescue: Everyday Charger
programme.desc: We meet a guy who turned his vintage Dodge into a daily driver... and help him fix it!

programme.title: Toughening Up The '91 Suburban With New Axles And A 4-Link Coilover Kit
programme.desc: Our GMC "Unbreakable" Suburban gets its new suspension along with a good sanding and paint job to help get it ready for the real world.

programme.title: Single Cylinder Special
programme.desc: We show you how to have lots of fun building engines on a budget. We dive into the world of small engines doing a multi-stage build on a 212 CC Go-Kart engine, and we test some easy, bolt-on upgrades on the chassis dyno and behind the wheel.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Shifts Into Gear With A New Transfer Case
programme.desc: Our K-10 Square body is starting to come back to life. The cab, body panels and bed all get reassembled. We add cooling, electrical, resto parts and measure the driveshaft and finalize the transmission linkage. The end is in sight!

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 4: Making The Bed
programme.desc: The MCT Crew have the frame shortened on Project Cream Puff and it's ready for its new bed. The guys give you a couple of options on how to tackle a short bed conversion, then start assembling their new one. Plus, get a little help with choosing what kind of floor we want for our custom C-10.

programme.title: Testing 4 Common Engine Building Myths: Which Ones Are True?
programme.desc: Want to build your best powerplant? It starts with understanding the fundamentals of engine building: valve lash, header sizing, and more!

programme.title: Road Course Camaro Part 10 Custom Dash Panel
programme.desc: The guys show you how to create a custom steering column for your race car that won't break the bank. Plus, they will fabricate a custom dash to accept their new digital gauge cluster, and show you an easy way to wire your project.

programme.title: Ford vs Chevy: Small Displacement Showdown
programme.desc: The TIMELESS Debate is on. Ford vs. Chevy. We start with a stock 305 Chevy and a 302 Ford. After an initial baseline, we see how they stack up against each other with the same mild upgrades. We find out, dollar for horsepower, who comes out on top.

programme.title: Building Bigfoot: What It Takes To Create A Monster Truck
programme.desc: We take a road trip to the outskirts of St. Louis to meet with the team responsible for Bigfoot! We have access to the inner workings, get a sneak peek at a new Bigfoot, and we're going to drive a monster truck!

programme.title: Bringing The Thunder To Our Hurst Olds With 80's Style And Big Power
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel roll an '83 Hurst Olds into the shop and install brakes, wheels, and tires to lay the groundwork for adding some thunder back into this classic lightning shifted street seeker.

programme.title: 440ci Motown LS Race Engine: Part II
programme.desc: We finish the assembly of our 440 with a conventional SBC bottom end and LS induction. Then we put it on the dyno and see how many ponies it puts out!

programme.title: Project Rapid Runner is Complete - SEMA Build Part 2
programme.desc: Challenging times are coming as the deadline of Project Rapid Runner comes into view. Chris and Eric's 2025 Nissan Frontier Pro 4X still has a ton of work needed to finish up in time for SEMA. Can they do it?

programme.title: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, to a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six
programme.desc: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, from a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six, Mike and Pat celebrate their vintage builds and how they turned retro into big modern muscle.

programme.title: Boosting A Crown Vic Police Interceptor 160 Horsepower
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc almost double the horsepower on a 2008 Ford 4.6L Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor. The solution for more power is adding a small tailpipe turbo, exhaust and fuel mods. Then the dyno don't lie! From 200HP to 368HP, this Vic is ready for high pursuit!

programme.title: Turning A Mazda Miata From Street Car to Spec Race Car - Part 1
programme.desc: The Carcass crew heads out to the NCM Motorsports Park for a High Performance Driving Experience! Then they take their new project car, a Mazda Miata, out on the track to get baseline numbers! Plus we add performance parts to get a boost in power!

programme.title: Mopar Big Block and Transmission Drop
programme.desc: Today, our 1969 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, gets a major power upgrade. We also get our brakes lined out and connect all the steering linkage for total control. The icing on the cake, we paint the scooped hood and add our Swinger stripe.

programme.title: Installing an Aluminum Bed Floor Kit in a Chevy C10
programme.desc: Our Lo 'n Slo, C10 project breaks tradition by ditching its rotted wood bed floor for an easy install aluminum kit that mimics the real thing. Plus, the guys in Engine Power explode our 292 straight-six for a full rebuild.

programme.title: What Muscle Car is Right For You
programme.desc: We look at several projects like Hard Charger - our 1969 Dodge Hellcat Charger, Sydewinder - our 1981 Fox Body Mustang Cobra, our 1966 Pontiac Convertible, and our 2016 Ford Mustang GT. We'll give you a play by play of what it takes to build each one to help you decide what avenue to take for your vehicle.

programme.title: Building 1974 Bronco From The Ground Up
programme.desc: With the help of some master craftsmen, the guys start building a Bronco from the ground up, one that will cruise the beach, scream down the interstate, and everything in between.

programme.title: How Much Power Can Bolt On Upgrades Add To a F-150 Sport Truck?
programme.desc: We revisit the F150 Dream Truck and find out what bolt on upgrades actually do to your horsepower numbers, and we'll test it on the dyno.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 9: Low Ride, High Power
programme.desc: Project Cream Puff takes a huge step forward in this episode as the MCT crew installs an air-ride suspension system, giving the build its signature low, effortless stance while cruising the streets. Plus, we'll unleash some serious power with the addition of a supercharged boost, transforming our C-10 into a street machine with both style and muscle.

programme.title: Bolt-On 100+ Horsepower in a Day
programme.desc: Power upgrades are great especially if you can bolt-on big performance in a day. Mike and Pat grab some wrenches to install a ProCharger supercharger on a 2019 Challenger ProCharger.

programme.title: Lowering And Chopping The Bed On The Turbocharged Ford 300 Flatbed
programme.desc: We bring our now turbocharged 1964 Ford F350 flatbed shop truck back for upgrades. We'll bob the bed by cutting the frame, build and install a new exhaust, and then drive it like we stole it!

programme.title: 1000 Horsepower on a Budget? Rebuilding a Windsor 351
programme.desc: There's No Replacement for Displacement! We made some good power with this Ford powerplant before, but can this bullet rebuild make 1000 Horsepower?

programme.title: Back to Basics Part IV
programme.desc: We bring you straightforward information and tips to make your next engine build go quicker and easier!

programme.title: 1000 Horsepower on a Budget? And Rebuilding a Windsor 351
programme.desc: There's No Replacement for Displacement! The Windsor powerplant is getting stroked, plus can this offroad Big Block Chevy bullet make 1000 Horsepower?

programme.title: Driveway Rescue: '94 Bronco
programme.desc: The men hit the road to rescue a viewer's ex-border patrol Bronco with new exterior & interior goodies. Plus custom exhaust for our Klassy K5 Blazer

programme.title: Rebuilding The Rusted Out Chassis On Our Square Body
programme.desc: A 50 year old tow truck gets a newly fabricated rear chassis to return it to its former glory.

programme.title: How To Achieve Power Gains Without Taking Apart Your Engine
programme.desc: There are four basic elements that affect an engine's performance: spark, fuel, air, and lubrication. We'll show you how to improve each of them WITHOUT cracking open your powerplant.

programme.title: Dropping Our '53 Willy's Wagon Body On Its New Chassis
programme.desc: The Carcass duo fab up some custom body mounts for a first look at the Chevy M1010 and Willys Wagon combo. Plus, a sneak peak at the powerhouse that will drive it all.

programme.title: Hard Charger - Interior and Out Back

programme.title: Wiring Hacks to Get Our Road Runner Amped Up - Part 5
programme.desc: We make all the right connections and dash towards the finish line as we install new seats, wiring, and the steering column in our '69 Road Runner.

programme.title: OEM Ford F-100 Suspension Swap
programme.desc: Shockingly, a sixty-year-old suspension needs replacing. So, Eric and Joel kick it old school with some OEM parts for Clint Black's 1960 Ford F-100.

programme.title: Project Fat Stack - Part 12
programme.desc: Interior Decorated - Tommy and Joel cut a rug and freshen up the rest of Fat Stack's interior to match the flashy exterior of their 1971 Chevy Caprice.

programme.title: OBS Overkill - 90's Sleeper Show Truck
programme.desc: We're kicking off our newest build, a 1996 Chevy Tahoe. It's a 90's inspired sleeper show truck that you wished you drove in high school.

programme.title: Out With the Noise, In With the Comfort: Buick Regal Soundproofing
programme.desc: We show you a few tips on wiring up your next project, then we sound proof the interior on our '85 Buick . Plus we take a stroll through some backwoods in search of some Detroit Treasures

programme.title: Assembling a 410 Mopar with High Flow Induction
programme.desc: Mopar fans rejoice! Chrysler's venerable muscle car powerplant gets a big cubic inch increase and the induction package you've been asking for.

programme.title: Keeping it F-100
programme.desc: With no time to kill, Eric and Joel install the remaining components to get Clint Black's old 1960 Ford F-100 back on the road again.

programme.title: Tacoma Topper
programme.desc: Our 2001 Toyota Tacoma gets a canvas topper, plus Jeremy and Eliza help a young couple with their restoration of a 1978 Chevy K10.

programme.title: Drifting Trailblazer SS Is Ready for the Track After Suspension Upgrades
programme.desc: The Trailblazer SS goes from super sport to drifting sport...suspension upgrades and a power adder cap off the project sending it to the track!

programme.title: Nissan Trailgater Part 3
programme.desc: It's the 4th quarter, bottom of the ninth, and final period of our 2025 Nissan Trailgater build. Eric and Joel put on the finishing touches and wrap everything up so you can have fun in the sun and leave no trace when you're out and about in your new overachieving overlander.

programme.title: Firing Up The JunkMail Jeep For The First Time
programme.desc: We start the final push getting Junk Mail one step closer to the trail. We tackle our wiring, plumb up our cooling and fuel systems. Then, we fabricate our exhaust before firing the '78 Postal Jeep up for the first time.

programme.title: Mocking Up a New 1974 Bronco
programme.desc: It's time to mock everything in place in our 1974 Bronco. We'll also have the frame blasted and powder coated, the body in epoxy, and assembled to the frame.

programme.title: Adding Class & Comfort to Our Square Body, Then Parking Lot Revenge
programme.desc: An interior dress-up for a 50 year old tow truck giving it new life on the road.

programme.title: Building a Dream '74 Bronco From the Ground Up
programme.desc: We take one of the most sought after vehicles - a true old-school '74 Ford Bronco, and strip it down to the chassis to bring it back to life, ultimately deciding on building it back up to an actual all-new dream machine...piece by piece.

programme.title: Cobra Fender Flares and Charger Charms
programme.desc: The crew installs widebody flares on the Fox Body Cobra, and take a few steps to make the Charger look like a million bucks.

programme.title: Hear The Willys' 383 Stroker Small Block Chevy Roar
programme.desc: The Willys Mud Wagon gets a 630HP powerhouse that screams, and Jeremy and Jimmy take FrankenRegal out for a mudding adventure.

programme.title: 434ci UMP Race Engine
programme.desc: We head to the premier high performance educational institution, the University of Northwestern Ohio, to build a track dominating race engine. We partner with UNOH Motorsports Team students to build a high-end 434ci UMP Modified engine for their dirt track racing program. After assembling this high compression power plant, we brutality put it through its paces on their engine dyno to get it ready for the track.

programme.title: Installing Tacoma Suspension Upgrades
programme.desc: Our Tacoma get suspension upgrades for our Straight Axle Toyota. Plus, our Pre-Runner Ranger gets alignment ready.

programme.title: Crushing It: Episode 4
programme.desc: Grab a backstage pass and get a glimpse of what it takes to produce a Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live event. Our team presents you with the stars of Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live, while hanging out with Demo Derby driver, Derick Anson, and visiting FMX driver, Cody Elkins, at his home in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Step by Step Installation of a New Top on Our 1966 Pontiac Convertible
programme.desc: Step by step, we install a new top on our 1966 Pontiac convertible. Plus, a High Performance visit to Las Vegas for LS Fest West.

programme.title: Project Nightshift: Working Overtime
programme.desc: Project Night shift is back in the shop! The guys install a rebuilt transfer case in our '93 Dodge Diesel Dually. They also plumb in our bigger turbo setup, showing you how to bead roll your tubing to make a secure fit. Plus, they'll show you the tools you'll need make your own brake lines.

programme.title: Crusin' Caprice Wagon Drivetrain Upgrade
programme.desc: The Caprice Wagon is back in the shop for the rest of its upgrades. Jimmy and Jeremy add a new drivetrain to give our cruiser a boost in horsepower and then we add a few custom touches before taking the whole tribe on a cross town adventure in the Carcass family truckster.

programme.title: Will the Ford 300 Inline Six Start After Sitting for 20 Years?
programme.desc: From freeway to farmyard, this rugged straight six was everywhere! It's the subject of our latest build.

programme.title: Ram Diesel Fuel System Upgrades
programme.desc: We've up'd the horsepower of our 2016 Ram dually with the air side of things, now onto fuel. A 2nd generation fuel system is installed with new injection & lift pumps to support 770 HP.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle Dreamland: A Museum Full Of Mopars
programme.desc: Tommy heads to Alabama to the Wellborn Musclecar Museum to see one of the most prestigious Mopar collections ever.

programme.title: Installing a 5.0L Coyote Drivetrain
programme.desc: Our Pre-Runner Ranger gets a 5.0L Coyote and beefy transmission for maximum off-road action.

programme.title: Time To Roll! Installing New Gears, Lockers and Drivetrain in Our DJ5 Jeep
programme.desc: We start the reassembly of our '78 Postal Jeep, "Junk Mail" with new gears and lockers for our axles. Plus, we drop in our upgraded drivetrain with a 4 to 1 transfer case.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 5: Tunnel Vision
programme.desc: The MCT Crew takes our '72 Super Cheyenne, Project Cream Puff, and tackles the challenge of building a custom transmission tunnel to make room for the new automatic trans. Plus, we'll cut and shape our fenders to install new wheel tubs for a cleaner look and accommodate our lowered stance.

programme.title: Old School 302 Ford Goes High Tech
programme.desc: We take an old-school 302 Ford and bring it into the 21st century with much-needed induction and fuel delivery upgrades.

programme.title: A Sport Truck Deserves Serious Brakes: 2020 F-150 Brake Upgrade
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes giveaway 2020 F150 gets body mods and other upgrades for a sporty dream truck appearance.

programme.title: Chevy Blazer Assembly/Interior
programme.desc: Klassy K5 returns from fresh paint for re-assembly, and interior goodies, plus the "dress-up" of our Ram 1 ton dually with mega-bumpers and headache rack

programme.title: Assembling Our Base
programme.desc: It's finally time to finish Project Spartan's drivetrain. We fabricate a new cross member, build custom mounting brackets, and install the transfer case on our 1969 M715 Jeep Kaiser. Then we modify the frame to accommodate the driveshaft run and tackle the suspension work needed to get the axles ready to be mounted. Project Spartan is getting closer to being a fully functioning machine.

programme.title: Building A Naturally Aspirated 6.0L LS Iron Block
programme.desc: We build up a naturally aspirated 6.0 liter LS iron block engine for both track and street duty.

programme.title: Beefing Up The '70 RestoMod Mustang's Brakes
programme.desc: The EBC Fastback Mustang has to hook and stick to the ground, so it's time for some new suspension magic!

programme.title: Adding More Power to the Rally Car's 4 Cylinder
programme.desc: We do a little wrenching on our Honda 4 cylinder. Updating some key components and sealing up some oil leaks. Plus, the Civic gets a facelift with a Rally Car inspired paint job.

programme.title: Building a Ford 2.3L 4-Cylinder Lima Engine For The Dirt Track
programme.desc: It's a first for HorsePower - putting together a four-banger, high performance engine dedicated to oval, dirt track competition. It's amazing how much power you can pack into a small race engine designed especially for dirt tracks.

programme.title: Building the Beast - Project UnSanctioned Part 4
programme.desc: Our 2001 BMW race car gets a set of coilovers, as well as big brake upgrade. Then we change the aerodynamics of our project to give it a fierce look.

programme.title: Complete build of our Big Body Grand Marquis
programme.desc: Complete build of our Big Body Grand Marquis

programme.title: Open Heart Surgery
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton are set to get their new five-speed transmission into their Fox Body Mustang. However, due to the engine bay's shape they need to take a different approach to installing their motor-transmission duo.

programme.title: Bringing A 1964 Ford F350 Flatbed Back From The Dead
programme.desc: We rescue a 1964 Ford F350 flatbed that hasn't run in 5 years. If we can get it started in the field we'll haul it back to the shop to make it safe and driveable again. It might even become our new shop truck!

programme.title: Buttoned Up & Shipped Off: The Classic Bronco Gets Its Final Assembly
programme.desc: The guys work hard to finish their 1974 build under the hood, under the frame, and under the top because this prized new Bronco will be on its way to the SEMA Show in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Creating Big Aero Gains in our Autocross Camaro
programme.desc: Part 3 of the Autocross Camaro Build. A 25th Anniversary Camaro transforms into an autocross machine. A custom spoiler, and an affordable splitter makes this muscle car ready for the track.

programme.title: 427ci LSx Part 2
programme.desc: We wrap up our 427ci LSx engine build for the Music City Trucks' C10 so it can hit the engine dyno! We're topping this engine with a high flowing induction package, stand-alone EFI, and classic small block look. We'll tune it up on the dyno to make pump gas power that will dominate the street!

programme.title: Adding Posi-traction to our '02 Old School Sierra
programme.desc: We trash the factory Gov-lock rear for a true posi to get both tires spinning. Plus suspension upgrades and a classic throwback exhaust continue our retro build.

programme.title: Dodge Challenger Tears It Up At NCM Motorsports Park
programme.desc: The Challenger tears it up at NCM Motorsports Park! Plus we'll help a viewer perk up her pickup in this week's Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Adding '90s Flair To A 2000s GMC Daily Driver
programme.desc: We buy a '02 Sierra on the cheap and turn it into a reliable, powerful daily driver. First a leveling kit, wheels, and tires for a brand new stance.

programme.title: How to Install a Convertible Top
programme.desc: Step by step, we install a new top on our 1966 Pontiac convertible. Plus, a High Performance visit to Las Vegas for LS Fest West.

programme.title: Taking our '69 Camaro into the Modern Era
programme.desc: We take our '69 Camaro and upgrade the suspension, brakes and tires to give it better handling and performance on the street.

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 4 Steering Upgrades
programme.desc: Eliza and Jeremy are adding a custom steering setup to their 2002 Ford Pre-Runner Ranger!

programme.title: Turning An Old Crown Vic Cruiser Into A Track Panther - Part 1
programme.desc: We start working on a new project with the novice racer in mind. We take a 2008 Ford Crown Vic Police Cruiser and turn it into a budget-friendly Spec Panther racing machine! Today we'll upgrade our transmission for better shifting and give the old power plant a tune-up.

programme.title: Brake the Pavement
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes and Pedal Commander Dodge Charger gets its final touches on brakes and cosmetics before hitting the track.

programme.title: Ultimate 318 LA: Part 2
programme.desc: Our small block 318 Mopar returns to be prettied up and completed on this episode. We cover it in a custom color and go through a detailed assembly process to get it ready for our Dyno. But things go sideways during the testing with our 318, first making excellent power then revealing major problems, and we hope we caught it in time.

programme.title: 1980s Mustang Cobra Transformation Part 2
programme.desc: This hissing Cobra gets dialed in with final touches, taking it from concept to coiled and ready to strike! Strap in for Project Sydewinder's first track day!

programme.title: OBS Pro Touring Chevy Heads to the C10 Nationals and Hits the Track
programme.desc: We add the final touches to our OBS Pro Touring Chevy C1500 and take it to the C10 Nationals where we put it to the test at the Nashville Superspeedway.

programme.title: AWD vs. 4WD Chevy 1500
programme.desc: There's a new purpose and a new plan for our Chevy K1500. It's the tips and techniques for a traction machine. GM's Greatest All-Wheel-Drive Idea Applied To Our C/K 1500

programme.title: Tearing Down a Pair of 351 Small Blocks: Windsor vs Cleveland
programme.desc: HorsePower goes on a salvage yard treasure hunt and finds a pair of 351 smallblocks -- Cleveland and Windsor. After twin teardowns, exploring the characteristics of each, the guys start the first of two performance build-ups.

programme.title: Power Nationals Muscle
programme.desc: We check out the 8 acres of muscle cars, hot rods, and classic cars, along with an autocross attraction at the first annual Power Nationals event at the Nashville Superspeedway.

programme.title: JL Rubicon: Tires and Under Armor
programme.desc: Our Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon gets brand new tires and some much needed under armor. Plus, our 2001 Tacoma gets a spray-on bed liner.

programme.title: Rescuing A 1971 Chevy Caprice From Driveway Death
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew rescues a familiar green 1971 Chevy Caprice, dropping a few tips and tricks along the way while diagnosing issues that can easily go unseen.

programme.title: Tearing Into Our AMC Javelin
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc have new project in the shop and have some unique plans that pay homage to the street machine era. But to do that they need to see what they have to work with.

programme.title: Cooling Down & Increasing Power On The '71 Chevy Caprice
programme.desc: Cool Running - We install the cooling system on our '71 Caprice and then put the pedal to the metal to give you the lowdown on electronic throttle vs mechanical.

programme.title: How Camshaft Timing Affects Engine Performance
programme.desc: The first-generation Chevy Small Block deserves its reputation as a powerful and reliable engine. It's the foundation for an old-school stroker build with an emphasis on durability.

programme.title: Sea Foam Truck Tech Sweepstakes
programme.desc: A beefy transmission and gear swap wraps up the Silverado giveaway truck that you can win!

programme.title: Lift & Shift
programme.desc: We yank out our old suspension, upgrade the underside of our Diesel Dually, Nightshift, and give it a disc brake conversion and lift kit to help uphold its Dodge signature style.

programme.title: Lighting the Way Forward
programme.desc: Project Spartan, our 1969 Jeep Kaiser M715, is getting a major overhaul from the ground up. We start by upgrading the lighting system with modern headlights and some vintage C10 turn signals, then move on to the critical work of patching and reinforcing the frame; fixing all the damage left behind by years of rust and corrosion. But the real milestone comes when we reunite the engine with the transmission, build custom mounts, and drop the heart of this beast back onto the frame.

programme.title: 700 Horsepower '86 Jeep Wagoneer Monster Hits the Track
programme.desc: This is a non-stop, complete thrash as we turn a 1986 Jeep Wagoneer into a 700+ horsepower, two-wheel drive monster and put it to the test at the National Corvette Museum Motorsports Park.

programme.title: Body Kit Bolt Ons
programme.desc: Balling on a budget means spending your money wisely. Brian and Jason ordered a complete body kit for their 2011 Lexus IS 250 from China and today, they're cracking open the crate! Will it work or do they have to cut it to fit?

programme.title: Pumping Extra Ponies Under The Hood Of The Retro AMC Javelin
programme.desc: We put some muscle behind our 1973 AMC Javelin, and we see how far it will go on the Dyno.

programme.title: Turning a '76 Cadillac Hearse Into A Torque Monster
programme.desc: We take a '76 Cadillac Hearse and start turning it into a torque monster that will scream down the track starting with the drivetrain.

programme.title: Chevy Blazer Custom Paint
programme.desc: After months of prep, the '89 Blazer hits the paint booth for a custom mix of color. And to accompany the panels will be a color-matched bedliner.

programme.title: Restoring a Scuffed Up Windshield - Road Runner Part 6
programme.desc: We get into some arts and crafts to create a one-of-a-kind emblem that redefines ransom wear and we'll use some wool to clear up Road Burner's eyes. When it's all said and done, the guys will be literally exhausted.

programme.title: 509ci W-Series Big Block Chevy Part 2
programme.desc: We continue the buildup of our 509ci W-Series engine as we get it ready to hit the engine dyno. We wrap up this vintage looking hot rod power plant with high flowing induction and throttle body EFI before we see how much power it makes in the dyno.

programme.title: Extreme Diesel Rigs at Ultimate Callout Challenge
programme.desc: LT & Austin purchase a 2011 Sierra Denali HD, plus they are on the road in Indy for coverage of the Ultimate Callout Challenge.

programme.title: Hellcat '69 Charger Restomod Sold For $200,000 - How We Did It
programme.desc: Watch the three year journey of a 1969 Dodge Charger from barn find to crossing the block at Mecum Auctions in Dallas. Detroit Muscle's Marc Christ and Tommy Boshers complete the restoration that results in a $200,000 sale number at auction!

programme.title: Hot Rod LQ9 Cam Swap
programme.desc: Our GM LQ9 engine needs the right ingredients to turn it into a spicy hot rod street bullet.

programme.title: How to Drift Like a Pro: Better Grip Means Better Drift for Our Trailblazer
programme.desc: Part 3 of the Drifting Trailblazer. Pro drifter, Josh Robinson, gives a lesson on drifting, and the Trailblazer gets a suspension overhaul.

programme.title: Can We Make This Stock '91 Suburban Unbreakable?
programme.desc: In the series launch we take a 1991 Chevy Suburban and transform it into 'Project Unbreakable.' We test the Suburban at on off-road track, then return to the studio to tear it down to the frame, create a full build-plan, get the engine work underway, and begin fabrication.

programme.title: Chevy DragAlanche - Part 3 The Ultimate Hook-Up
programme.desc: Our Chevy Avalanche, Project DragAlanche, gets a stronger rear end featuring beefier gears and an upgraded braking system built to handle increased performance. Then the factory rear suspension is replaced with a fully adjustable 4-link setup, providing the tuning capability and traction needed for maximum grip and consistent launches down the drag strip.

programme.title: Will Race Fuel And A Bigger Cam Improve Power On The Chevy 350 Dyno Mule?
programme.desc: We just can't stop searching for more power from our Small Block Chevy! It's getting high-octane race fuel, more aggressive timing, and a bigger cam.

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger: Headers & Shocks
programme.desc: Cagetube, Rollcage, Shock loops and more, our Prerunner Ranger is getting custom headers and long travel shocks.

programme.title: Ford F-150: Preparation F
programme.desc: Today, we're prepping a big-block Ford to go in our big blue F-150. We'll walk you through the ins and outs of any and everything you'll need to plumb an entire fuel injection system from sump to solenoids.

programme.title: Turbo Tech Making 1200+ Horsepower
programme.desc: Turbo pioneer, Kenny Duttweiler steps in to lend a hand with our LME 427 ci LSX engine. Boosting this bullet with a high-tech turbo system produces a lot of excitement and big dyno numbers!

programme.title: Making Room for Bigger Tires On Our Lifted GMC Sierra 1500
programme.desc: Transformation of our throwback Sierra continues with a lift kit, 33" tall tires, and a tune-up before we hit the trail for some wheelin' in the country.

programme.title: 1974 Beach Cruiser Bronco Is Ready To Roll
programme.desc: Today we finish the final assembly of our 1974 Beach Cruiser Bronco with the installation of the interior.

programme.title: Crown Vic Cruiser Gets A Junkyard Axle For Its Spec Panther Transformation - Part 2
programme.desc: We continue work on our Ford Crown Vic Police Cruiser Spec Panther race car with a rear end swap, suspension mods, and upgraded stopping power.

programme.desc: Stephanie tries to convince Kristen to stay in Los Angeles. Bill is upset when the police return Caroline's purse to him.
