programme.desc: It's easy to feel like you're only as good as your last performance or your biggest mistake. But God doesn't evaluate you the way the world does. Your value was settled before you even got started.

programme.title: Expecting Change
programme.desc: God doesn't just want to fix you, He wants to restore you. Right now, He's transforming you to impact others. Expect more than a personal breakthrough; expect God to exceed your expectations and bless others through your life.

programme.title: Cover The Spread
programme.desc: When the odds are against you, face the battle anyway. In Cover The Spread, Pastor Steven Furtick challenges us to turn our problems into petitions - because God's got the answer.

programme.title: Learning Hope the Hard Way
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how God uses hardship to give birth to greater hope.

programme.title: You Can Skip This!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches you to move beyond fear and doubt by taking the next step God asks of you.

programme.title: 3 Habits of a Healthy Heart
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals three habits for improving attitude, enduring hardship and sustaining hope.

programme.title: Tune Your Heart To Truth
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how God's truth protects your heart from the enemy's distractions.

programme.title: I'm Going Through But I'm Running Over
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how God makes a way through adversity when you refuse to lose heart.

programme.title: Not Something, But Someone
programme.desc: Pastor Steven shares a simple truth that can help you endure life's hardest trials. True security isn't the absence of trouble; it's the presence of a Savior who promises you'll never walk through it alone.

programme.title: When Waiting Isn't Working
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows when faith requires action instead of more waiting for a perfect next step.

programme.title: The God Of Already
programme.desc: God already sees you for who you truly are. In The God of Already, Pastor Steven teaches us that God's plan for our lives is closer than we realize.

programme.title: Fix Your Focus
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how right focus honors God and strengthens the relationships you love.

programme.title: The God Of Also
programme.desc: Don't limit your potential. In The God of Also, Pastor Steven Furtick teaches us that understanding the calling God has placed on our lives also requires us to let go of the limited idea of who we believe He's created us to be.

programme.title: It's Hard To Hear God
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick explains how to recognize, trust and obey God's voice amid noise and uncertainty.

programme.title: Breaking The Bondage Of Wrong Belief
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how believing God is enough breaks captivity to lesser things.

programme.title: The Lord Will Lighten Your Load
programme.desc: When you've been hurt, it can be hard to keep hoping. But God wants to lift the weight you've been carrying today. Learn from the life of Israel (Jacob), how God will give you a strategy to unburden your heart and move forward.

programme.title: Challenge The Shadow
programme.desc: No challenge, no change. In Challenge The Shadow, Pastor Steven Furtick shows us that things can change when we bring our doubts and shame to the light of God's presence.

programme.title: I Left That Out
programme.desc: Most of us have parts of our lives we'd rather keep hidden, even from God. The disappointment we haven't processed. The questions we haven't asked. The fears we don't want to admit. But what if the breakthrough you're praying for is on the other side of the thing you've been avoiding?

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: Invisible Prisons
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals that God may exceed the expectations He does not meet.

programme.title: God Will Work It In!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how God strengthens you within a situation even before it improves.

programme.title: Not Now Is Not No
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how God's slower timing can teach you without denying His promise.

programme.title: Forward Not Finished
programme.desc: In Forward Not Finished, Pastor Steven Furtick reminds us that God is still writing our story - so don't give up believing Him for more.

programme.title: Making Moves
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how to take faithful steps and trust God when struggle signals His work.

programme.title: There Is A Throne
programme.desc: Sometimes, even when you're trying to do all the right things, you still end up in a dark place. But there is a King on the throne, and knowing He is with you can make all the difference in the world. Priscilla Shirer preaches from Revelation 4.

programme.title: Rags To Righteous
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how God uses every pit stop on the path to your purpose.

programme.title: I'm Going Under
programme.desc: There's nothing you could ever go under that God isn't over. His authority isn't meant to control you with fear but to lead you with love. In this message, Chet Pete reminds us: When you trust His commands and surrender to His control, you can rest.

programme.title: Concealed But Not Canceled
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how God turns your greatest weakness into His greatest weapon.

programme.title: When Jesus Is Your Jury
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals freedom from human opinion and performance through Jesus' verdict.

programme.title: Ugly Trust
programme.desc: When you say, I can't, God says, I can. In Ugly Trust.

programme.title: A Recipe For Resentment
programme.desc: If you've been feeling pulled in every direction, it might be time to pivot. God isn't asking you to do everything - He's asking you to stay close to Him.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: Let Me Show You The Door
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how to resist the enemy God's way when attacks precede greater impact.

programme.title: I Know God Can, I Know God Will, But I Don't Know How
programme.desc: Are you praying for clarity on a decision in your life? Pastor Jabin Chavez preaches about the role of faith in how we see our lives and in the decisions that we make. Maybe the reason you can't tell what's next is that God is inviting you into.

programme.title: When Anxiety Attacks
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how to find anxiety's center and resist it instead of running.

programme.title: Do the New You
programme.desc: In Do The New You, Pastor Steven reminds us that God has given us the decision to remain the same or grow into who He has created us to be.

programme.title: This Might Be My God Moment
programme.desc: Are you standing over a situation that's too big for you? If you feel like your hope, logic, and options are at a dead end, pay attention because this might be your God moment.

programme.title: What If I Got It Wrong?
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches you to take doubts to Jesus and trust God's purpose over your expectations.

programme.title: Barriers to Blessings
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how focusing on who God is removes expectations that block blessing.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: He Answered
programme.desc: Pastor Steven gives us three things to remember when life is hard. The enemy wants to keep us circling the wilderness, but God will bring us through as we learn to repeat what leads us to victory.

programme.title: Try Higher
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches you to bring obstacles to God instead of merely trying harder.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Official live videos from the album SO BE IT by Elevation Worship.

programme.title: Places Everyone!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shows how God meets you on the path and restores you in unexpected places.

programme.title: This Is What A Miracle Feels Like
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals signs of God's work when your feelings lag behind a new reality.

programme.title: Delayed Praise
programme.desc: In Delayed Praise, Pastor Steven Furtick encourages us to tune out what the enemy is telling us about our current situations and focus on the things that God has already taught us.

programme.title: The Limp Won't Make You Late
programme.desc: Lean on Him to lead you. In The Limp Won't Make You Late, Pastor Steven reveals that God has you exactly where He needs you - and if you'll lean on Him, He'll give you what you need to get through.

programme.title: Dig Until God Does
programme.desc: It will flow when it's supposed to. In Dig Until God Does, Pastor Steven Furtick shows us how to plant seeds of faith in the dry seasons of our lives until God brings the rain.

programme.title: Lions & Lizards & Lies
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches that taking back your mind begins by humbling your heart.

programme.title: Running For A Reason
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick reveals how being chosen while chased develops purpose in life's hidden caves.

programme.title: He Was The One
programme.desc: Assume that God is using you. In He Was The One, Pastor Steven teaches us that instead of judging our current season, we should trust that it is significant to where God is taking us next.

programme.title: God Keeps Receipts
programme.desc: Pastor Rich Wilkerson Jr. preached from Hebrews 6 to show us that even though we can forget God, He promises never to forget us. God knows us, and He keeps receipts, but it's not to shame us; it's to save us. If you need your faith renewed today.

programme.title: Something In Between
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches that Jesus overcomes the guilt, grief and grave separating you from God.

programme.title: New Number Same Name
programme.desc: If you're looking at what's next and feeling nervous, remember this: What God has done in your life is only the foundation, not the finish line. He's a creative God, still at work in ways you're not expecting. Let go of your plan, so God can show you His purpose.

programme.title: Filled By Faith!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how to move forward in faith through grief, fear, and uncertainty.

programme.title: Elevation Church Live
programme.desc: Welcome to Elevation Church. See what God can do through you.

programme.title: The God Of Again
programme.desc: Get ready for what's next. In The God Of Again, Pastor Steven Furtick reminds us that God isn't against us - He keeps coming back for us over and over again.

programme.title: This May Be Plan C
programme.desc: What do you do when things don't go according to plan? There might be some things in your path you didn't expect, and it might be taking longer than you thought, but God's got you covered. Watch the message to see why you're still going to get there.

programme.title: Let's Build Something
programme.desc: Jesus saves you and makes you new, but He doesn't stop there. Next, He'll give you something to do. Pastor Earl McClellan shares from Nehemiah to show that God has called you to build something, but the timing might not be what you expect.

programme.title: Focus Your Faith
programme.desc: In Focus Your Faith, Pastor Steven Furtick shows us how the power of faith can transform our perspective.

programme.title: Don't Let The Attack Distract You
programme.desc: Right when you start to feel some positive momentum in your life, an attack comes out of nowhere. Sound familiar? Pastor Steven uses the parable of the seeds to illustrate what to do when the enemy attacks and how to persevere in your purpose.

programme.title: Not As Long As My Song!
programme.desc: Hitting your limit isn't a sign of weakness; it's an invitation to shift your perspective. When the enemy brings the battle to your mind, remember that he only attacks what's valuable. And God's goodness is your secret weapon to win the fight.

programme.title: Elevation Church Live
programme.desc: Welcome to Elevation Church. See what God can do through you.

programme.title: It Still Works
programme.desc: Pastor Steven showed us through the life of Moses how faith often looks like taking action even while you feel full of doubt. God can do miracles when we have the courage to look our doubt in the face and do it anyway.

programme.title: First Things First
programme.desc: Ben Graves teaches that God calls you to face hardship and contend for a legacy rather than hide.

programme.title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle join forces with Joxer (Ted Raimi) and Orpheus (Matthew Chamberlain) to defeat the evil god Bacchus (Anthony Ray Parker), who is transforming innocent girls into deadly monsters.

programme.title: The Return of Callisto
programme.desc: When the fierce woman warrior Callisto (Hudson Leick) escapes from prison, Xena must face her in battle once again.

programme.title: Warrior..Princess..Tramp
programme.desc: Xena must foil an attempt to dethrone her friend and look-alike, Princess Diana, by the unscrupulous Meg, who bears a startling resemblance to both.

programme.title: Intimate Stranger
programme.desc: With the help of Ares (Kevin Smith) in the Underworld, Callisto (Hudson Leick) switches bodies with Xena and returns to the land of the living where the two women warriors battle once more, this time disguised as each other.

programme.title: Ten Little Warlords
programme.desc: While still trapped in the body of her enemy, Callisto, Xena is forced to enter a competition where warlords vie to become the new god of war.

programme.title: A Solstice Carol
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle try to bring the warmth of the holiday season to a cold-hearted king (Peter Vere Jones) who has outlawed the Winter Solstice celebration.

programme.title: The Xena Scrolls
programme.desc: In 1940, two archaeologists look for the legendary scrolls that Gabrielle wrote about her adventures with Xena.

programme.title: Here She Comes...Miss Amphipolis
programme.desc: Xena masquerades as a beauty pageant contestant to stop a saboteur, who is bent on destroying a peace treaty between three warlords.

programme.title: Destiny
programme.desc: After being critically injured in a fight, Xena lets her mind flash back to the time that Julius Caesar (Karl Urban) taught her a valuable lesson about destiny.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: Gabrielle's attempt to take Xena's body to be buried with her brother are complicated by would-be thieves, Amazon dynasty squabbles, and Xena attempts to communicate through Autolycus.

programme.title: A Necessary Evil
programme.desc: In order to stop the evil Velasca (Melinda Clarke) from hunting down Gabrielle, Xena must unleash an even more depraved immortal to vanquish her---Callisto (Hudson Leick).

programme.title: A Day In The Life
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) has 24 hours to prevent a warlord from plundering one village, and the world's biggest giant from destroying another.

programme.title: For Him The Bell Tolls
programme.desc: While engaged in a battle of wills with her son, Cupid, Aphrodite (Alexandra Tydings) turns Joxer into a dashing hero tasked with stealing a princess's heart away from her betrothed.

programme.title: The Execution
programme.desc: When Meleager, the hero who once saved Gabrielle's village, is condemned for murder, Gabrielle and Xena have only one turn of the sand dial to produce evidence that he is innocent.

programme.title: Blind Faith
programme.desc: A warrior (Jeremy Callaghan) wants to make his name by killing Xena. He fails, but he succeeds in putting the warrior princess in a blind rage when he kidnaps Gabrielle and sells her to agents of a king.

programme.title: Ulysses
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle chance upon King Ulysses on his way home to Ithaca from Troy, and when they see that Poseidon doesn't want him to get there, they do everything they can to make sure that he does.

programme.title: The Price
programme.desc: Xena reverts to her old ways to whip a dispirited Athenian army into shape to take on a foe known as the Horde.

programme.title: Lost Mariner
programme.desc: After a shipwreck, Gabrielle is rescued by the cursed ship of Cecrops, where she will have to stay until she dies -- unless Xena can break the curse.

programme.title: A Comedy of Eros
programme.desc: The baby of Cupid & Psyche, on the loose with Daddy's love-causing bow, complicates Xena's attempt to stop Draco from attacking a temple of Hestian virgins.

programme.title: The Furies
programme.desc: When the Furies find out that Xena never avenged the death of her father, they curse her with persecution and madness until she completes her task.

programme.title: Been There, Done That
programme.desc: The exact same day continues to start over and over again and only Xena can unravel the mystery.

programme.title: The Dirty Half Dozen
programme.desc: Xena enlists the help of four notorious criminals to steal back the secret to an impenetrable metal that Ares is using to win wars.

programme.title: The Deliverer
programme.desc: When Xena goes to help an old foe in a battle against Caesar, she ends up rescuing Gabrielle from the evil talons of Dahak, the 'One God.'

programme.title: Gabrielle's Hope
programme.desc: When Gabrielle is mysteriously impregnated, Xena must fight in a battle between the warriors and the Banshees to determine if the child is evil or good.

programme.title: The Debt
programme.desc: When Xena is given a cryptic message about a Green Dragon, she heads to the Kingdom of Chin to kill him.

programme.title: The Debt II
programme.desc: While awaiting execution for attempting to kill the Ming ruler, Xena finally repays the debt she owes her spiritual mentor, Lao Ma.

programme.title: The King of Assassins
programme.desc: When Joxer's twin brother, Jett, plans to assassinate Cleopatra with the help of Autolycus, Gabrielle uses as many Xena-like tactics as possible to try to stop the murder.

programme.title: Warrior...Priestess...Tramp
programme.desc: When Xena saves her look-alike, the Hestian Priestess Leah, from Balius, the supposed Hestian Priest, she must enlist the help of Meg, yet another Xena clone.

programme.title: The Quill Is Mightier
programme.desc: Gabrielle gains new respect for the power of the word when Aphrodite casts a spell on her scroll, turning everything she writes into reality.

programme.title: Maternal Instincts
programme.desc: Imbued with the evil power of her father Dahak, Gabrielle's daughter Hope joins forces with Callisto to kill Xena's son, Solan.

programme.title: The Bitter Suite
programme.desc: The bitter conflict between Xena and Gabrielle reaches a crescendo in this musical episode, set in the dream world of Illusia.

programme.title: One Against An Army
programme.desc: When Gabrielle is struck with a poisonous arrow, Xena must find a way to save her while single-handedly battling the entire Persian army.

programme.title: Forgiven
programme.desc: When Xena and Gabrielle set out to recover the stolen Urn of Apollo, they are joined by Tara, a feisty 16-year old who wants a chance to turn her life around.

programme.title: King Con
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle join forces with two con men to exact revenge against a ruthless gaming club owner who has ordered Joxer's death.

programme.title: When in Rome...
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle battle the ruthless Caesar to rescue the mighty Gaul warrior, Vercinix.

programme.title: Forget Me Not
programme.desc: Haunted by images of the past, Gabrielle goes to the Temple of Mnemosyne to forget her painful memories.

programme.title: Fins, Femmes & Gems
programme.desc: When Aphrodite obtains the stolen Mystic Diamond, she puts a spell on Xena, Gabrielle and Joxer to distract them from rescuing the prized jewel.

programme.title: Tsunami
programme.desc: Xena, Gabrielle and Autolycus summon all their resources to escape from a ship submerged by a monstrous tidal wave.

programme.title: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: Xena, Gabrielle and Autolycus pull off a spectacular heist to retrieve the golden statue of Pax.

programme.title: Sacrifice, Part I
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle struggle in vain to prevent the rebirth of Gabrielle's child Hope, the evil daughter of Dahak.

programme.title: Sacrifice, Part II
programme.desc: Xena reluctantly agrees to join forces with Callisto to kill Gabrielle's evil daughter Hope.

programme.title: Adventures in the Sin Trade - Part I
programme.desc: Distraught with grief over the loss of Gabrielle, Xena travels to Siberia and the Amazon Land of the Dead to find her friend.

programme.title: Adventures in the Sin Trade - Part II
programme.desc: Xena travels to the Amazon Resting Place to battle the evil Witch, Alti, and learns that Gabrielle is still alive.

programme.title: A Family Affair
programme.desc: Xena reunites with Gabrielle and the two friends face off with the evil Hope and Dahak's grandson, the monstrous Destroyer.

programme.title: In Sickness And in Hell
programme.desc: Suffering from an array of physical ailments, Xena and Gabrielle battle a Scythian army.

programme.title: A Good Day
programme.desc: Xena engineers a giant battle between Caesar and Pompey to save Greece.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Muses
programme.desc: Xena, Gabrielle and Autolycus bring dancing to a town where it is banned.

programme.title: Locked Up And Tied Down
programme.desc: Xena is banished to Shark Island Prison for all the crimes and murders she committed in her dark past.

programme.title: Crusader
programme.desc: Xena and Najara, a radiant young woman who preaches about the Light, compete for Gabrielle's heart and soul.

programme.title: Past Imperfect
programme.desc: In order to save a town from destruction, Xena must figure out who is copycatting her past evil deeds.

programme.title: The Key To The Kingdom
programme.desc: A double for Xena double-crosses Autolycus in an attempt to steal a special baby.

programme.title: Daughter of Pomira
programme.desc: To bring peace between two feuding cultures, Xena and Gabrielle rescue Vanesa, the young adopted daughter of the leader of the dreaded Horde.

programme.title: If The Shoe Fits
programme.desc: Through imaginative storytelling, Xena, Gabrielle, Joxer and Aphrodite help the young runaway Princess Alesia realize there's no place like home.

programme.title: Paradise Found
programme.desc: In a seemingly idyllic land, Gabrielle finds peace and calm as Xena is beset by visions of violence.

programme.title: Devi
programme.desc: In exotic India, Gabrielle finds she has the power to cure people, but that ability may come from a sinister source.

programme.title: Between The Lines
programme.desc: While traveling through India, Xena and Gabrielle's souls are sent into the future through the power of Mehndi to protect their good Karma from the reincarnated Alti (Claire Stansfield).

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Xena invokes the help of the god Krishna (Rajiv Varma) to rescue Gabrielle and Eli (Timothy Omundson) from Indrajit (Rajneel Singh), the King of Demons.

programme.title: The Play's The Thing
programme.desc: Gabrielle unwittingly becomes a pawn in a theater scam when one of her scrolls falls into the hands of Zehra, the "Queen of Cons."

programme.title: The Convert
programme.desc: Najara returns claiming she has renounced violence, while Joxer deals with his first kill.

programme.title: Takes One to Know One
programme.desc: On a dark and stormy night, Xena must determine which one of her friends is a murderer.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: When Brutus kills Ephiny, Gabrielle is called back to be queen of the Amazons.

programme.title: The Ides Of March
programme.desc: Callisto returns to tempt Xena as Caesar plans to declare himself emperor.

programme.title: Deja Vu All Over Again
programme.desc: A woman is convinced she is the reincarnation of Xena, the Warrior Princess.

programme.title: Fallen Angel
programme.desc: After being crucified by the Romans, Gabrielle's (Renee O'Connor) soul struggles to save Xena (Lucy Lawless), who literally becomes a demon from Hell.

programme.title: Chakram
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) has no recollection of being a warrior after she and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) are resurrected from the dead by Eli (Tim Omundson).

programme.title: Succession
programme.desc: Ares (Kevin Smith) merges Xena (Lucy Lawless) and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) into the same body and forces them to fight Mavican (Jenya Lano), Ares' potential right hand.

programme.title: Animal Attraction
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless), Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor), Joxer (Ted Raimi) and Amarice (Jennifer Sky) travel to the town of Spamona, where Xena is shocked to learn that she is pregnant.

programme.title: Them Bones, Them Bones
programme.desc: The spirit of the evil Shamaness Alti (Claire Stansfield) attempts to capture the soul of Xena's (Lucy Lawless) unborn child.

programme.desc: Chef Stellino paints the picture of a life expressing himself through his plating. Dishes include: Red Wine Sauce / Scalloped Potatoes (with Swiss and Parmesan cheese) / Steak au Poivre with Garlic Arugula / Salmon with Brussel Sprouts and Red Wine Sauce.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Satisfying & Complete With or Without Meat
programme.desc: If you're cutting back on meat you may wonder what to eat more of. Ellie shows you how easy (and tasty) it is to incorporate other protein-rich elements into your snacks and meals. Recipes include Broccoli and Cheddar Soup, Steak Fajitas, Asian Noodle Bowl with Peanut Dressing, and 3 Ingredient Crunchy Roasted Chickpeas.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Big Flavor, Less Salt
programme.desc: Ellie helps you get the bold taste you crave from your favorite foods while keeping salt in check in your kitchen. Recipes include 3-ingredient Coriander Crusted Turkey Breast, Sweet & Spicy Roasted Root Vegetable, Tri-Color Salad Pizza, and Family Favorite Minestrone Soup.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Raw Vs Cooked
programme.desc: Raw foods are on hot now. But cooked foods have unique benefits too. Let Ellie suss out the facts from the hype for you. Recipes include Gazpacho, 3 Ingredient Tomato Sauce, Zucchini Carpaccio, and Wok Charred Lettuce with Shrimp.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Better Brunch
programme.desc: Ellie hits refresh on the typical brunch menu with some creative, make-ahead crowd-pleasers that break the mold. Recipes include Eggs Florentine in Tomato Cups, Breakfast Strata, Pumpkin Waffles, and 3 Ingredient Brussel Sprout Hash with Egg.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - Snack Attack
programme.desc: Americans get more than 25% of calories from snacks. Ellie shows how to make them count with some great ways to satisfy the cravings we get around the clock. Recipes include 3-ingredient Chocolate Grape Banana Skewers, Nutty Oatmeal Bars, Spring Cottage Peas with Basil, and Hummus with Cumin-Roasted Carrots.

programme.title: Ellie's Real Good Food - How To Fish
programme.desc: Are you floundering when it comes to adding fish to your menu? Ellie is your fishing guide as she demystifies the choosing, prepping, and cooking of fish. Recipes include 3-Ingredient seasoned breadcrumbs, Tilapia Milanese with breadcrumbs, Green Tea Poached Salmon with Asian Slaw, and Bouillabaisse.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - The Improbable Grill
programme.desc: The Improbable Grill: In this show we explore three unexpected techniques for grilling. The first stands the vertical rotisserie used in Mexico and the Middle East. The second involves a piece of equipment you don't usually find at a barbecue-a roofer's torch. The third involves a mystery ingredient that virtually no one on the planet has ever grilled.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Cured and Smoked
programme.desc: Cured and Smoked: In humankind's long march to food security, two ancient preserving techniques have stood out over the millennia: curing and smoking. The first involves preserving foods with salt, soy sauce, or sodium nitrite, and the second technique involves blasting foods with flavorful clouds of wood smoke. Today, we're pushing the envelope on traditional curing and smoking.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Maryland Crab Feast
programme.desc: Maryland Crab Feast: This show focuses on my favorite food growing up: callinectes sapidus, better known as the Maryland blue crab. Maryland seafood markets and restaurants come alive with soft shell crabs, eaten shell and all, traditionally deep-fried, here seared over live fire. Which brings us to the summum of the Maryland crab experience: a crab feast known as Maryland steamed crabs.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Raichlen's Rules Desserts
programme.desc: Raichlen's Rules: Desserts: Take your desserts to a new level of flavor with Grilled Pound Cake with Berry Salsa and Smoked Whipped Cream, Salt Slab-Grilled Pears with Amaretti And Smoked Whipped Cream, Dessert Quesadillas, Smoked Ice Cream with Rum Raisin Sauce.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Best Ribs Ever
programme.desc: Let Texans brag about brisket and Carolinians praise pulled pork shoulder. For the rest of us, the ultimate symbol of barbecue is ribs. In the American Midwest, ribs mean baby backs or other pork ribs, while in Korea, the bone of choice is the beef short rib. In the eastern Mediterranean, lamb ribs reign supreme. In this show we give you three of the best ribs ever.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Health Food
programme.desc: Barbecue Health Food: A little-known fact-Steven Raichlen's first James Beard Award-winning book wasn't about barbecue, but a book on healthy eating. This show harnesses the flavor- boosting, fat-melting power of live fire to produce grilled fare that not only tastes good but is good for you. From the paellas of Spain to the grilled beef salads of Southeast Asia.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Planet Steak
programme.desc: Steak. Few other words in the English language have such power to make our hearts beat faster and our mouths water than sizzling slabs of beef seared over live fire. In this show we embark on some meaty globe hopping, exploring over-the-top steaks from France, Cambodia, and the American Southwest. Hot fire. Sizzling meat. It's a carnivore's dream come true.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Fruit Deserts
programme.desc: Jacques doesn't always eat dessert at home, but when he does, it's usually some kind of seasonal fruit. Classics like Baked Apple Bon Femme, Bananas Flambe, Cherry Compote or Pears in Puff Pastry... are served often. A new favorite is a British Lemon Posset. Other simple staples are Blueberries with Lemon and Mint or Grapefruit with Apricot Sauce, all great ways to end a meal.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Lavish Indulgences
programme.desc: Jacques celebrates birthdays, anniversaries and holidays with special meals. It's when he splurges on caviar, oysters, even truffles-the ultimate extravagance. These occasions are a time to gather together around the table with family and friends and indulge in our favorite foods and wines.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Summer Cookout
programme.desc: When the weather heats up it's time for family dishes that work on the grill or in the pan. Jacques' great summer menu with Asparagus in Butter Sauce, a Grilled Steak with Zucchini, topped with Anchovy Butter, Curly Dogs for the kids. He shows you classic ways to cut potatoes and ends with a Patriotic Raspberry and Blueberry Galette.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Simply Seafood
programme.desc: Jacques loves seafood and feels lucky to live by Long Island Sound with its wonderful stocks of Atlantic fish and shellfish. He prepares scallops, crab and cod--raw, fried, sauteed or grilled in dishes that are quick, simple and delicious.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Party Time
programme.desc: Gathering with family and friends around the table or for a game of boules is the life's greatest pleasure for Jacques. He makes chicken wings, cucumber soup, merguez sausage, zucchini canapes, hummus and his father's Fromage Fort. Simple food that can be made ahead means that you can enjoy a glass of wine with your company.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - London
programme.desc: Billy and Dom learn the secrets behind the perfect traditional English roast dinner in London's historic Borough Market, explore the best of the diverse food offerings in Brick Lane and pop in to see their friend, Sir Ian McKellen, in his pub in East London.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Scotland
programme.desc: Billy and Dom traverse the Isles of Lewis and Harris, where they attend an agricultural show and are invited to a traditional Scottish cèilidh. They meet the Hebridean Baker who treats them to an alfresco dinner on the Isle of Taransay, and visit the Isle of Harris Distillery to try their offering of gin and whisky.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - California
programme.desc: Billy and Dom share their favorite haunts in Los Angeles, including the famous Mel's Diner in Santa Monica. They take a trip to Sonoma County for a farm-to-table adventure and get a rare opportunity to take a fascinating glimpse at the world's most advanced lab-grown meat facility in Oakland.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Manchester
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Dom's hometown of Manchester, the world's first industrialised city and now a vibrant food capital. They brunch at cult diner Gooey, learn to cook curry at a classic "Rice & Three" café, explore the science behind ice cream cones, and enjoy a special tour of Manchester United's iconic stadium.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Costa Rica
programme.desc: Billy and Dom journey across Costa Rica from the northern Pacific coast to San José. In Nicoya, a renowned Blue Zone, they uncover dietary secrets linked to long, healthy lives. Venturing into the jungle, they work on a coffee plantation and discover why Costa Rica is the world's leading exporter of pineapples.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Riga
programme.desc: The CentralTirgus is the biggest covered city food market in Europe. Just aside the Art Nouveau Old Town, we find century-old rye-bread making, grilled lampreys, soviet milk sausages, and hemp butter. Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Freiburg
programme.desc: The 'green' city of Germany has an incredible gothic cathedral with a food market at its feet. Every morning, six days a week, farmers from the Black Forest bring their trout and herb pestoes, wild berries, and smoked ham to the city. Be it a vegan wurst or a tasty cheesecake, here the surprises never finish!

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Budapest
programme.desc: The largest indoor market in Budapest is also the most elegant in Europe! Spanning over three levels, the impressive central food market is long recognized as a marvel. Whether it be the freshest fish, the richest goose liver, or the sweetest paprika that you're looking for, you'll find it. But don't forget the basement: this is where you will find the very best pickled cabbage in the country!

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Amsterdam
programme.desc: Food markets have a strong tradition in the Netherlands and many citizens count on their long street markets for their fresh food supplies. One of the oldest and most famous markets of the Netherlands is the Albert Cuyp Markt, a street market stretching along the upcoming (and "hip") neighborhood of de Pijp.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - From Caracas to Lima
programme.desc: In this episode, we'll travel the BBQ trail from Venezuela to Peru, starting with a Venezuelan specialty-Asopao (seafood rice), reimagined here on the grill by Caracas-born chef Geronimo Lopez. And then a twist on two Peruvian delicacies-Tuna Anticuchos (kebabs) and Smoke-Roasted Peruvian Potato Salad.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - The Brazilian Grill
programme.desc: Brazilians are world masters at the art of the rotisserie. In this show, learn to cook beef, chickenand pork with the proverbial turn. We start with Brazil's celebrated Picanha (fat cap sirloin)-served with farofa and Country-Style Salsa. Next, Brazilian Pork Loin grilled with Bacon and Prunes, and finally, Rio Chicken Rollatini. So put on some samba music and get ready to rock the grill.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Fire and Spice
programme.desc: The Caribbean occupies a special place in the annals of barbecue. Taino Indian barbacoa-seafood and meats smoke-roasted on a wooden platform that gave us the word "barbecue." The Caribbean remains a hotbed of barbecue delights; Jamaican Jerk Chicken, Trinidadian grilled vegetable dip called Choka and Shrimp Boka Dushi-a spicy Dutch West Indian kebab whose name literally means "happy mouth."

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Texas Trinity
programme.desc: Texas BBQ to many means brisket, but in this show, you'll experience the Texas Trinity: Grilled Quail with Pear Salsa and Blue Cheese Farroto prepared by San Antonio master chef Jason Dady. Smoked and Grilled Rib-Eye Steaks accompanied by Smashed Potatoes. And a sizzling sandwich, a Hot Gut Hero (beef sausage with pepper Jack cheese). It's the Texas Trinity hot off the grill.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Mexi-que
programme.desc: Across Latin America, grilling styles vary: Argentine and Uruguayan masters embrace simplicity, seasoning steaks with just salt. In contrast, Mexican chefs layer bold flavors-marinating meats in recados and adobos, wrapping them in aromatic leaves, and searing over hardwood fires. Here are three spectacular Mexican grilling specialties that showcase this rich, fiery tradition.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - San Antonio Grill
programme.desc: San Antonio is the home base for this season of Planet Barbecue. One of only two cities in the U.S. designated a UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy, the Alamo City boasts a cuisine as colorful as its historic city center. Get ready for Carne Asado Breakfast Tacos, Jason Dady's Oak-Smoked Cherry-Glazed Ribs, and Beef Cheek Barbacoa prepared by local smoke master Esaul Ramos.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Planet Barbecue - Grilling from Across the Pond
programme.desc: When Columbus landed in what is now the Bahamas in 1492, he initiated an East-West culinary exchange that continues to this day. This show explores three European grill classics-each with a New World twist. From Wood-Grilled Gazpacho with Serrano Ham Crisps to a unique Pearl District Spiessbraten served with Jicama Salad. And for dessert? Spectacular Smoked, Torched Creme Brulée.

programme.title: Serial Griller - Hot Handhelds
programme.desc: Matt Moore kicks off Serial Griller with "Hot Handhelds," grilling up bold favorites like Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwiches, Pork Gyros, char-grilled hot dogs, wings with blue cheese, and the juicy Hemingway Burger. No forks required!

programme.title: Serial Griller - Friends and Family
programme.desc: Matt Moore grills for friends, serving sausage, blade steaks, redneck potatoes, and a Bardstown Buck cocktail.

programme.title: Serial Griller - All the Courses
programme.desc: In "All the Courses," Matt Moore celebrates East Nashville's Tomato Fest with a feast-Breakfast Pizzette, Tuna Nicoise, Scored Flank Steak with Dijon Caper Sauce, and Grilled Watermelon. A multi-course grilling adventure with Southern flair!

programme.title: Serial Griller - East Meets West
programme.desc: Host Matt Moore brings East and West together over charcoal on the Ammo Grill. Inspired by his travels to Japan and the renowned Hikiniku To Come experience, Matt serves up juicy Wagyu Hamburger Steaks alongside a lineup of crowd-pleasing favorites. The menu includes Chili Cheese Dawgs, Salmon Kabobs, and Bacon-Bratwurst Fried Rice, each showcasing bold flavors and live-fire cooking techniques.

programme.title: Serial Griller - Americana-ish
programme.desc: Matt Moore fires up his Hasty Bake grill outside his airplane hangar, surrounded by his Piper Cherokee and vintage military aircraft, for an Americana-inspired feast cooked over live fire. Drawing from his Lebanese and Syrian heritage, Matt starts with grilled beef kefta pitas before serving a smoky grilled Caesar salad and juicy grilled chicken thighs topped with vibrant salsa verde.

programme.title: Serial Griller - All Day Eats
programme.desc: Matt Moore showcases the versatility and convenience of gas grilling on the Napoleon Rogue Pro-S in an all-day celebration of outdoor cooking. The menu begins with family-favorite griddled breakfast smashburgers before moving to a grilled greens salad and grilled shrimp tostadas. Then, a Greek-inspired rotisserie beer can chicken with drip potatoes delivers a flavorful one-pan feast.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - London
programme.desc: Billy and Dom learn the secrets behind the perfect traditional English roast dinner in London's historic Borough Market, explore the best of the diverse food offerings in Brick Lane and pop in to see their friend, Sir Ian McKellen, in his pub in East London.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Scotland
programme.desc: Billy and Dom traverse the Isles of Lewis and Harris, where they attend an agricultural show and are invited to a traditional Scottish cèilidh. They meet the Hebridean Baker who treats them to an alfresco dinner on the Isle of Taransay, and visit the Isle of Harris Distillery to try their offering of gin and whisky.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - California
programme.desc: Billy and Dom share their favorite haunts in Los Angeles, including the famous Mel's Diner in Santa Monica. They take a trip to Sonoma County for a farm-to-table adventure and get a rare opportunity to take a fascinating glimpse at the world's most advanced lab-grown meat facility in Oakland.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Texas
programme.desc: Billy and Dom go on a Texas road trip, and absorb the very best of its Southern Hospitality. In Dallas they taste an array of delights offered at the State Fair of Texas. They learn about ranching and how to cook and eat like a real cowboy, and learn the secret behind Austin's best BBQ.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Kyushu
programme.desc: Billy and Dom explore Kyushu, the most southerly of the Japanese main islands. They master the art of making the world famous Tonkotsu Ramen, fashion their own sushi knives with the help of a blacksmith who ordinarily has an eight-year waiting list for his product, and participate in a traditional Japanese tea ceremony.

programme.title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Manchester
programme.desc: Billy and Dom head to Dom's hometown of Manchester, the world's first industrialised city and now a vibrant food capital. They brunch at cult diner Gooey, learn to cook curry at a classic "Rice & Three" café, explore the science behind ice cream cones, and enjoy a special tour of Manchester United's iconic stadium.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Let Food be Thy Medicine
programme.desc: Diane embraces the words of Hippocrates, "Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food." She explores Greek staples-olive oil, herbs, nuts, veggies-as health foundations. Plus, three simple recipes and a chat with Dr. William Li, author of Eat to Beat Disease.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Changing the Geography of the Dinner Plate
programme.desc: How do you take a meat-centric plate and shift things around so that vegetables take up the prominent place and meat plays a secondary role? Diane and her son Yiorgos explore the geography of the dinner plate by recreating classic Greek recipes for meat with, well, less of it!

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Greens Rule the Day
programme.desc: Diane shares how shopping for, cleaning and cooking greens is easy and accessible. She visits her 96-year-old cousin's garden, this vibrant produce may hold the key to her longevity. In the kitchen, Diane prepares a green storm and sips a surprising elixir from cooked greens.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Plant-Based in Ancient Greece
programme.desc: Inspired by the ancient Greek philosopher and mathematician, Pythagoras, Diane explores plant-based cooking rooted in his ancient vegetarian philosophy. She discusses modern nutrition's alignment with Pythagorean principles and chats with Prof. John Wilkins on Ancient Greek foods and medicines.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Influential Grilling
programme.desc: Influential Grilling: Scroll through the images on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, and you'll find grilled and smoked dishes of astonishing ingenuity. In the spirit of this new style of barbecue, we've invited three of my favorite influencers to grill with me - Derek Wolf from Over the Fire Cooking, Scott Thomas from Grillin' Fools, and Susie Bulloch from Hey Grill Hey.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wagyu Demystified
programme.desc: Wagyu Demystified: Wagyu, "Japanese cow" literally, was once an obscure cattle breed from Japan. Today, it's on restaurant menus and in butcher shops around the world. Get ready for a sumptuous Japanese A5 Rib-Eye with sesame salt and grilled rice cakes, followed by wagyu steak tomahawks with fire-roasted marrow. Then feast your eyes on wagyu smash burgers with parmesan crisps.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight
programme.desc: Barbecue Takes Flight: What's America's most popular meat? It's Poultry. Americans consume more than 112 pounds per person each year. Today Steven prepares an astonishing array of grilled poultry from brandy brined rotisserie chicken to duck legs flame roasted Peking-style. And with a special guest a Project Fire first: turkey "ribs"-found in St. Louis, and virtually nowhere else.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Budapest
programme.desc: The largest indoor market in Budapest is also the most elegant in Europe! Spanning over three levels, the impressive central food market is long recognized as a marvel. Whether it be the freshest fish, the richest goose liver, or the sweetest paprika that you're looking for, you'll find it. But don't forget the basement: this is where you will find the very best pickled cabbage in the country!

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Valencia
programme.desc: Perhaps one of the most beautiful and well-organized food market buildings in Europe is the Mercado Central of Valencia. Built on the area where an open-air market stood for centuries, the Valencian style Art Noveau construction is a 'Cathederal of senses'.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Garden
programme.desc: Georgia brings us into her garden and teaches us about small space gardening, container gardening, and how to make the most of the land around you, no matter your constraints. Along the way she talks with community leaders on what it takes to compost and start a community garden. Georgia also takes us back to her kitchen to share some of her favorite garden recipes.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Wild
programme.desc: Join Georgia on an urban foraging expedition and learn from an edible and medicinal plants expert as he and Georgia collect a variety of items during a walk through the neighborhood. From flower studded ice cubes, to honeysuckle tea, to dandelion green salad, Georgia is making the most of what is around her.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Go West, Young Woman
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Entertaining at Home
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Artisans of Charleston
programme.desc: Georgia is in Charleston, South Carolina where she is preparing a dinner at historic Fenwick Hall. She invites a legendary queen of Southern cooking to come by and teach her the secret to her two ingredient biscuits, learns a Nigerian inspired cocktail from a local sommelier, and heads out on the water to harvest oysters. Georgia also shares her tips for setting a southern outdoor table.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Traditions in Tuscany
programme.desc: Georgia visits Tuscany to get back to her own roots, and learn about the generations of families who are carrying on their family's traditions, some for centuries. She goes truffle hunting, learns to make fresh pasta, how to taste wine, and samples the incredible cheeses from the sheep grazing in front of her - experiencing the true value in living off the land.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art
programme.desc: Georgia brings the audience into the kitchen with her to share delicious garden to table recipes. Along the way she pays a visit to an artisan beeswax candle maker who teaches her the art of candle making. Georgia then goes to sit at the pottery wheel with a gifted ceramicist to create candle holders and elements for a table setting.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Earth, Women, Fire
programme.desc: In preparation for a dinner party, Georgia searches for wild edibles in unlikely places, and pays a visit to a pair of women glass blowers who create works of usable art in their glass studio in Brooklyn, New York. They work together to make glass pieces for the dinner table. Georgia brings us back to the kitchen to cook delicious dishes and set a table with their glassware.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Apples
programme.desc: In the orchards of upstate New York, Georgia Pellegrini explores the idea of "uncultivation"--a way of working with nature rather than controlling it. From regenerative apple growing to slow-crafted cider and brandy, she meets makers who transform fruit into something lasting, revealing how time, patience and imperfection shape both flavor and meaning.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Maine
programme.desc: In Maine, Georgia Pellegrini explores the delicate balance between wild ecosystems and the people who steward them. From ancient wild blueberry barrens to regenerative oyster farms and cutting-edge marine research, she follows a network of growers, fishers and scientists working in sync with nature -- revealing how diversity, care and innovation can sustain both food systems and the future.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Uplands
programme.desc: In the Western Catskills, Georgia Pellegrini follows a young couple who return to a childhood home and reimagine it as a regenerative farm. Through soil, animals and shared meals, they rediscover a deeper connection to land and community -- revealing how staying, tending and working with nature can transform both a place and the people who call it home.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Yaupon
programme.desc: In Texas, Georgia Pellegrini traces the story of yaupon -- North America's only native source of caffeine. Once dismissed as a nuisance, this plant reveals a deeper story: of land out of balance, of restoration through stewardship and of Indigenous traditions nearly lost. As farmers, scientists and communities reconnect with yaupon, it becomes a bridge between ecology, culture and renewal.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - East Wind
programme.desc: In the Ozark hills of Missouri, Georgia Pellegrini steps inside East Wind Community -- an egalitarian experiment in shared living. Here, land, labor and resources are held in common, and decisions are made collectively. As she joins daily life and conversation, she explores what it means to build a life rooted in cooperation and a more connected, communal way of living.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Christmas
programme.desc: In a quiet winter landscape, Georgia Pellegrini explores a more thoughtful holiday -- one rooted in simplicity, sustainability and handmade tradition. programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Apples

programme.title: Como un caballero

programme.title: Aldo conoce a la familia
programme.desc: Lety le confiesa a Aldo que soñó con Fernando y lo invita a desayunar; Aldo se da cuenta de que perdió la perla que guardó en su saco; Don Erasmo le reclama a Lety por salir tan temprano de la casa.

programme.title: Aceptado
programme.desc: Fernando y Omar se burlan de la exposición de Aldo; los gerentes aceptan el proyecto gracias a Aldo y Fernando; las del cuartel le muestran a Lety la carta que encontraron.

programme.title: Una mala imitación
programme.desc: Alicia se burla de Tomás porque quiere parecerse a Aldo; Tom le agradece a Aldo que lo haya rescatado por segunda vez y le ofrece su amistad.

programme.title: Guillermo
programme.desc: Guillermo llega a Conceptos a quejarse porque le colgaron el teléfono sin tomarle recado y Alicia se deslinda de la responsabilidad; Aldo presenta a Guillermo en la junta.

programme.title: Enterado
programme.desc: Marcia le pregunta a Carolina qué tan cercana es su relación con Lety; Omar le dice a Fernando que Aldo podría estar enterado de su situación con la actual presidenta de Conceptos.

programme.title: El cuartel en la sala de juntas
programme.desc: Marcia se molesta porque las del cuartel comerán con Lety en la sala de juntas; Paula María tira la fotografía de Lety y Aldo y las del cuartel la ven; Lety se ve obligada a contarles cómo conoció a Aldo.

programme.desc: Luigi piensa que Aldo habla de Ruli y que pronto se le va a declarar: Alicia le dice a Tomás que le suspendieron el celular y él le presta el suyo; Tomás reta a Aldo y lo llama traidor.

programme.title: Peleando por Lety
programme.desc: Fernando y Aldo se pelean por el amor de Lety hasta que Marcia los separa; Lety piensa que Aldo peleó por ella, pero que Fernando solo peleó por defender conceptos.

programme.desc: Ariel cita a Leticia en una dirección y manda a su chofer para recogerla; Tomás le pregunta qué está pasando y Lety le explica que Ariel quiere probar sus aptitudes para ser presidente de Conceptos.

programme.title: No te merezco
programme.desc: Alicia se duerme con el vestido de novia puesto, esperando que se le cumpla el sueño de casarse con Aldo; Lety escribe en su diario que no merece un amor limpio y desinteresado como el de Aldo.

programme.title: Espionaje fallido
programme.desc: Omar se esconde en la oficina de don Erasmo para espiar a Lety con Aldo, pero lo descubren Lety y Ana Paula; las mujeres del cuartel descubren el nuevo teléfono de Alicia.

programme.title: Karla
programme.desc: Marcia le reclama a Fernando las acciones de Omar; Alicia recibe un préstamo muy importante de parte de su mejor amiga; Fernando conoce a una joven hermosa llamada Karla.

programme.desc: Las del cuartel dudan de la explicación de Lety sobre el pleito entre Aldo y Alejandro; Omar y Aldo intercambian celulares en el restaurante sin darse cuenta.

programme.desc: Karla le aconseja a Fernando olvidar a Lety para dejar de sufrir; Omar continúa siguiendo a Lety y a Aldo y ellos lo descubren.

programme.desc: Alicia sigue haciendo cambios en la oficina como presidenta de Conceptos; Lety tiene problemas con Aldo porque no logra olvidar a Fernando.

programme.desc: Bret Maverick goes to Hollow Rock, Wyoming to attend the 4th of July horse race. In the town, he gets swindled in a card game by a corrupt sheriff who has him beaten, robbed, and thrown in jail. Bret's forced to enter the race to get his money back.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Home Is the Brave
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns the body of war hero Cole Prescott to his hometown of White River for a proper burial. However, when Cheyenne arrives, instead of a warm welcome, the townspeople greet him with hate towards the dead man.

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Long Rope
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns to his hometown as Sheriff Bodie. He is seeking a murderer in a town filled with corruption. Being home brings back many memories, including an old feud and a man who organized a lynching when he was a child.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Clarence Bibs Story
programme.desc: Clarence Bibs, a simple-minded man, fancies himself as a gunfighter. While practicing, he falls and his gun fires, killing a famous gunslinger. The man's partner comes to town wanting revenge.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Score Is Even
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark go on a hunting trip and soon become witnesses to a robbery and murder. Lucas subdues the two robbers, but is severely wounded in the process. Lucas struggles to get the robbers to justice, but devises a plan just in the nick of time.

programme.title: Maverick - Poker Face
programme.desc: Mexican bandits hold up a stagecoach carrying Bart Maverick and a group of passengers who detest gamblers. Bart realizes their plight and schemes up a way to save their lives and win $70,000 by challenging the leader to a high-stakes poker game.

programme.title: Kansas Pacific
programme.desc: With talks of a Civil War brewing, Southern saboteurs know they must keep Northern forces from using the U.S. train system. They devise a daring and dangerous plan to stop and capture a railroad engine, preventing the completion of a railroad line.

programme.title: The Tall Tales of Jim Bridger - A Shard of Glass
programme.desc: Haunted by the memory of leaving a man to die, mountain man Jim Bridger is determined not to repeat the mistake. When his trapping party runs out of water while crossing a barren desert, Bridger struggles desperately to keep his companions alive.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Trade
programme.desc: Outlaw Sam Morley, an old friend, comes to the McCain Ranch. He asks Lucas to turn in him for the $500 reward and use the money to pay for his girlfriend's medical care. However, a bounty hunter has other ideas.

programme.title: The Rifleman - One Went to Denver

programme.desc: Just released from prison, Dan Maury comes to North Fork in search of Marshal Micah Torrance, who helped get him locked up. Torrance carries a shotgun everywhere he goes, but Maury plans to wait him out.

programme.title: Colors
programme.desc: As members of the Los Angeles Police Department's elite anti-gang unit, a seasoned cop (Robert Duvall) and his new partner (Sean Penn) are called in to assist with the crackdown against the mounting gang violence in the slums of East Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Mod Squad
programme.desc: Three problem teens headed to jail...until a police captain offers them a deal to work for him and go undercover in the hip L.A. club scene.

programme.title: The Devil's Brigade
programme.desc: They were misfits... and heroes! William Holden stars as Lt. Col. Robert T. Frederick who takes on the daunting task of melding a renegade group of American and Canadian recruits into a crack team of commando warriors in this riveting WWII saga.

programme.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
programme.desc: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Chrome And Hot Leather
programme.desc: Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

programme.title: The Born Losers
programme.desc: When a vicious motorcycle gang launches an assault on a small town and a local girl (Elizabeth James), Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) goes on a one-man crusade to save the town and the girl! The first of the wildly successful Billy Jack feature films.

programme.title: The Glory Stompers
programme.desc: When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.

programme.title: The Wild Angels
programme.desc: When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this genre collision of biker, heist, buddy flick and sci-fi pic!

programme.title: Lone Wolf Mcquade
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.

programme.title: Code Of Silence
programme.desc: Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage...and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents' brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

programme.title: Bloodsport
programme.desc: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

programme.title: RoboCop (2014)
programme.desc: When Alex Murphy is critically injured, OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

programme.title: Walking Tall (2004)
programme.desc: When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!

programme.title: Walking Tall: The Payback
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!

programme.title: Firewalker
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker!
programme.desc: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Anti-Trust
programme.desc: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.
