Sabrina has a blast at first but misses her pals.

programme.title: Endless Night, Part Two
programme.desc: The Nekross plunge Tom's world into a total eclipse, and make their demands to wizardkind - surrender, or the entire human race will suffer!

programme.title: Witchmas Carole
programme.desc: It's Christmas time and Gem's selfish antics are driving everyone mad! Sabrina and her family conspire to show her the error of her ways by giving her a Christmas Carole type visit. After Salem, Hilda, Zelda and Sabrina visit her, Gem is still her nasty little self. It isn't until Quigley & Sabrina show up at Gem's house with a gift as a true act of kindness that Gem is moved. Even if it's only for five minutes!

programme.title: Simply Simon
programme.desc: The girls are on the run from Sheriff Snarf's ogre deputies when the come upon the perfect way to sneak into "King" Simon's castle.

programme.title: My Magic Pet Morphle - Mila and Morphle's Magical Christmas
programme.desc: My Magic Pet Morphle' is an animated hit tv show for toddlers and older kids. Morphle can morph into anything his human companion Mila wants. From dinosaurs to cars, construction vehicles like diggers, dump trucks and cranes to pets like cats dogs and lions!

programme.title: Once Upon a Whine
programme.desc: After ignoring an important household rule, Sabrina finds that she has caused Cinderella to appear in Greendale. She discovers that Cindy is a whiney, lazy, jerk. When Sabrina tries to send Cindy back she accidentally sends Harvey to fairy tale land! She must return Cinderella back to where she belongs and retrieve Harvey before her family finds out she didn't follow the rules.

programme.title: A Tail of Two Kitties
programme.desc: Salem falls for a fellow feline. He learns that she is a kitty-witch as well. They fall in love and want to run off together. But Salem must decide if he wants to reverse his curse and become human again or stay with the Spellmans.

programme.title: Strange New World
programme.desc: Sabrina is on the fast track to losing the Science Fair. She decides to get a little help....by conjuring up a young Thomas Edison. At first Tom is a pro at helping Sabrina until things start to disappear! Sabrina learns that with Tom gone from his place in time, the things he created don't exist. She must get Tom back in time before Tom is stuck in Greendale forever! And technology goes back to a time with no movies, video games or Eep! A mall!

programme.title: The Secret of Room 12, Part One
programme.desc: Benny and Tom are perplexed by the odd reactions of their teacher Mr Fisher and their classmates after visiting Room 12, a seemingly ordinary photo-copying room

programme.title: Molar Molar
programme.desc: It's time for Sabrina's wisdom teeth to come out. She doesn't want to experience it the mortal way so she opts to have them removed magically and pain free. Once the teeth are gone so is her wisdom. She alienates her friends by telling them what is really on her mind endangers herself by not thinking smart. She must get her teeth back before her smarts are gone for good! One teeny problem: Spookie is on vacation and she must find him so he can reverse the spell.

programme.title: Stone Broke
programme.desc: Gem's family has suddenly gone bankrupt and she is forced to stay with Sabrina. The fact that Gem is broke does not sink in at first and she bosses Sabrina around. Gem soon discovers that Sabrina is her only friend and she relies on Sabrina to show her the ropes. Sabrina is so annoyed by Gem that she tries to cast a spell that will make Gem rich again. But Gem inadvertently throws a wrench in each of Sabrina's spells. Gem learns she likes doing things for herself and feeling independent.

programme.title: The Quantum Effect, Part One
programme.desc: Wizard Eva Starling alerts Ursula to a huge crater in the woods and believes that hostile magical beings are trying to slip through from the Netherside.

programme.title: The Dating Game
programme.desc: When Jasper decides to have a party, Topaz is left Trolled over by the love train and will do anything for an invite. In an effort to win him over, Topaz uses spells to first change herself then accidentally changes Jasper into a sneaky geek. As per Cinderella rules, the BFFL have 'til midnight to change Jasper back into Topaz's sweetie-pumpkin-- but can they escape detention first? ?

programme.title: The Cave of Menla-Gto, Part One
programme.desc: Tom is hurt in a magical accident. While his entire family journeys to Tibet in search of a cure, Benny and Moon stand alone, to face the greatest Nekross attack yet.

programme.title: The Key of Bones, Part Two
programme.desc: The humans and aliens are met by the Quest Master, who takes them to an old castle where they must follow clues to find the key of bones.

programme.title: Shrink to Fit
programme.desc: Sabrina and Chloe try to compete with Gem by fitting into the latest fad jeans. After sneaking a spell from the Spookie Jar, they not only get their wish by fitting into the jeans but they begin to shrink as well. The more Sabrina shrinks, her power shrinks as well. Sabrina and Chloe must reverse the effects of the spell before they stay that way FOREVER!

programme.title: The Curse of Crowe, Part Two
programme.desc: Tom and Benny suffer from Gemma Raven's curse - they hate each other, without knowing why. But can friendship overcome the darkest powers of magic?

programme.title: Krakatrolla Needs Some Java
programme.desc: The BFFL have a problem: Not only is their vacation time winding down but so is their patience! As the girls lose all control of their temper, their anger causes the eruption of Mt. Krakatrolla. Having wasted their magic fighting, the girls must combine what's left to put the volcano to rest. The girls escape with bad hair but at least they'll be alive long enough to fix it

programme.title: My Magic Pet Morphle - Magical World of Mila and Morphle
programme.desc: My Magic Pet Morphle' is an animated hit tv show for toddlers and older kids. Morphle can morph into anything his human companion Mila wants. From dinosaurs to cars, construction vehicles like diggers, dump trucks and cranes to pets like cats dogs and lions!

programme.title: Fall of the Nekross, Part Two
programme.desc: Time is running out for the Nekross. But if helping Benny means saving his enemy, what choice will Tom make?

programme.title: Surf Monster A-Go-Go
programme.desc: Now that Simon is gone, it's time to have some fun in the sun! Surfs up! But when some local surfing studs take the BFFL out to sea, they encounter a sea monster that would make Jaws tremble. To turn off the stirred-up, monster-making magic and prove she's not afraid to help (or swim), Sapphire must follow her new Ogre friend to the secret cove of the sea monster and save her friends.

programme.title: Key to My Heart
programme.desc: Sabrina has a crush on Dave, her new piano instructor. She is devastated when she learns that he already has a lady in his life, Melinda. Sabrina is so jealous that she casts a spell to hurt Melinda's career so Dave can focus on her. It isn't until Dave abandons his own dreams to help Melinda does Sabrina realize what she has done. Sabrina has to give up something important to her in order to restore things to normal.

programme.title: Friend or Foe, Part Two
programme.desc: With Tom and Lexi held prisoner by Gaunt, the wizards and aliens must learn to work together - but is the alliance doomed to fail?

programme.title: Field of Screams
programme.desc: Sabrina's baseball team is on a major losing streak. And Gem is there to point it out. Sabrina conjures up the perfect team. Well almost perfect...they are monsters from the Netherworld. They bring Sabrina's team around and make them the champs! In doing so, they have benched Sabrina's team including Sabrina. In fact, they want to take over Greendale!

programme.title: Witchery Science Theater
programme.desc: After Sabrina gets a bad haircut she is ashamed to be seen. She convinces Chloe and Harvey to go to the movies with her so she can hide. The kids are bummed when tickets to the new hit movie, Submarine II has been sold out. They decide to buy tickets for the other movie instead then sneak into the sold out hit. Just when the kids are seconds away from being busted by the uptight theater usher, Sabrina screws up a spell and they wind up IN the movie.

programme.title: Hexcalibur
programme.desc: Sabrina needs help on a Netherworld term paper. She sneaks into Zelda's prize possessions to look at a journal written by the famous Wizard, Merlin. But the fragile book crumbles upon Sabrina touch. She goes back in time to visit the famous wizard in hopes of getting another copy and replacing it before Zelda finds out. But she and Salem go back a little too far and wind up in a time when Merlin and Arthur are the same age as Sabrina.

programme.title: Board and Sorcery
programme.desc: The Spellman's take a trip to the mountains, with Hilda and Zelda skiing, Quigley ice-skating and Sabrina and Harvey snowboarding a good time is had by all! That is until Quigley runs over a celebrated Ice Capades character and has to fill in for him and Harvey is challenged to a race by Slugloaf! Sabrina casts a spell to make Harvey One with the snow and instead of becoming an awesome boarder he becomes a snowman!

programme.title: Brina Baby
programme.desc: Sabrina's abuses her magic one too may times and Quigley is not pleased. He warns her of the consequences of goofing off. Sabrina, not wanting to be a failure in adulthood, swears off magic altogether! Suddenly, strange things start happening around the house. The whole family is shocked when they discover that Sabrina's inner witchlet is the culprit.

programme.title: Twilight Falls, Part Two
programme.desc: Using the Chamber of Crowe as his gateway, Warlock threatens to break down the Line of Twilight and take his revenge on the Dayside once and for all

programme.title: The Last Day, Part One
programme.desc: While the Nekross advance their Master Plan, Tom sees someone from his past, and his entire life will never be the same again...

programme.title: Fall of the Nekross, Part One
programme.desc: Benny launches an attack on the Nekross ship - a plan which has terrifying consequences for both wizards and aliens alike.

programme.title: Most Dangerous Witch
programme.desc: Tim the Witchsmeller is a disgruntled half witch who can perform no magic, and boy is he bitter. He's come to Greendale to trap some witches, namely Hilda & Zelda for his trophy collection. Harvey is mistaken for a witch and is captured by the villainous Tim. Sabrina must save Harvey before he winds up being in Tim's clutches for the rest of his life.

programme.title: The Daughters of Stone, Part One
programme.desc: School-friend Katie seeks Tom's help after her grandfather Gilbert has encountered an ugly witch in the deserted theatre he is trying to restore

programme.title: When Good Girlz Go Bad
programme.desc: When the rest of the BFFL gets rude and rowdy, Ruby becomes suspicious. What could make the girls turn their classmates into chimps? What could make them cast a spell on the principal? What could make them brainwash Trollzopolis? ? SIMON . Apparently the evil hypnotic cookies Simon fed them at Mystic Fallz weren't duds after all, just a time release, and time is up for Trollzopolis .

programme.title: Working Witches
programme.desc: Hilda and Zelda want a car, and need some cash fast! Quigley explains that they need to get a good old-fashioned job. They reluctantly work at the local fast food joint, but trouble brews when Hilda gets promoted for Zelda's hard efforts. The success goes to Hilda's head and she has to hit bottom before she realizes how much she needs her sister and the importance of teamwork.

programme.title: Dawn of the Nekross, Two
programme.desc: With his Gran trapped, Tom and Benny must dare to go inside the mystical Chamber, to ask the mysterious Randal Moon for help.

programme.title: Truth or Scare
programme.desc: Sabrina and her classmates go on a camping adventure! Her Uncle Quigley is acting chaperone. Gem uses this opportunity to get to Sabrina by daring her to play a prank on her sweet Uncle. Sabrina does it to save face but feels horrible all the while. The tennis match of pranks goes on until Harvey is in danger. Sabrina realizes that dares are stupid and people only end up getting hurt.

programme.title: All Out War, Part One
programme.desc: On the eve of war, Tom is visited by a wizard family who claim to have found the most powerful object on the planet - the Source of All Magic!

programme.title: My Magic Pet Morphle - Mila And Morphles Awesome Adventures
programme.desc: My Magic Pet Morphle' is an animated hit tv show for toddlers and older kids. Morphle can morph into anything his human companion Mila wants. From dinosaurs to cars, construction vehicles like diggers, dump trucks and cranes to pets like cats dogs and lions!

programme.title: What Becomes of the Broken Hearted?
programme.desc: Sabrina is disappointed at not being picked to go on a field trip by her favorite teacher. Salem steers her to the mysterious Wise Warlock. (okay, so he just helps to earn frequent flyer points) The Warlock tells Sabrina that she suffers from a broken heart. Duh! She knew that already. So the Wise Warlock sends her on a quest to find someone who has never had a broken heart.

programme.title: The Thirteenth Floor, Part One
programme.desc: Tom Clarke faces his greatest challenge yet, when a mysterious elevator takes him to Floor 13 - a destination far beyond this world.

programme.title: Wiccan of the Sea
programme.desc: Sabrina is just sick of the winter weather. She, Chloe and Salem would give anything for one hour at the beach. Sabrina dabbles in the Spookie jar and off they go. When they get to the beach they realize they have been transformed, Sabrina and Chloe are mermaids and Salem is a catfish! They get swept away at sea and are captured by Queen Stingy. They must escape and return to the island in order to return home!

programme.title: My Magic Pet Morphle - Mila and Morphle's Magical Friendship
programme.desc: My Magic Pet Morphle' is an animated hit tv show for toddlers and older kids. Morphle can morph into anything his human companion Mila wants. From dinosaurs to cars, construction vehicles like diggers, dump trucks and cranes to pets like cats dogs and lions!

programme.title: Dawn of the Nekross, One
programme.desc: Tom Clarke is hiding a secret - he's a schoolboy wizard! But when the alien Nekross arrive on Earth, a battle for survival begins...

programme.title: All Out War, Part Two
programme.desc: Worlds collide as Earth becomes a battleground in an intergalactic war. Tom and Benny must risk everything to help Varg and Lexi, and stop Kooth's apocalyptic plan.

programme.title: The Bat Pack
programme.desc: Hilda's is not pleased when her old vampire buddies, The Bat Pack, swoop into town for a visit. But Sabrina is dazzled by their charming ways. She and Salem are smooth-talked into following them to the Netherworld. Once there, they learn that Fang, Hemo and Clammy need their help pulling off an Ocean's Eleven-type Blood Bank heist! Hilda and Zelda show up just in time to take the blame! And when the Aunts are about to receive their punishment, the Bat Pack step in to fess' up!

programme.title: Enchanted Vacation
programme.desc: It's summer vacation. So many places to see...But Hilda wants the gang to go on an Adventure Tour in the Netherworld. They leave just in time because Tim the Witchsmeller is back and wants revenge! Tim discovers where they went and is on their tail. The vacation is teaching the family to cooperate, something they have a hard time doing. They're going to need to pull together because Tim has a new morphing machine and he uses it to turn each member of the family against one another.

programme.title: Endless Night, Part One
programme.desc: On the advent of an eclipse, the Nekross activate their magnificent master plan - to control the moon's orbit and bring everlasting night to Earth!

programme.title: Witchwrecked
programme.desc: It is field trip time as Sabrina's class heads toward Monument Island where an important statue is kept. The class is disappointed to have chaperones and worse yet, to write a paper on it. UHGG! Sabrina decides to take matters into her own hands by kicking up a small sea storm. The storm gets outta control and they are shipwrecked on a remote island (in the Bermuda Triangle). They are in trouble when Sabrina discovers her magic won't work.

programme.title: 100 Wizards, Part Two
programme.desc: With 100 wizards trapped in the Nekross King's evil scheme, Tom, Benny and new wizard Chloe must unite to fight the enemy. But with the Zarantulus on its way to Earth, time is running out.

programme.title: Scare Apparent
programme.desc: Boogey Jr. (son of the legendary Boogey man) pays a visit to Sabrina and Salem. At first they are startled, and then become sympathetic when they learn that he is afraid of his own shadow! Boogey Jr. is not living up to his father's frightful expectations. Sabrina helps Boogey to face his fears! Now Boogey Jr. must confront father and tell him he doesn't want to follow in his footsteps but instead he wants to be an accountant.

programme.title: Send in the Clones
programme.desc: Sabrina goes hog wild at the Greendale JR. High Extracurricular Activities Faire. Against the advice of family and friends, Sabrina boasts she can do it all! Sabrina soon finds that she cannot keep up the pace. But if there were more of her she could. So she does what any 12- year old witch would do....she clones her self, twice. Now with three Sabrina's she can do anything she wishes....or can she?

programme.title: Vice Versa, Part One
programme.desc: When Tom and Benny meet a mysterious Hobbledehoy, the boys find themselves rearranged! Benny now has magical powers, while Tom becomes a schoolboy genius.

programme.title: Generation Hex
programme.desc: Sabrina is on a quest to raise the most amount of money for the Library fund. She does and even earns a little extra. Sabrina gets sidetracked while eyeing a vintage collectable doll in a store window. She takes the extra earnings and splurges on herself. Why not? She earned it? That night the doll comes to life and shows her the error of her ways. Sabrina learns that because of her, her friends and family's lives have been ruined!

programme.title: Into the Woodz
programme.desc: Their racing days finally catch up with them and the BFFL have to face their hardest enemy yet, the law! After fulfilling their punishment at the Old Trollz Home, old troll Fossil lets the girls off for good behavior. To thank him, the BFFL fight past mud monsters and stone ogres in the Haunted Woodz for Fossil's old toy Gobby.

programme.title: Troll Fast, Troll Furious
programme.desc: Sapphire falls hair over heels for Mica, a skootz-racing senior. Blinded by his good looks (and maybe his racing lights) Sapphire doesn't realize she's just being used to help Mica build a super-skoot! The BFFL come to rescue Sapphire from the fast crowd -literally- but it's not until a narrow escape from Officer Irons that she comes to her senses...

programme.title: Le Femme Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina uses her magic to conjure up an advance copy of the latest Spy flick to make Harvey happy. But instead of getting the movie the spell throws herself and Harvey into the spy world. They must fight the evil Furfinger (Salem) and stop him from stealing everyone's thumbs in order for the spell to wear off!

programme.title: Ruby's Rules of Partying
programme.desc: While the BFFL are busy trying to follow Ruby's party rules, Snarf - disguised as cute troll Gravel - crashes Jasper's party. Someone tell Snarf it's not a costume party. Going goo-goo for Gravel, Ruby splits up the group, a perfect chance for Simon to make a guest appearance The girlz need to kiss and make-up if they ever want to get back to the party, NO SIMONS ALLOWED.

programme.title: The Quantum Effect, Part Two
programme.desc: As Jathro activates the telescope, creating a quantum storm, Varg and Lyzera arrive and take Michael prisoner

programme.title: Paranormal Pi
programme.desc: When Pi sees Sabrina's Uncle Zamboni flying through the air he is convinced there are paranormal rumblings in Greendale. He makes it his mission to prove it to the townspeople. Sabrina must keep him from finding out her family secret before her uncle turns him into a frog...or worse.

programme.title: Documagicary
programme.desc: Sabrina ends up in a new docu-series called, That Witch which becomes an overnight sensation! Sabrina soon tires of the demanding schedule and lack of privacy. The director won't let her out of her contract, so Sabrina refuses to use magic in hopes that the show will be cancelled. The director retaliates and frees Tim the Witchsmeller knowing the duel will be good for ratings.

programme.title: I Got Glue Babe
programme.desc: Everyone is fed up with Sabrina and Gem's constant rivalry. Sabrina casts a spell to make Gem and herself closer. But she uses too much potion and it causes them to stick together. Being a Siamese twin with Gem is hard at first but when they learn they might stay like that forever, they find a way to work together.

programme.title: Homecoming
programme.desc: It's that special night of the school year: Homecoming. The Trollball game is the main attraction until Simon decides it's his turn to play. Rampaging around with his fire breathing dragon, Simon threatens to totally ruin Homecoming! Topaz must face her fears and team up with feeble, failing Zirconia if she wants to save the day.

programme.title: Best Friends for Life
programme.desc: Amethyst returns from a summer away with a surprise: her gem got its glow! She can cast spells now like the rest of her friends. But when crew "leader" Ruby is upstaged by Amethyst, she gets angry gives Amethyst the boot from the group. The remaining BFFL take it upon themselves to scare the feuding friends back together - by turning Topaz into an ogre.

programme.title: The Importance of Being Norma
programme.desc: Sabrina tries to win a spot on the cheerleading squad before Gem. Her only requirement; she must impress the incredibly snobby cheerleaders all week long. Unfortunately, it happens to be the same week that she must guide her old friend Norma Alphalinear, around school. Yikes! Norma's a total geek! So Sabrina casts a spell to make Norma cool but instead everyone wants to be like Norma.

programme.title: Anywhere But Here
programme.desc: Sabrina is tired of the restrictions that come with being a kid. She casts a spell that catapults into adulthood. She loves the freedom at first but them shirks at the responsibility that comes with being an adult. Sabrina must reverse the spell before she is stuck in adulthood and misses out on being a kid!

programme.title: My Magic Pet Morphle - Building with Morphle
programme.desc: My Magic Pet Morphle' is an animated hit tv show for toddlers and older kids. Morphle can morph into anything his human companion Mila wants. From dinosaurs to cars, construction vehicles like diggers, dump trucks and cranes to pets like cats dogs and lions!

programme.title: The Great Race
programme.desc: Like a fly they just can't swat, menacing Mica returns and demands to have a skootz-race rematch. After the BFFL put Onyx through training to rival Rocky Balboa's, it's race time. On your mark. Engines set. GO! The race runs perfectly, and Onyx is in the lead, but when things get dangerous for Mica, will Onyx go for gold or put pride aside to save Mica from a macabre make-over?

programme.title: Grazlax Attacks, Part One
programme.desc: Tom's quiet Saturday at Benny's house becomes a thrilling fight for their lives when the vicious alien Grazlax hunts them down.

programme.title: Upside Down Town
programme.desc: Sabrina uses a little dash of mojo to win a bake off contest against Gem. Unfortunately whoever eats her upside down cake has their personality reversed. Sabrina has to find an antidote before Greendale is ruined!

programme.title: Invasion
programme.desc: Four years have passed, but the people grow concerned that Ragnar (Travis Fimmel) has become complacent. So, the time has come for a new raid.

programme.title: Treachery
programme.desc: The brutal Wessex Viking raid is in full swing and King Ecbert (Linus Roache) finds himself facing an entirely new kind of foe.

programme.title: Eye For An Eye
programme.desc: A meeting between two great men may pave the way for future compromise as Ragnar (Travis Fimmel) and King Ecbert (Linus Roache) come face to face.

programme.title: Answers In Blood
programme.desc: Lagertha (Katheryn Winnick) and Ragnar (Travis Fimmel) unite once again and together fight to win Kattegat back from the iron fist of Jarl Borg.

programme.title: Unforgiven
programme.desc: King Horik returns to Kattegat with a surprising proposition for Ragnar. Lagertha runs into a less-than-enthusiastic homecoming from her new husband.

programme.title: Blood Eagle
programme.desc: Ragnar and King Horik clash over how to dispense justice to Jarl Borg. In Wessex, King Aelle arrives and Ecbert has an eye on a new alliance.

programme.title: Boneless
programme.desc: Princess Aslaug's latest prophecy comes to fruition as she readies to give birth, and Ragnar, King Horik and their new ally set sail for Wessex .

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Ragnar's (Travis Fimmel) Viking warriors march on to King Ecbert's (Linus Roache) villa and are met with a surprisingly vicious welcome party.

programme.title: The Lord's Prayer
programme.desc: In the season finale, Ragnar (Travis Fimmel) and King Horik (Donal Logue) return to Kattegat and the final showdown between two leaders is at hand!

programme.title: Brother's War
programme.desc: In the season 2 premiere, the battle begins between Ragnar and King Horik's forces against Jarl Borg in a battle which pits brother against brother.

programme.desc: Ragnar and King Horik clash over how to dispense justice to Jarl Borg. In Wessex, King Aelle arrives and Ecbert has an eye on a new alliance.

programme.title: Boneless
programme.desc: Princess Aslaug's latest prophecy comes to fruition as she readies to give birth, and Ragnar, King Horik and their new ally set sail for Wessex .

programme.title: The Choice
programme.desc: Ragnar's (Travis Fimmel) Viking warriors march on to King Ecbert's (Linus Roache) villa and are met with a surprisingly vicious welcome party.

programme.title: The Lord's Prayer
programme.desc: In the season finale, Ragnar (Travis Fimmel) and King Horik (Donal Logue) return to Kattegat and the final showdown between two leaders is at hand!

programme.title: Brother's War

programme.title: Treachery

programme.title: Treachery
programme.desc: The brutal Wessex Viking raid is in full swing and King Ecbert (Linus Roache) finds himself facing an entirely new kind of foe.

programme.title: Episode 518
programme.desc: Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

programme.title: Episode 519
programme.desc: Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

programme.title: Episode 520
programme.desc: Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

programme.title: Episode 521
programme.desc: After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

programme.title: Episode 522
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.title: Episode 523
programme.desc: Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

programme.title: Episode 524
programme.desc: When Lisa's Uncle Fedor comes to visit her at the farm, he is visibly upset. He claims that someone is following him. Indeed, Fedor is convinced that the Secret Police are out to steal back a valuable scientific formula, which only he knows.

programme.title: Episode 525
programme.desc: When Eb places an ad in a magazine claiming to be a wealthy landowner, it catches the eye of a young socialite. When the young woman makes an unexpected visit to Hooterville, Eb is forced to keep up his ruse.

programme.title: Happy Birthday
programme.desc: Oliver is upset when he finds out Arnold the pig and he share the same birthday. Jealous that Arnold is getting more attention than he is, Oliver becomes convinced that Lisa is throwing him a surprise party and drives all over town in search for it.

programme.title: Episode 601
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa play host to four children from the city, who find themselves in Hooterville as part of a rural exposure program. The kids learn how to milk the cow, pick vegetables, plant seeds, and share sleeping quarters with four-legged friends.

programme.title: The Coming Out Party
programme.desc: Little Lori Baker, who after coming to stay with the Douglases on a rural experience program, is staying on at the Douglas farm. This city girl, like Oliver, has found that she loves the country life! Lisa decides to throw Lori a welcome party.

programme.title: Episode 605
programme.desc: Lisa tells a rather fanciful version of how she met and fell in love with Oliver. The Douglases' house guest, little Lori Baker from the city, is all ears. The tale begins with how Lisa's father, the king, was exiled, causing Lisa to flee to Paris.

programme.title: Episode 606
programme.desc: The residents of Hooterville assume that Oliver Douglas must be broke when Lisa is spotted looking for work and standing in line at the soup kitchen. But assumptions in this town, even logical ones, are bound to be wrong.

programme.title: Episode 607
programme.desc: There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

programme.title: Episode 608
programme.desc: Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

programme.title: Episode 609
programme.desc: Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

programme.title: Episode 610
programme.desc: Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

programme.title: Episode 611
programme.desc: Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

programme.title: Episode 612
programme.desc: After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

programme.title: Episode 613
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

programme.title: Episode 614
programme.desc: Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

programme.title: Episode 615
programme.desc: The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

programme.title: Episode 616
programme.desc: Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

programme.title: Episode 617
programme.desc: Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

programme.title: Episode 618
programme.desc: While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

programme.title: A Girl For Drobny
programme.desc: Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

programme.title: Episode 622
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

programme.title: Episode 624
programme.desc: When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

programme.title: Episode 625
programme.desc: Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

programme.title: The Ex-Secretary
programme.desc: Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.

programme.title: Episode 101
programme.desc: In this classic series' premiere episode, New York City attorney Oliver Wendell Douglas (Eddie Albert) satisfies his desire for the simple life by buying a farm, much to the chagrin of his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor). John Charles Daly narrates the tale!

programme.title: Episode 102
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) brings his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor), to their new home, a ramshackle farm near Hooterville, just outside of Pixley, where she gets to meet the town's oddball residents. Bea Benaderet, Edgar Buchanan and Frank Cady guest star!

programme.title: Episode 103
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

programme.title: Episode 104
programme.desc: Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

programme.title: Episode 105
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

programme.title: Episode 106
programme.desc: The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

programme.title: Episode 107
programme.desc: Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

programme.title: Episode 108
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) sends a sample of his soil to the State Scientific College, a report comes back that his farm contains ingredients never before found in soil. Could his soil problems just be cosmetic? Eleanor Audley guest stars.

programme.title: Episode 109
programme.desc: Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best cropMrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

programme.title: Episode 110
programme.desc: After some wheeling and dealing and mending a riff between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.

programme.title: Episode 111
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheatbecause of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Episode 112
programme.desc: The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

programme.title: Episode 113
programme.desc: It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

programme.title: Episode 114
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

programme.title: Episode 116
programme.desc: When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

programme.title: Episode 117
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

programme.title: Episode 118
programme.desc: Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

programme.title: Episode 120
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s apple crop is ready to be harvested, and he decides to take them to market himself and make a killing. Of course, getting to market before the price drops proves a little more difficult than Oliver anticipates.

programme.title: Episode 121
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

programme.title: Episode 122
programme.desc: Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

programme.title: Episode 124
programme.desc: Sam Drucker (Frank Cady) is leaving on a much-needed two-week vacation and talks Oliver (Eddie Albert) into assuming his duties as deputy sheriff. But Oliver soon learns enforcing the law isn't quite as easy as it looks.

programme.title: Episode 126
programme.desc: Whatever you do, don't say her name and especially while playing checkers down at Drucker's! An old hag named Molly Turgiss (Renie Riano), who died twenty years before the Douglases (Eddie Albert, Eva Gabor) came to town, might be haunting them.

programme.title: Episode 127
programme.desc: It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get himuntil the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

programme.title: Episode 128
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Eb (Tom Lester) has a way with sick animals after Eb cures Arnold, the pig, and Alice, the chicken, and offers to put him through veterinary college. But will life in Green Acres ever be the same without Ed?!

programme.title: Episode 129
programme.desc: A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining thingsand as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

programme.title: Episode 130
programme.desc: Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rainor lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

programme.title: Episode 131
programme.desc: The Third-Tuesday-of-Every-Month-Culture-Committee of the Every-Other-Wednesday-Afternoon-Discussion-Club decides that Hooterville needs some "culture" in the form of a symphony orchestra. And Lisa (Eva Gabor) may just know the perfect conductor.

programme.title: Episode 132
programme.desc: Oliver's (Eddie Albert) nephew Charles (Don Edmonds) arrives for a visit, and Oliver is completely shaken up when the boy turns out to be a long-haired, motorcycle-ridin', hippy-dippy type. But, boy, does he know a thing or two about engines.

programme.title: Episode 201
programme.desc: Oliver dreams of entering his crop in the Corn Festival, but the dreaded "Bing Bug" invades Hooterville's farms. After learning of his service as a WWII pilot, the locals volunteer him for the perilous task of flying the town's only crop duster.

programme.title: Episode 204
programme.desc: When a lovely, young and successful farmer comes to Oliver (Eddie Albert) for his legal counsel, Lisa (Eva Gabor) quickly becomes jealous of the two spending time together and becomes determined to break up what she sees as a budding romance.

programme.title: Episode 205
programme.desc: When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralphand the barn for Oliver!

programme.title: Episode 206
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) takes to his soap box, delivering fiery, patriotic speeches after getting a bill from the State Farm Unattached Duty Tax for an outrageous $12.03! But no one can figure out why the tax is levied in the first place.

programme.title: Episode 207
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the "real-life" story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

programme.title: Episode 208
programme.desc: Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from "petticoat Junction." Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

programme.title: Episode 209
programme.desc: The locals complain that Oliver's penchant for wearing business suits to do farm work is ruining Hooterville's image. Oliver tries to adjust, but the last laugh is on him when Lisa has her dressmaker design Italian him some swanky new overalls.

programme.title: Episode 210
programme.desc: The Hooterville Chamber of Commerce attempts to attract a Hollywood film studio to shoot a movie in town. And when a rumor spreads that famous actor is arriving, the townsfolk are all abuzz as they prepare for their close-up, Mr. DeMille!

programme.title: Episode 211
programme.desc: Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

programme.title: Episode 212
programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.title: Episode 213
programme.desc: Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

programme.title: Episode 214
programme.desc: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

programme.title: Episode 215
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: Episode 216
programme.desc: When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

programme.title: Episode 217
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is neververy close.

programme.title: Episode 218
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Episode 219
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Episode 220
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Episode 221
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Episode 224
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Episode 225
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his wordeven the Air Forceand soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Episode 227
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But waitdid he even want to?

programme.title: Episode 228
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Episode 229
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hootervilleand she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Episode 230
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Episode 301
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Episode 302
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Episode 304
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Episode 305
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Episode 306
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Episode 307
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Episode 308
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Episode 309
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Episode 310
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Episode 312
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Episode 313
programme.desc: Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

programme.title: Episode 314
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Episode 315
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Episode 316
programme.desc: After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc stood him up at the alter on their big day.

programme.title: Episode 317
programme.desc: Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programme.title: Episode 319
programme.desc: Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

programme.title: Episode 320
programme.desc: Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

programme.title: Flight To Nowhere
programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Episode 322
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Episode 323
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Episode 324
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Episode 325
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Episode 326
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Episode 327
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Episode 329
programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Episode 330
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

programme.title: Episode 401
programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Episode 402
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.title: Episode 403
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

programme.title: Episode 404
programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.title: Episode 405
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Episode 406
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Episode 407
programme.desc: Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

programme.title: Episode 408
programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.title: Episode 409
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Episode 410
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: The Blue Feather
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Episode 414
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programme.title: Episode 416
programme.desc: All that glitters is not frosted cereal. After a jewelry heist in Chicago, the robbers foolishly stash their booty in the grain bin of a cereal manufacturer. Oliver and Lisa discover the jewels in their bowl of Crickly Wickly!

programme.title: Episode 417
programme.desc: Oliver Wendell Douglas returns from farm to firm... law firm, that is. When a young and ambitious local graduates from law school, he looks for a potential partner in Hooterville. Oliver is the logical choice. Lisa and Eb help the new venture.

programme.title: Episode 418
programme.desc: After partnering with a young, local lawyer, Oliver has opened a new law office in Hooterville. However, their secretary, Lisa, shows a lack of necessary skills. Soon, Lisa's job is on the line, even if she is married to one of the partners.

programme.title: Episode 419
programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.title: Episode 420
programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: The Rangers save a keystone species. / The Rangers get rid of invasive fire ants.

programme.title: Look Out Lemur
programme.desc: The Rangers save a lemur, and teach Preston Praxton about terraced farming. The Rangers save a lake from invasive zebra mussels.

programme.title: Praxton Island, Inc.
programme.desc: The Rangers deal with issues from artificial islands. The Rangers save a family from lead in their home water supply.

programme.title: Coral Calamity / S'no Problem
programme.desc: The Rangers help to save the New Caledonia Barrier Reef. The Rangers save Patty and Preston from an avalanche.

programme.title: The Tortoise and the Heiress
programme.desc: The Rangers save a tortoise from off-road vehicles. / The Rangers save peatland from fires.

programme.title: The Otter and the Oil
programme.desc: The Rangers have to save an otter from an oil tanker leak, then plug and clean the leak. The Rangers save a pod of orcas.

programme.title: Monkey Business / Lost Panda Cub
programme.desc: Rosie, Lavender and Pepper journey to the Amazon to save a marmoset that Preston Paxton has captured as a pet for his daughter, Patty. The Rangers have to help a lost panda cub get home.

programme.title: A Whale of a Problem
programme.desc: The Rangers rescue a beached whale who has been tormented by sonar waves. The Rangers have to stop a bee colony from collapse.

programme.title: The Earth Needs Their Kelp
programme.desc: The Rangers need to return balance to an ocean environment. / A large iceberg has calved, leaving a floe that's on a collision course for a clan of polar bears.

programme.title: Backyard Bird Feeder
programme.desc: A backyard feeder is too close to a glass window and the Rangers need to find another way to safely feed the birds. When the Rangers jump in to save animals from a forest fire, they jump the gun and accidentally put out a controlled burn.

programme.title: Moo-ving Cows / Panda-monium
programme.desc: The Rangers have to stop Preston Praxton from poisoning a stream with pesticides. / The Rangers work to reunite and relocate a family of pandas when their home environment is destroyed.

programme.title: The Big Dig / Catalog Slog
programme.desc: The Rangers discover Preston Praxton has been causing earthquakes by digging underground. / Preston is sending out big, thick catalogs and they're overflowing landfills.

programme.title: Preston Fest / Snakes on a Plain
programme.desc: Preston throws a music festival that destroys all local vegetation, threatening local wildlife who are now going hungry. / The Rangers help protect the lives of snakes during their migration.

programme.title: Big Gold Superbloom / Batter Up
programme.desc: Wildflowers are being destroyed, causing tomato worms to devour the crops on a nearby farm. / The Rangers need to help bats from colliding with wind turbines.

programme.title: Missed Them by a Hare
programme.desc: Climate change causes snow (the natural camouflage of a family of Snow Hares) to melt prematurely, leaving them vulnerable to predators. / The Rangers have to save a bear cub stuck on the side of a mountain.

programme.title: Marshland Chronicles
programme.desc: A spring morning snowstorm is followed by an abrupt afternoon warm up, causing a flood of melted snow that threatens the local wildlife. / An Otter has lost her favorite rock!

programme.title: Tigertastic / Seal Gone Wild
programme.desc: Preston is destroying mangrove forests in India to create profitable shrimp farms, exposing the area and its wildlife to storms. / The Rangers have to get a lost seal back home after it wreaks havoc on a city.

programme.title: Fly Away / Safari Soulmates
programme.desc: The Praxtons are using helium balloons to try and set a World Record. / In Africa, the symbiotic relationship between ostriches and zebras is threatened when Preston is rounding up ostriches for his own profit.

programme.title: Spooky Costume Party / GMO OMG
programme.desc: The Rangers and Floof help Patty prep for an eco-friendly Spooky Costume Party. / Preston's genetically modified crops are running amuck!

programme.title: Frozen Falls / Got Silk?
programme.desc: The Rangers save turtles trapped on an ice floe when a waterfall freezes over, but their "save" has consequences. / The Rangers save spiders from the Praxtons who are milking them for their silk!

programme.title: Chimney Caper
programme.desc: During the holidays, the Rangers need to remove a raccoon family looking for warmth that gets trapped in Preston's chimney. / Patty smuggles sugar gliders into the country to give as "goodie bags" at her birthday party.

programme.title: The Lost Puppies / Goats in Trees
programme.desc: The Rangers save a lost puppy stuck in a city sewer system. / When Priscilla removes pesky seed-spitting tree goats from her argan orchard, the goats go hungry and her crop diminishes without the goatsAo assistance in regeneration.

programme.title: Bunny-20
programme.desc: When bunnies all over the world start coming down with the same illness, the Rangers must all work together to help two zoologists keep the bunnies safe until a cure is found.

programme.title: Team Rainbow Rangers!
programme.desc: The Rangers have to stop a factory from dying a river rainbow! / The Rangers help a handicapped-duckling fly to catch up with its migrating flock.

programme.title: Whale of a Tale
programme.desc: Heavy boat traffic is disruptive to a migrating whale and her calf and the Rangers need to find a way to keep the whales safe. / The Rangers save a coral reef from being damaged by a reckless construction team.

programme.title: Chimp in the Wild / Shake It
programme.desc: The Rangers see if their chimp friend Ernest is ready to go back to the wild. / After a terrible earthquake, the Rangers must save a group of ducks.

programme.title: Gold in That Thar Moon
programme.desc: Preston's gold mining mission on the moon is endangering gorillas here on Earth. The Rangers must stop him! / The Rangers must save Floof after Preston captures him.

programme.title: Bunny Buddies
programme.desc: The Rangers save pet bunnies that have been let out into the wild. / The Rangers work to solve problems with a palm oil plantation.

programme.title: Teacup Tigers / Glass Warfare
programme.desc: When Preston tries to shrink his own "teacup" tigers to take home to Patty, the Rangers have to stop him and restore the tigers to their proper size! / The Rangers save an entire desert and its inhabitants from Priscilla, who's trying to turn it all into her new glass palace.

programme.title: Who Said Bat
programme.desc: The Rangers need to help bats from colliding with wind turbines. / Pollution from a gold mine threatens the otters in the ocean.

programme.title: Green is the New Black
programme.desc: Preston's fashion line releases microfibers into the ocean, causing environmental problems. / The Rangers go to try to help a bottle-nosed dolphin when it gets a plastic six-pack ring stuck on its nose and mouth.

programme.title: Calling Fowl / Treehouse Trouble
programme.desc: The Rangers discover Preston Praxton is feeding ducks to keep them off his golf course and it's making them sick. / Preston is harvesting trees so Patty can build her massive dream treehouse, and is in turn destroying the forest.

programme.title: Car Wash / Preston's Shipwreck
programme.desc: Preston's washing his car in his orchard and the runoff from the chemicals in the soap is polluting the riverbed and harming animals. / Preston's determination to find treasure in an old pirate shipwreck threatens an inter-marine-species Utopian paradise.

programme.title: Wild Wild Horses
programme.desc: The Rangers step in when Preston's latest get-rich-quick scheme to sell wild mustangs results in a mustang galloping off with Patty. / A man encroaches on a baby elephant who becomes separated from her mother and the Rangers race to reunite them.

programme.title: Scents and Sensibility
programme.desc: Kalia rewards the Rangers with special powers and gifts to thank them for all they do to help the Earth. / Jealous of the Rangers' new scents, Patty demands Preston figure out how she can have a smell, too, and grizzly bear chaos ensues.

programme.title: Croaking In The Rain
programme.desc: When a series of tornadic waterspouts hits Louisiana, an entire pond full of frogs is lifted up and dropped all over the bayou - it's raining frogs! / The Rangers need to help a family of hungry owls who can't tell day from night because of lights from a newly constructed baseball stadium.

programme.title: Glitter Litter
programme.desc: While planning a runway show in front of a picturesque waterfall, Priscilla abuses nature in the name of fashion, so the Rangers need to teach her a lesson. / Preston sneaks into Kaleidoscopia and builds a resort on an exotic island, unknowingly separating two groups of prismacorns and threatening the future of their population.

programme.title: The Cowardly Mountain Lion
programme.desc: The Rangers help a three-legged mountain lion gain access to a more ecologically diverse mountain range. / In the American Southwest, wild burros compete for food with cows from a nearby ranch, and the Rangers need to figure out how to make sure the animals can live in harmony.

programme.title: Why So Crabby?
programme.desc: When the carbon emissions from Preston's oceanfront mansion cause the local lobsters to get cracks in their shells, the Rangers must find a way to help. / While glamping with Preston, Patty Praxton does a gender reveal for her new pony and accidentally causes a forest fire.

programme.title: Peek-a-Boo Beluga
programme.desc: When a beluga whale gets lost and ends up in New England, Preston wants to keep her and won't let the Rangers take her home. The Rangers must stop Priscilla's cheaply made solar-paneled drones which have gone haywire before they overcharge and explode.

programme.title: Tiny Rocket Man
programme.desc: On a quest to figure out how to get back to Kaleidoscopia, Preston sends up a space shuttle piloted by a tiny robot Preston, which loses communication with Earth due to overcrowding of the communication spectrum. / When an algae superbloom stops seagrass from growing in Florida waters, the Rangers must help a hungry manatee and find a solution to this smelly problem.

programme.title: Flying Beavers
programme.desc: When a beavers' dam causes a flood that threatens a nearby town, the Rangers must prevent the disaster and find a safe new place for them to call home. / On Kaleidoscopia, mystery goop is getting stuck on the horns of prismawhals, blocking them from being able to use their horns for good, and the Rangers need to figure out why.

programme.title: Hungry Hungry Hamsters
programme.desc: The Rangers help wild hamsters who are getting sick from a lack of nutrition in their diet. / In Costa Rica, sloths are being shocked by power lines, and the Rangers must find a way to protect this vulnerable species.

programme.title: Ape Escape
programme.desc: When farmland takes over a gibbon habitat in Sumatra, the Rangers help to relocate the animals to more fertile land. / In Russia, the environment is being destroyed by a diamond mine owned by Priscilla Praxton, so the Rangers must help the animals and convince Priscilla to change her ways.

programme.title: Rainbow Floe / Northern Lights
programme.desc: The Rangers save a baby polar bear stranded on an ice floe. / The Rangers lose their Spectra Scooters while helping a seal family and discover the Northern Lights.

programme.title: Tree Hugger / Turtle in a Net
programme.desc: The Rangers have to save a forest from destruction. / The Rangers have to save a turtle caught in a fishing net.

programme.title: When Beetles Bark
programme.desc: The Rangers have to stop bark beetles from destroying a forest. / The Rangers go help a hermit crab and find an island covered in plastic garbage.

programme.title: Monarch Migration
programme.desc: The Rangers help a kaleidoscope of butterflies migrate to their new home in Mexico. / The Rangers try to save a mother horse from a sinkhole... but end up falling in themselves.

programme.title: Rabbit Roundup
programme.desc: The Rangers have to help remove invasive rabbits from a farm in Australia. / The Rangers have to help an Alligator who has lost its home environment.

programme.title: Sludge Stream / The Tsunami
programme.desc: The Rangers have to stop a factory owner from polluting a local stream. / The Rangers have to save Preston and Patty from a tsunami.

programme.title: Duck Duck Oops / Lost Island
programme.desc: The Rangers have to save a duck family from a water disaster. / The Rangers have to save a family of shrews from a sinking island.

programme.title: Divided We Fall
programme.desc: The Rangers have to stop a poacher in Africa. / The Rangers have to save a colony of bats suffering from White Nose Disease.

programme.title: Land Ho / The Strongest Spider
programme.desc: The Rangers discover a brand new volcanic island. / The Rangers need the help of a spider to help a mother duckling and discover a spider with the strongest silk in the world.

programme.title: Flash Flood
programme.desc: The Rangers have to reunite a gorilla family separated by a flash flood. / The Rangers have to save cows from a wildfire.

programme.title: Rangers Raise A Condor
programme.desc: The Rangers have to help Patty Praxton care for an endangered condor after Patty disturbs its home. / The Rangers need to rehome an overpopulation of wild ponies who are destroying their island home.

programme.title: The Case of the Missing Class Pet
programme.desc: The Rangers try to save a missing class pet. / The Rangers must save a farm from crop-raiding elephants.

programme.title: Chimp in Kaleidoscopia
programme.desc: The Rangers try to rescue a chimp by bringing him to Kaleidoscopia. / Rangers have to help a homing pigeon during a solar storm.

programme.title: Henpecked / Rangers in Space
programme.desc: The Rangers save farm hens from overcrowding. / The Rangers go to outer space to stop a malfunctioning space shuttle from harming satellites and hurtling space junk towards Earth.

programme.title: What A Gas / Turtle Trek
programme.desc: The Rangers save the cows that are currently providing power to Preston's farm via their methane gas burps. / The Rangers save a newly hatched baby turtle who struggles to find the ocean.

programme.title: Tornado Hunters
programme.desc: The Rangers save Patty and Preston from a tornado. / The Rangers save the air in a polluted city.

programme.title: Dust In The Wind / Catch a Tiger
programme.desc: The Rangers save a family of Javelinas from an intense desert dust storm. / The Rangers have to save a tiger thought to be extinct.

programme.desc: The Rangers have to save the unique animals at a hydrothermal vent. / The Rangers rescue a giant catfish.
