programme.desc: One of the most important yet overlooked periods in human history; the who, what, why, where, when and how of the Golden Age of Islamic Civilization; exploring the Abbasid Empire; how it bridged the ancient world and the Renaissance.

programme.title: Ibn Battuta's Search for Knowledge
programme.desc: Meeting the Moroccan wayfarer Ibn Battuta; tracing his journey across Northern Africa and the Middle East in the century after the Mongol sack of Baghdad; new insights into the era, including whether it ever truly come to an end.

programme.title: Arabian Nights Caliph: Harun al-Rashid
programme.desc: Getting to know Caliph Harun al-Rashid; Baghdad's House of Wisdom, which is the largest depository of books in the world at the time; it serves as the engine that drives much of the Golden Age; the Arabian Nights collection of stories and legends.

programme.title: The Arab World's Greatest Writer: al-Jahiz
programme.desc: Considered by many scholars to be the finest writer of Arabic prose to ever live, Al-Jahiz is a stylist and author of more than 200 works, uncovering the origins of Arabic writing and documenting the life and works of Al-Jahiz.

programme.title: The Land of Canaan
programme.desc: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

programme.title: The Arrival of the Israelites
programme.desc: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

programme.title: Jerusalem - An Introduction to the City
programme.desc: Surveying the topography and layout of Jerusalem; reviewing biblical accounts of Jerusalem from the arrival of David around 1,000 B.C.E. to the start of the Babylonian exile in 586 B.C.E.; the remains of an Assyrian siege on the city of Lachish.

programme.title: The Jerusalem of David and Solomon
programme.desc: A first look at the biblical City of David; combing through the remains of a scribe's house behind a city wall; the development of biblical Hebrew script; rare examples of this script in a clay sealing, a piece of pottery and a victory stele.

programme.title: Creation Stories and Why They Matter
programme.desc: The nature of creation stories.

programme.title: Reading Metaphor in Creation Stories
programme.desc: Metaphor and symbol are integral to creation stories, as they form a crucial part of the language of myth.

programme.title: Mesopotamian Creation: Enuma elish
programme.desc: Enuma Elish, also called the Seven Tablets of Creation, is a masterpiece of Mesopotamian literature.

programme.title: The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic
programme.desc: Examining key Mesopotamian texts referencing a catastrophic flood which decimates humanity.

programme.title: Egyptian Gods of Creation
programme.desc: Take account of funerary texts that contain allusions to the ancient Egyptian conceptions of creation.

programme.title: Egyptian Approaches to Creation
programme.desc: Within ancient Egyptian culture, explore the means by which the gods created the world and humanity.

programme.title: Arnhem: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: In December, 1944, 400 men of the 1rst British Airborne Division paraded at Buckingham Palace to receive their grateful thanks from their king and countrymen. Although they paraded as heroes, victors they were not. They were some of the survivors of a whole airborne division of over 10,000 men lost during the most audacious and ultimately controversial battles of Operation Market Garden; Arnhem.

programme.title: Big Picture: The Republic of Korea (ROK) Soldier
programme.desc: Through the Korean Military Advisory Group, the South Korean Army has been able to build itself up to the fourth strongest Army in the world. 'The Big Picture' shows the activities of the South Korean Army and its preparations for the future.

programme.title: Afrika Corps
programme.desc: This is the story of the rise and fall of one of the legendary forces of warfare. During its brief existence, the Afrika Korps forced the Allied forces ranged against it into a for war of attrition, thereby cementing its place in the annals of military history. The Afrika Korps will be forever associated with its brilliant commander Erwin Rommel, the Desert Fox of legend.

programme.title: Grey Wolves Part 2: Nowhere to Hide
programme.desc: Hitler was the proof that Germans did not understand the sea. Fortunately for him, his submariners did, and he had good reason to hand out awards to his U-Boat commanders. They had been preparing for war against England following the Anglo German naval agreement of 1935. When war broke out, only 57 U-Boats were available. He persuaded engineers that more boats were urgently required.

programme.title: The True Glory
programme.desc: Introduced by then General Dwight D. Eisenhower and using footage filmed by military photographers, this documentary recounts the historic events from the D-Day invasion to the end of the war. The pre-invasion preparations focus on work in munitions and heavy equipment manufacturing. The D-Day invasion, Operation Market Garden, the failed northern thrust into Holland in the fall of 1944, and more.

programme.title: Arnhem: A Bridge Too Far
programme.desc: In December, 1944, 400 men of the 1rst British Airborne Division paraded at Buckingham Palace to receive their grateful thanks from their king and countrymen. Although they paraded as heroes, victors they were not. They were some of the survivors of a whole airborne division of over 10,000 men lost during the most audacious and ultimately controversial battles of Operation Market Garden; Arnhem.

programme.title: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The outbreak of war in Europe forces the US to review its readiness for war. Whilst the American Air Force recruits and trains, adapting to Germany's new battle tactics, the Empire of Japan creates bring about a global conflict with its surprise attack. Now at war in the east and the west, America's air power must start to push back the forces of aggression.

programme.title: Vietnam Firefight
programme.desc: In the Vietnam War, flying into jungle produces a different kind of hazard. In a daring rescue mission a desperate pilot cuts his own landing zone in forty foot tall bamboo. They come under heavy fire as they return again and again to pick up more survivors from the bamboo circle.

programme.title: Marines at Tarawa
programme.desc: The 2nd US Marines' bloody assault on Tarawa.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: The Americans are getting ready to seize Baghdad airport, in what is to be the sole battle of this war. Opposite them: the Republican Guard led by Saddam Hussein's son Qusay. Dr. Hana Hammed, an Iraqi woman, wants to meet Qusay in order to have her husband, a prisoner in Abu Ghraib, released.

programme.title: Lull Before the Storm: Between the Wars
programme.desc: Here's a front row seat to Japanese attack on Manchuria and the rise of Hitler and the Nazi Party. As the world was undergoing significant changes so was the military air power.

programme.title: BATTLE OF ST. VITH
programme.desc: Background of events on Hitler's Ardennes offensive December 1944, with focus on December 19th attack on St. Vith, marking beginning of the Battle of Bulge. Role of 84th infantry division in fighting German army in World War II - penetration of Siegfried Line November 1944, and move into Belgium December 1944.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: At an airfield, Ivan, a new recruit, meets Lyudmila, a skilled pilot concealing an ailment. She mentors him as Lenya, the strict trainer, pushes Martynov, a rebellious trainee. When scouts go missing, aerial battles ensue, forging deep bonds, and unveiling secrets. Amidst peril and personal struggles, they find courage, love, and hope.

programme.title: The Life of Adolf Hitler: Death and Decay
programme.desc: The story of Adolf Hitler from the days of triumph through to the final Götterdämmerung.

programme.title: The American Navy in Vietnam
programme.desc: Documentary survey of the activities of the United States Navy leading up to and during the first years of the American war in Vietnam. Footage of American warships during the controversial Gulf of Tonkin incident, which triggered American military action in Vietnam, is shown, as well as depictions of the landing of U.S. Marines on the beaches at Da Nang and Chu Lai.

programme.title: Liberation of Ukraine
programme.desc: Kiev, the Ukrainian capital, is, after a lengthy battle, back in Soviet hands. But now they have to clear the Germans and German allies out of the Crimea and liberate the rest of Western Ukraine. Hitler declared the Crimea a 'Festung,' meaning it should be held at all cost and to the last man. The German 17th Army was effectively destroyed in the process.

programme.title: Heinrich Himmler
programme.desc: The Occult Roots of the Third Reich. The creator of the infamous Gestapo, the Waffen SS and the concentration camp network. Perhaps the strangest individual of all the Nazi crew. Himmler was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past.

programme.title: We Strike Back
programme.desc: Pearl Harbor day has etched itself in our history. The entire nation was motivated in a fighting fury. We will see the Japanese seize Hong Kong, Singapore, Philippines, and the Dutch East Indies. General McArthur is profiled.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The War in Italy
programme.desc: In an initial failed attempt to become a partner the equal of Germany in the Axis Alliance, Mussolini ordered his troops towards the British positions in Egypt in September 1940. Mussolini, feeling secure in the shadow of Hitler's apparent invincibility, never dreamt that the War between Britain and Italy would culminate in his own death less than 5 years later.

programme.title: The Road to War: September-December 1939
programme.desc: From the moment Adolf Hitler marched his troops into Poland on the 1st of September 1939, the Second World War was inevitable. As the opening skirmishes are played out, see for yourself the events that shaped the escalating crisis.

programme.title: Battle Lines Drawn: January-March 1940
programme.desc: As the New Year dawned and the people of Britain faced the introduction of rationing, all eyes turned northwards to Scandinavia. U-Boat attacks increased and at Scapa Flow a German Air Raid claimed the first British casualties.

programme.title: D-Day
programme.desc: This episode takes you through the tense hours of the largest seaborne invasion in history: Operation Neptune, often referred to as D-Day. The operation began the liberation of France and laid the foundations of the Allied victory on the Western Front.

programme.title: Part 10 - Scorched Earth
programme.desc: With the fall of Nazi Germany, the focus shifts to the Pacific, where Japan continues to resist fiercely. This episode covers the brutal island campaigns, kamikaze attacks, and the increasingly destructive U.S. bombing campaigns. Japan's refusal to surrender prompts the U.S. to deploy a new and terrifying weapon: the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Blitzed: Nazis on Drugs
programme.desc: In 1938 a drug called Pervitin was created in Nazi Germany. This drug was distributed to German soldiers during the course of WW2 and Hitler was no exception to these drug highs receiving drug cocktails from his personal physical Theodor Morell. This film explores the use of drugs in WW2 and looks at the potential effects that drugs could have had on Hitler, soldiers and the war itself.

programme.title: The Atom Strikes
programme.desc: First experimental blast set off in New Mexico; bombing and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: The End of Illusions
programme.desc: Germany, 1933. Adolf Hitler, at the head of the Nazi Party, has just become Chancellor and is faced with leading a republic in the throes of economic crisis and rampant inflation. Hitler used the cult of personality nurtured by his propaganda chief Joseph Goebbels, who spread the Nazis xenophobic and anti-Semitic ideology, which Hitler had been touting since the First World War.

programme.title: The War and Mike Bray
programme.desc: When American soldiers occupied Germany, they faced orphaned German children resorting to looting. Sergeant Mike Bray was assigned to rectify the situation. He earned the children's trust and helped them establish the Young German Christian Association, restoring an abandoned castle for recreation. The children were sad to see Bray go when he left, grateful for his support.

programme.title: The Siege of Leningrad
programme.desc: Leningrad, a vital and large Baltic sea port, is facing the entire weight of Army Group North. The Soviets have no reserves to spare as the Battle of Moscow is about to begin. Wilhelm von Leeb's Army Group North fails to take Leningrad, but begins a horrible siege that will last 872 days, in which over a million civilians will die of starvation and disease.

programme.title: The Human Torpedoes Of WWII
programme.desc: See the history of the mysterious 'Human Torpedoes' of WWII -- and how they originated and developed upon the standard torpedo in top secret.

programme.title: Rugged Company K
programme.desc: This is the thrilling story of one of the most decorated companies in the Army, Company K, 18th Infantry Regiment known as 'The Bloody One'. K is ordered to lay siege to an entire German infantry battalion impregnably fortified on high ground. The heroism of Lt. Johnson and the fearless acts of every soldier in the company are portrayed in this stirring tribute to the rugged men of Company K.

programme.title: Autopsy of a Mass Murder
programme.desc: On 20 November 1945, the trial of the top brass of the Third Reich, including Göring, opened in Nuremberg, the city where the anti-Jewish laws were drawn up in 1935. One year later, the international military tribunal sentenced 12 of the accused to death, and seven to jail. Some Jewish witnesses testified, and only Hans Frank, the Governor General of Poland, acknowledged the persecution of Jews.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Six scouts and pilots who excelled in the operation are sent to the capital to receive awards, then given a week's rest at a prestigious boarding house. Meanwhile German saboteurs, posing as the transport plane's commander and radio operator, plan to kill them en route and infiltrate the boarding house to assassinate Soviet command staff.

programme.title: Lest We Forget
programme.desc: Last in the deeply moving series about the Holocaust. While the hunt to find surviving Nazis continues today, efforts are being made to preserve the memory of their tragic victims.

programme.title: Kuwait
programme.desc: The war really begins from the moment Saddam Hussein, the president of Iraq, launches his troops into Kuwait. These are spearheaded by 100,000 of his republican guard. Supported by helicopter gunships, armored personnel carriers, mobile artillery and tanks.

programme.title: Hitler's Evil Scientists
programme.desc: It is a word that sends a chill down the spine: 'Ahnenerbe'. This was the name of the research institute set up to prove the scientific foundation of Nazi ideology. Driven by a scientific megalomania, the race for new discoveries led the institution to carry out countless acts of barbarism.

programme.title: Dawn of the Titans
programme.desc: This first part of the series introduces the first tanks being deployed on the battlefields in northern France during the First World War and describes the devastating effect these steel monsters had on an infantry confronted with them for the very first time. It tracks the development, both technologically and strategically from the Fuller 1919 philosophy through the German attack on Poland.

programme.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
programme.desc: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation. The footage is a camp-by-camp record taken in order to provide lasting objective proof of the horrors the liberators witnessed. Some emphasis is also placed on the humanitarian work done in camps by the liberators.

programme.title: Partners, Plans, and Provisions
programme.desc: In the pacific, in Europe, and on the continents of Africa and Asia, every branch of the air services now forms close partnerships with the other branches of the armed forces. The roles of transport and supply must now be balanced with combat, and the Army Air Force focuses on protecting allied interests on land and across the oceans.

programme.title: Hitler's Eastern Front: Army Group South
programme.desc: As Adolph Hitler prepared his armies for the invasion of Russia in 1941, he was conscious that he was about to change European history. He did change it although not in a way that he neither the rest of the war torn World would have ever thought possible.

programme.title: Sink the Bismarck
programme.desc: In May 1941, the British Royal Navy relentlessly pursued the formidable battleship Bismarck with the mission to sink it at any cost. They hunted the mighty battleship for three days, aiming to control the North Atlantic. At a time when England stood alone against Nazi forces, the mission was crucial to maintaining communication and securing the Atlantic from the German Kriegsmarine.

programme.title: The Reason Why
programme.desc: The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: By 1942, Soviet industry-rebuilt in the east-fueled the Red Army with mass-produced tanks, planes, and weapons, reversing the tide at Stalingrad. But while the war economy thrived, civilians starved under famine and rationing. With Allied aid and relentless sacrifice, the USSR rose as an industrial giant-at a staggering human cost.

programme.title: Ma Horner
programme.desc: This is the story of a young apple-cheeked Sergeant nick-named 'Ma' by his men because of his protective nature toward their scouting unit. It is also the tale of Pat Cassidy, a looter of watches and wine and a member of Horner's unit. How these two opposites combine their talents to single-handedly capture a German-held land mine control center, makes a spellbinding, action-packed episode.

programme.title: Big Picture: The Army Medical Corps
programme.desc: Graphically shown here is the treatment given our wounded in battle. We see the care a man receives from medics all along the line; from the time the wounded soldier calls 'Medic' until he is released for duty. The Medical Corps is saving more lives than in any other time of combat. Lieutenant Colonel S. J. Newsom of San Diego, California tells the story in an interview with Captain Zimmerman.

programme.title: First Blood: April-June 1940
programme.desc: When Winston Churchill becomes Prime Minister of the wartime coalition government in May 1940, he pledges his blood, toil, tears and sweat; within days of his appointment, he is made to honor his promise; with France near defeat and Allied soldiers trapped at Dunkirk, Churchill faces a critical challenge; capturing the drama and resilience that defined his leadership during Britain's darkest hour.

programme.title: Britain Under Attack: July-September 1940
programme.desc: With mainland Europe under Hitler's control, the German Fuhrer turned his attention to Operation Sealion, and the Battle of Britain. However he'd underestimated the enormity of the task and the spirit of a nation inspired by Winston Churchill.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: June 5th, 1944: A monumental Allied force assembles to liberate Europe from Nazi rule. With tension high and WWII entering its fifth year, two million soldiers stand prepared for sacrifice. In France, civilians eagerly await their deliverance, listening to Radio-London. As Allies land in Normandy, civilians, oblivious to danger, emerge to welcome them amidst combat.

programme.title: Ultimate Annihilation
programme.desc: The 20th century saw a deadly leap in technology. This episode explores mankind's most fearsome creations-chemical, atomic, robotic, and nuclear weapons. From banned gases to bombs that level cities, it's the story of ultimate destruction. Some were used, others were not-but all redefined the scale of warfare and the terrifying potential of future conflicts.

programme.title: Prelude to War
programme.desc: The surrender at Reims ended the major phase of the European Theater of WWII. The film dissolves from the surrender to Hitler in his early years of power, follows the rise of Nazism through the Munich Pact, the attack on Poland, the fall of France, and the Battle of Britain.

programme.title: The Armstrong 100 Ton Gun
programme.desc: The Armstrong 100 Ton Gun was first created in the late 1870's, and was easily the largest weapon of the time. Weighing in at 103,888 kg, the 100 Ton Gun had an length of 9.953 meters, and took a crew of 35 men, including 18 men just to handle the ammunition. The gun was originally offered to the Royal Navy, who deemed it too heavy for use. The Italian Regia Marina then took the gun into service.

programme.title: Out Blitzing the Blitzkrieg
programme.desc: The fourth episode sees the Germans well and truly on the retreat and the Allies are able to successfully implement operation Husky - the landing on Sicily - where General Montgomery and the American General George Smith Patton ousted the Germans in little over five weeks. On the Eastern Front General Zhukov inflicted heavy defeat on the Germans now having the new T - 54 tank available.

programme.title: The Night of the Long Knives: Hitler's Rise to Power
programme.desc: The Night of the Long Knives is considered the first act of horror committed by the Nazis. What happened in Germany, and in Hitler's rise to power, that led to this purge in 1934? Caught between the conservative tendency and the revolutionary aspirations that were dividing the country, the Chancellor had a choice. To calm the rumors of a military coup against him, Hitler sent a clear message.

programme.title: The Battle for Iwo Jima
programme.desc: The Marines hoist the flag after a bloody victory at Iwo Jima.

programme.title: Wings Over Vietnam
programme.desc: Both sides utilized air power during the Vietnam War, but the United States ruled the skies. The American pilots often were the factors that turned the fortunes of battles by interrupting enemy supply lines and communications, as well as gathering reconnaissance information for the ground troops. Despite the overwhelming success, it didn't produce victory. Vietnam air tactics broke the prior mold.

programme.title: Vietnam and the Limits of Strategic Bombing
programme.desc: A closer look at the scope of the U.S air power during the Vietnam war. See how air power changed the war, from bomb showers by the Republic F-105 Thunderchief, to C-123 Providers crashing, intended to supply provisions and air lift soldiers and civilians.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Falklands War
programme.desc: The Battle between the UK and Argentina over claims to the Falkland Islands systematically merged weapons technology of air, sea, and ground. A UK invasion yielded a bombardment of speed, weaponry and destruction.

programme.title: Memories of WWII
programme.desc: Amateur filmmakers in Normandy secretly documented daily life between 1939-1945, risking arrest under Nazi rule. Preserved for decades, their footage reveals war's darkest hours-shortages, fear, and ruins-yet also family bonds, joy, and hope. This documentary offers an extraordinary civilian perspective, intertwining anonymous lives with the unfolding tragedy and liberation of WWII.

programme.title: The Battle for Germany
programme.desc: Germany is retreating on all fronts and suffering defeat after defeat. The breach of Germany's pre-War borders now seems inevitable. Desperate, Hitler orders all males between the ages of 16 and 70 to enlist and fight for the fatherland. Nazi ideologues put faith in victory and the Nazis seem to vanquish and suppress all forms of doubt and resistance in the last months of the Reich.

programme.title: Stalin's Executioners: The Katyn Massacre
programme.desc: This film tells for the first time the story of the Katyn massacre seen from both sides: That of the victims and that of the perpetrators. It reveals how this crime, attributed to the Nazis for 50 years, was in fact carried out by the Soviet secret police, the NKVD.

programme.title: WWII War Diaries: 1941
programme.desc: In this third film of the series, '1941', see how Adolf Hitler increased the Nazi stranglehold on Europe, while Winston Churchill inspired the people of Britain to stand together as the nightly Luftwaffe bombing raids were extended to include the nation's vital ports, as well as the capital, London.

programme.title: Hitler's Death Army - Part II: Death and Decline
programme.desc: With recolorized archives, this episode explores the final year of Hitler's infamous division. From recruitment and indoctrination to their last missions, we uncover who these men were-and how they became perpetrators of mass murder. Following their brutal combat and crimes against humanity, we confront the chaos, ideology, and horror that defined the Das Reich's final descent.

programme.title: The Hammer Falls Hardest Here
programme.desc: Hitler's fortress Europe begins to crumble with Nazi occupying forces fall back on every front. The US Army Air Force grows to become the biggest armada the world has ever seen, gaining the air superiority needed to ensure complete victory.

programme.title: Memories of a Nazi Camp
programme.desc: The Natzweiler-Struthof camp has been erased from historical memory and yet.. with one of the highest death rate, this Nazi camp saw the worst eXactions and scientific eXperiences of the history.

programme.title: Fighter Aircraft: The Quest For Speed
programme.desc: The rare combination to power and grace lends high performance aircraft a fascination all their own. Hurdling through the atmosphere at extraordinary velocities they traverse oceans and continents, accomplishing in a few hours what journeys would cost in painful labor and time. Making these airplanes faster has been a long endeavor in fuel and technology. One element remains constant - pilots.

programme.title: Two Roast Chickens
programme.desc: Two recipes for roast chicken and more.

programme.title: Thanksgiving III
programme.desc: Thanksgiving; grill-roasted turkey; mashed sweet potatoes; cranberry sauce; potato masher.

programme.title: Pantry Staples
programme.desc: Making lemony rice with turkey meatballs and a lentil dish, palak dal; the pros review the top rice cookers on the market.

programme.title: Thanksgiving, Simplified
programme.desc: One-pan turkey breast and stuffing; dressing vs. stuffing debate; buying turkey; pear-cranberry chutney; roasted butternut squash and apple.

programme.title: Endless Dessert
programme.desc: Banana pudding pie; different vanilla products; the story of Augustus Jackson's eggless ice cream; no-churn ice cream.

programme.title: Porchetta-Style Turkey and Fennel
programme.desc: Porchetta-style turkey breast; smart ovens; roasted fennel with orange-honey dressing.

programme.title: Roast Chicken and Sprouts
programme.desc: Roast chicken with warm bread salad; a tasting of white miso; skillet-roasted Brussels sprouts with chile, peanuts and mint.

programme.desc: Poulet au vinaigre (chicken with vinegar); meat pounders; torte aux pommes de terre (French potato tart).

programme.desc: Ground beef chili; food processors; red lentil soup with North African spices.

programme.desc: Julia makes herbed roast chicken breasts, paired with mushroom orzo and garlicky Swiss chard.

programme.desc: Chicken on the grill; black-eyed pea salad with peaches; white wine sangria; nectarine and blackberry galette.

programme.desc: Uncovering the secrets to coffee cake with pecan-cinnamon streusel; tasting expert Jack Bishop challenges Julia to a tasting of crunchy peanut butter; gadget critic Lisa McManus gives a roundup of smart gadgets for home cooks.

programme.title: Eggs for the Holidays
programme.desc: Orange, cranberry and mint pavlova; a tasting of vanilla; cocktail tools; holiday eggnog.

programme.title: Mediterranean Comfort Food
programme.desc: Pastitsio; feta cheese; braised eggplant with paprika, coriander and yogurt.

programme.desc: Holiday sugar cookies; parchment paper; silicone baking mats; lemon bars.

programme.desc: Dan shows how to make perfect roast chicken; Lisa and Valerie share their picks for store-bought chicken broth.

programme.title: America's Test Kitchen Presents
programme.desc: All things science, cooking, and kitchen gear.

programme.title: Something Hearty, Something Light
programme.desc: Dan Souza makes Bridget Lancaster beef top loin roast with potatoes; metal spatulas; chopped carrot salad with fennel, orange and hazelnuts.

programme.title: Autumn Supper
programme.desc: Oven-roasted chicken thighs; the best tools for roasting; easy apple crumble.

programme.title: Hearty Alpine Fare
programme.desc: Tartiflette; mushrooms.

programme.desc: Indian butter chicken; a primer on tomato products; spinach dal with cumin and mustard seeds.

programme.title: Elevated Friendsgiving Mains
programme.desc: Slow-roasted duck with blackberry sauce; the best uses for different tinned fish; a rich bean bourguignon.

programme.title: Roast Chicken and Salad
programme.desc: Green goddess roast chicken; the origins of green goddess dressing; a primer on herbs; perfect pesto; potato, green bean and tomato salad.

programme.title: Turkey Two Ways
programme.desc: Turkey thigh confit with citrus-mustard sauce; cranberry sauce; skillet turkey burgers.

programme.title: Thanksgiving for a Small Group
programme.desc: Roasted whole turkey breast with gravy; mops; unlocking the secrets to perfect oatmeal dinner rolls.

programme.title: Outsmarting Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Roast turkey; oven thermometers.

programme.title: Desserts
programme.desc: Celebrate Friendsgiving with pecan pie, salted caramel apple bars and more!

programme.title: Grill-Roasted Chicken and Green Beans
programme.desc: Easy grill-roasted whole chicken; milk chocolate chips; necessary specialty devices for the kitchen; skillet-charred green beans with breadcrumb topping.

programme.title: All-Time Best Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Dan Souza invites nine ATK test cooks to his home to create the all-time best Thanksgiving meal.

programme.title: Scandinavian Brunch
programme.desc: Perfectly spiced Swedish cinnamon buns; robot vacuums; gravlax.

programme.title: Holiday Dessert and Salad
programme.desc: Cranberry curd tart with almond crust; wheat berry salad with radicchio; dried cherries and pecans; blue cheese.

programme.title: Thanksgiving for a Crowd
programme.desc: Hosts Davison and Lancaster reveal the recipe of turkey and gravy for a crowd; equipment expert Adam Ried shares his pick for stock pots; science expert Dan Souza explains the difference between stale bread and dried bread.

programme.title: Cocktails to Celebrate
programme.desc: Joe Gitter explores egg-based cocktails, then shows you how to open and serve a bottle of Champagne.

programme.title: Blackened Chicken and Roasted Okra
programme.desc: Blackened chicken; spice storage solutions; corn products; roasted okra with spicy red pepper mayonnaise.

programme.title: Springtime Feast
programme.desc: Spiral sliced ham glazed with cider vinegar caramel; mandolines; the science of sound and texture; Spanish potatoes with olive oil and wine.

programme.title: Spanish Summer Supper
programme.desc: Pinchos morunos -- Spanish grilled pork kebabs; dried chiles; melting points; Catalan tomato bread; rosé sangria.

programme.title: Prime Rib and Popovers
programme.desc: Sous vide prime ribs with mint persillade; vacuum sealers; popovers.

programme.title: Comfort Food With a Twist
programme.desc: Julia's take on comfort food includes thick-cut pork chops with smoked sea salt, garlic-scented mashed sweet potatoes with coconut milk and cilantro, a brussels sprouts and kale salad with herbs and peanuts, and her slow-cooker Nutella bread pudding.

programme.title: Holiday Gathering

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: We trek onto the second-largest ice sheet in the world, one of the best places to see the impacts of a warming climate; by air we see the stunning ice fjords fed by the majestic glacier behind it.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: We take to the ice by dog sled to see how the Inuit hunt; on board The Kisaq we pass huge colonies of seabirds: guillemots and kittiwakes and giant icebergs, where we see first-hand the effect of climate change as they crumble into the ocean.

programme.title: Walking the Yangtze With Ash Dykes

programme.title: Original Gangstas

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: Mario Van Peebles and Billy Zane shake up the frontier in this gun-blazing, fist-pounding western that takes a page missing from the history books and unfolds it with suspense, humor and awe-inspiring power! Pam Grier and Isaac Hayes co-star.

programme.title: Duel At Diablo
programme.desc: Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: When wild child Anna Lucasta (Eartha Kitt) is thrown out of the house by her self-righteous father, she falls into the life of prostitution... and into the arms of street-wise sailor Danny Johnson (Sammy Davis, Jr.).

programme.title: Jason's Lyric
programme.desc: Two inner city youths (Allan Payne, Jada Pinkett) find love amidst the violence around them and dream of a better life away from the slick ghetto streets of Houston.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: In this powerful drama, respected teacher Quincy Davis accepts an offer to become Vice Principal of an inner-city school poised to be integrated.

programme.title: Beat Street
programme.desc: Feel the rhythm. Catch the beat! Brash, bold and breakin' all the rules, this powerful musical stars Rae Dawn Chong and Guy Davis.

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: This fly follow-up to "Breakin'" finds Kelly, Ozone and Turbo trying to rescue a community center facing demolition at the hands of a greedy real-estate developer.

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: To save the homes of his family and friends, John "Rappin" Hood (Mario Van Peebles) rallies with his fast-talking comrades to fight back. Not with their fists... but with their powerful rap!

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Fed up with patriarch Mr. John Henry Brooks Jr.'s tyrannical rule, Mrs. Brooks and the kids are fighting back!

programme.title: Barbershop (2002)
programme.desc: Ice Cube headlines a stellar cast this hit comedy about a southside Chicago barbershop.

programme.title: Barbershop 2: Back In Business
programme.desc: The buzz is back in this hit sequel! Calvin (Ice Cube) is struggling to keep his father's shop alive, competing with a name-brand chain opening up next door! Queen Latifah, Eve, Michael Ealy, Troy Garity and Cedric The Entertainer co-star.

programme.title: Beauty Shop
programme.desc: When her egotistical boss pushes her a hair too far, top stylist Gina decides to open her own beauty shop with an eccentric group of stylists!

programme.title: Holiday Heart
programme.desc: Holiday (Ving Rhames), a choirmaster by day and a talented female impersonator by night, is lonely and grieving the death of his lover...until he befriends a bright young girl and her drug-addicted mother (Alfre Woodard).

programme.title: Street Smart
programme.desc: A freelance journalist becomes the toast of the town when he breaks a story about the dirty deeds of a ruthless New York pimp. There's only one problem: Jonathan fabricated the entire thing.

programme.title: Gang Related
programme.desc: Two killers are hiding where no one will ever find them...behind their badges! Tupac Shakur and James Belushi are two corrupt police detectives caught in a dangerous web of deceit in this gritty, smart and tough action thriller.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: A drug called "Fatal Beauty" has hit the streets of Los Angeles, and Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg), the city's toughest cop, is out to take down the drug lord responsible!

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: Police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) discovers that he's the only one who believes that his childhood friend was framed for murder to protect the local tourism business.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: A straight-laced and successful executive's world is turned upside-down when he discovers the 17-year-old son he never knew he had: Roger (Denzel Washington in his feature film debut)!

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Two best friends in 1964 Chicago cope with the challenges of everyday life and life in the housing projects.

programme.title: A Family Thing
programme.desc: When Earl (Robert Duvall) learns he has a Black half-brother (James Earl Jones) in Chicago, he heads north.

programme.title: Salt & Pepper
programme.desc: Legendary Rat-Packers Sammy Davis, Jr., and Peter Lawford star as London's hippest nightclub owners who take on England's craziest criminals!

programme.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
programme.desc: A slick comedy that blows the 70s Blaxploitation movies right out of the hood! A decorated war hero, returns to the ghetto and enlist an army of original gangstas to clean it up in this mixture of nostalgia, silliness and unpredictable humor.

programme.title: Kerry
programme.desc: Kerry wants to learn about his grandfather's relationship with his son.

programme.title: Xander & Carrie
programme.desc: After their twins contract a genetic disease, Xander and Carrie look for a history of HLH.

programme.title: Nick
programme.desc: Nick discovers why his French Canadian grandmother turned away from her heritage.

programme.title: Ty
programme.desc: Ty learns about his German heritage. He visits the Jewish Museum Berlin.

programme.title: Emily
programme.desc: Emily visits Marysburg Cemetery to learn about her ancestors.

programme.title: Best of Genealogy Roadshow
programme.desc: From immigration to murder mysteries, see guests across America uncover their histories.

programme.title: Albuquerque
programme.desc: Explore ties to a Native-American code talker, the Wild West and a comic book heroine.

programme.title: Miami
programme.desc: Trace stories about Pocahontas, the Tuskegee experiment, a villainous ancestor and more.

programme.title: Houston
programme.desc: Discover Andersonville prison, uncover a link to the Cherokee Freedman and more.

programme.title: Why Are You Still Here, Your Love Don't Feel: "Ty" Eason v Kori Stevenson
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Ty says she and Kori want to have a baby. Kori wants to do fertility treatments and Ty wants to conceive the traditional way with a man. Kori believes Ty is still interested in men. She says she caught Ty watching heterosexual porn and looking at her ex-boyfriend's social media page. It's up to Judge Star to sort this out on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: If You Don't Change Your Toxic Ways, I'm Ready to Walk Away: "Jerry" Tubbs V Jamishia Gipson
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Jerry says Jamishia is sneaky. He says she sent $2K of his money to her friend to help her friend and charged $5k to his credit card during a shopping spree. Jamishia says Jerry promised her a certain lifestyle and he needs to live up to that. She says she expects him to help her out financially.

programme.title: Picture Perfect Disaster: Tiara Reid V Amir Reid
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Tiara says Amir is controlling and financially manipulative. He convinced her to sell her car and the proceeds would go to funding their business. That didn't happen and now she has no car and no seed money for their business. Amir says he's not controlling, he has his wife's best interest in mind when making decisions for the family. He doesn't want a divorce, he wants to fight for his family. Hear what Judge Star has to say on the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: Shopaholic Madness: Timothy Johnson v Tammy Johnson
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Timothy says Tammy controls who comes to their house. He says her family is allowed there anytime, but she doesn't allow his family to visit. They've been in their house for 10 years and his side of the family has yet to visit. Tammy wants to save her marriage. She says they can resolve their lack of communication and divorce is not an option. It's up to Judge Star to get them on the same page in the next Divorce Court!

programme.title: Runaway Bride: Maria Robinson v Tekeila Boyd-Gibson

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.desc: A young woman finds love in the jail's one co-ed housing unit; another inmate, charged with a spree of armed robberies, now comes under investigation inside the jail; a father speaks for his son, who if found guilty, could face the death penalty.

programme.title: The Bad Good Friday

programme.title: Brother Against Brother

programme.title: Miss Fortune

programme.title: Next of Kin

programme.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part

programme.title: Citizen's Arrest
programme.desc: A convicted thief continues his stealing ways inside the jail; a former law enforcement officer turned meth addict serves time with and grows closer to her dealer; a man gets arrested for allegedly threatening the sheriff.

programme.title: Inside Pendleton Juvenile

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 5
programme.desc: "The lone wolf receives an assassination request to eliminate a feudal lord from a member of his own clan. The Yagyus are using this opportunity to hunt down the lone wolf and exploit the clan's weakness at the same time."

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Yagyus continue to use any method necessary to kill the lone wolf. Meanwhile, Ogami is shocked to receive an assassination request from a woman with uncanny resemblance to his late wife.

programme.title: 52 Masters: RON THOMAS
programme.desc: Will gets all choked up when he trains with fellow Karate Kid franchise veteran Ron Thomas (Karate Kid, Cobra Kai).

programme.title: Soldier Champion aka American Force 6: Soldier Champion
programme.desc: Escape is the only way to survive. Larry Rourke, leader of the resistance to an oppressive South-Asian country, escapes a prison for political dissidents, but it is all part of a master-plan by the head of the prison, who intends to use him to locate the rebel headquarters. Joined by an anti-government cult, the Full Moon Alliance, Rourke must ensure that the government's armies do not catch them before they can find salvation.

programme.title: Three Avengers
programme.desc: When two acrobats are fired for fighting with punks in the audience, they go to live with an aunt who's being pressured to sell her house for a real estate development. The developer's nasty son, Lee Fu, decides to muscle the sale.

programme.title: 52 Masters: LUA aka KAIHEWALU LUA with Michelle Manu
programme.desc: Will spends time with his friend Michelle Manu, a master of the devastating Hawaiian martial art of Kaihewalu Lua.

programme.title: The Magnificent Duo
programme.desc: Leopard, seeks to dominate the opium market. Who can stop him? The Magnificent Duo is ready and willing to take on the gangsters and their Japanese ninja allies in their righteous fight to stand up for the poor and challenge the wicked.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: James Lew
programme.desc: Winning the Emmy Award for Most Outstanding Stunt Coordinator for the "Luke Cage" Marvel series, James Lew began his career as one of the greatest forms and weapons competitors in the tournament circuit of the 1970s. Gracing the cover of countless magazines, Lew teamed up with Carrie Ogawa-Wong to become the greatest duo performance team in history. This earned them the cover of Inside Kung Fu magazine which became the most popular action cover of all time.

programme.title: Raging Rivals
programme.desc: Shanghai in chaos at the turn of the century, a place where gangsters gather and commit all manner of evils. Ghost Kick Silver Fox faces off against the Shanghai Tigers in a battle for control of the lucrative casinos and brothels, but the victor will be the one who ultimately can train the best kung fu killers.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Steve Sexton
programme.desc: Steve "Roadhouse" Sexton is a man who put his martial arts skills to the test everyday. An instructor in Korean Hapkido, Sexton was also the muscle for many bars and places where "tough guys" gather. These are the stories of a man who was shot at, and stabbed but used his martial arts skills to overcome some of the most deadly encounters.

programme.title: 52 Masters: GERALD OKAMURA
programme.desc: Will's lesson with Kung Fu master and martial arts film star Gerald Okamura (G.I. Joe Rise of Cobra, Big Trouble in Little China) takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Green Dragon Inn
programme.desc: When an evil land baron's son murders an innocent family, a Marshal is called in to escort him to be executed in the court of law far to the north. With the aid of an army of soldiers, the Marshal must fight off the Land Baron's assassins.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Art Camacho
programme.desc: Art Camacho is one of the premiere filmmakers in the martial arts industry. From a stuntman to a fight choreographer to the director's chair, Camacho's career includes over 22 film projects wit 36 credits in producing, acting and stuntwork. An award-winning film director, Camacho provides a candid interview about growing up Hispanic, the failures he faced, the influence Bruce Lee played on his life and what it took to break into the film industry.

programme.title: Ninja Operation 2 - Way of Challenge
programme.desc: Sword of Catastrophe is stolen by the Black Ninja, who seeks to free the sword's energy and become all-powerful. Only Ninja Gordon can prevent this catastrophe, but in his search for the secret he comes across an unlikely crew of ninja misfits, who teach him the way to defeat the Black Ninja's dark skills.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Chuck Sullivan
programme.desc: A 60-plus year veteran of the martial arts, Chuck Sullivan is considered one of the most influential artists in American kenpo karate. As one of the earliest black belts of icon Ed Parker, Sullivan stepped into history in 1961 by developing the first series of instructional films which played a key role in the early stages of promoting kenpo throughout the world.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Donnie Williams
programme.desc: In 1969, Donnie Williams took a step into history as one of the founding members of the Black Karate Federation (BKF). The purpose of the BKF was to establish proper representation for Black youth in the karate tournament circuit. It wasn't long before the BKF became the largest Black organization in America, and Williams continued to play a major role in its success.

programme.title: Horse Boxing Killer
programme.desc: A handsome fighter and a beautiful martial arts warrior are forced to combine forces and practice the Art of Horse Boxing under the instruction of the Drunken Master Sam Seed to combat a mutual ruthless enemy.

programme.title: Rebel of Shaolin aka Shaolin Traitor
programme.desc: The new Emperor doesn't like Shaolin and wants to get back a priceless jade gift that the previous Emperor bestowed upon Shaolin. The Emperor's sister (Lung Chung Erh), has found a way to get the priceless jade back by hatching a plan with a corrupt revenge-minded Shaolin Monk (Lu Ping). Part of the plan calls for framing Le Ping Fei (Carter Wong) as a killer and traitor of Shaolin.

programme.title: The Conspiracy of Thieves
programme.desc: Awesome and fantastic kicking: from the Legendary Flash Legs Tan. It's China early 20th century and the country thrives on illegal gambling. The Department of State Security is sending Captain Chang (Dorian Tan) under the guise of the son of the former owner to infiltrate a casino run by criminals. Awesome and fantastic kicking: from the Legendary Flash Legs Tan.

programme.title: Escape to High Risk
programme.desc: Wu Tang collection is proud to present the cult classic "Escape to Freedom" an often sadistic and certainly batty, sexy, proud and violent POW scum fest that sets 'Chinese' insurgents against vile, evil Hitler moustache 'Japanese' camp guards who think nothing of shooting, stabbing, torturing and slapping their mud covered, constantly scream-in wards.

programme.title: 52 Masters: BENNY "THE JET" URQUIDEZ (pt 2)
programme.desc: Will continues his training with Benny "The Jet" Urquidez and sits down for an interview.

programme.title: 52 Masters: BENNY "THE JET" URQUIDEZ (pt 1)
programme.desc: Will meets one of his childhood heroes, kickboxing champion Benny "The Jet" Urquidez- and finds the training is tougher than he expected

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 17
programme.desc: After dealing with a gang of local bullies, Sengoku is asked to help a desperate lady, whose husband tried to stop a corrupt mining operation.

programme.title: Swift Shaolin Boxer
programme.desc: Angela Mao rips through her enemies! Fierce females Angela Mao and Judy Lee search and seize the Five Phoenix's Night-Shining Pearl from the wicked bandits of the Black Wind Fortress. Tieh Ying-Hung, as the leader of the woman's gang, vows to overthrow the fortress in order to restore law and order. Can she conquer the fortress and its massive army of kung fu masters and death defying traps? Top notch action from Hwang Kwo Chu the man who brought you Method man.

programme.title: Ninja Knight 3: Heaven's Hell
programme.desc: After serving five years in prison for the murder of gang leader Donald's brother, Alfred, a fisherman by trade, finds that not only has his fiancée married into the mob but Donald is determined to ruin his life completely. A vendetta of mindless violence, which can only end in violent bloodshed.

programme.title: The Eagle Fist
programme.desc: A young militia fighter decides to throw in his lot and go off and learns kung fu. He meets a master of the Eagle fist and soon becomes a master, as well as learning some dark truths about his teacher's past and why he was trained to such a high level.

programme.title: Final Mission Final aka Who Knows About Me
programme.desc: Here is a place full of murder, terrorism and assassination. His obsession is to create the ultimate challenge...His final mission is to finalize...An ex-convict, Sung, is determined to go straight rather than fall back into the clutches of leading gang boss Lo. Hunted by the gang, who are trying to recover some incriminating photos, Sung seeks the help of an ex-model and a fighter so as expose the gang boss and his nefarious activities.

programme.title: The Ultimate Ninja
programme.desc: A twenty year old feud between an evil tyrant, Roger, and Ronald, the benevolent village leader, leaves Ronald dead and Roger running the village with an evil menacing bunch of ruffians. Years later the orphaned children are reunited when an evil ninja steals the Black Ninja Warrior from the Red Ninjas. If he gets a hold of the Golden Ninja Warrior a rule of tyranny will be unleashed upon the country, and only the three can stop him.

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 9
programme.desc: Tako is robbed, Lord doesn't have enough money to pay for the hotel he is staying in, and Sengoku gets stuck assisting a cranky old man. Can the day get any worse?

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub The Final: Episode 6
programme.desc: Itto and Daigoro arrived in Hida Takayama. Hikosaka, the local magistrate in charge of the village of Tsukada in Takayama, has been taxing the peasants more than the annual tribute and using them as laborers for his own personal use, which has become a problem.

programme.title: Dynamo
programme.desc: Bruce Li is hired by a talent agency to become the next big martial arts star, due to his resemblance to Bruce Lee. However, a rival agency becomes jealous of Bruce's success, and attempts to have him killed. See Bruce Li fight karate legend Steve Sanders!

programme.title: Challenge of Young Bruce Lee
programme.desc: Adopted by monks after being abandoned as a baby, Young Bruce Lee learns the art of kung fu.After the death of his master, Bruce leaves the temple and travels to the city. There he is befriended by Black belt masters Kim & Jun who invite Brice into their home; he is confused by their modern lifestyle.

programme.title: Fearless Kung Fu Elements
programme.desc: According to Chinese legend, the Universe is made of five basic elements: gold, wood, water, fire and earth. These elements are also considered very powerful in kung fu. This film tells the story of five princesses and their loyalty to their clan as each must fight the demon fox using one of the five elements.

programme.title: Inheritor of Kung Fu aka Two Graves to Kung Fu
programme.desc: A naïve kung-fu student (Ti Lung) falls under the influence of a corrupt master. Soon, the student realizes his master's plan is to dominate the martial arts community by stealing a legendary martial arts book that's supposed to bestow its owner with extraordinary powers. His master will stop at nothing - including murder - to possess this book.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo Episode four: Judo
programme.desc: Warriors of Budo Episode Four: Judo brings us to the modern era of martial arts when dutchman Anton Geesink shook the world by winning gold at the 1964 Tokyo Olympic Games, it was clear evidence that Japan's firm grip on Judo was broken. When Jigoro Kano turned the deadly Martial Art of Jujutsu into Judo, he created a global sport with competitors in more than two hundred countries. The Kodokan Judo institution is still however the symbolic beating heart of Judo.

programme.title: Magnificent Chivalry
programme.desc: Hong Kong superstar Jimmy "One Arm Boxer" Wang Yu stars as the Bamboo blade, China's top swordsman. His services are rendered by the Imperial treasury, who wants him to infiltrate a powerful gang of Highwaymen and get back the stolen silver bullion. After numerous deadly encounters the gang is beaten by the bamboo sword and only the gang leader remains; however he's a lot tougher than they originally bargained for.

programme.title: Fight the Kickboxer
programme.desc: Champion kickboxers Rough Tati and Harry Wells are partners in a scam to fix their fights so as to win big odds in gambling. When Rough begins to expand his criminal activities to gun-running, drugs and prostitution, Harry decides to quit and go straight, but is framed by his former partner and sent to jail. Here he clashes with crime boss, Mason, and his men and manages to escape, but so does Mason.

programme.title: Filthy Guy
programme.desc: Sammo Hung is a poor village orphan called 'Filthy Guy' for his unwashed / diseased head whose ambitious landlord's son becomes king and wants to kill him, as a prophecy predicts Sammo Hung will replace him. Eventually Sammo Hung becomes the first Ming Emperor.

programme.title: Fury in Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: Pak Si-baek, master of the Taekwondo martial arts, and Wang Pa-san, master of the Jeong-mu Taekwondo martial arts, decide to take each other's child and teach them their martial arts styles. But when Si-baek arrives at the Shaolin Buddhist Temple, the Buddhist priest Gong-young of the school of Jeong-Mu has already been kicked out. Si-baek is accused of playing a part in stealing the Shaolin secret manuscripts and imprisoned according to Jeong-mu law. The school of Jeong-mu flourishes.

programme.title: The Ninja Squad
programme.desc: THE MASTER - THE STUDENT - their desperate challenge. Two highly skilled ninjas come together, with two different personal wars. Billy, fresh from ten years of training, is blinded by revenge for the murder of his family... Ninja Gordon needs to defeat a power-hungry ninja, Ivan the Red, before he eliminates everybody in his way. Can both master and student overcome the obstacles put before them? An explosive and grueling duel ensues that determines the fate of the Ninja Empire.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 3
programme.desc: Ittou and Daigoro were eating in a room of an inn in Ushiori when Okaayo jumped in. Upon closer inspection, there was blood on her hands. Okayo had stabbed and killed Bunbematsu, who had attacked her to take her body, by mistake after a struggle, and had entered Itto and the others' room to escape anyway. The brothel manager Torizo could not let her go. He ordered Itto, who was hiding Okayo, to hand her over to him. Ittou, however, refused to comply with his request.

programme.title: Instant Kung Fu Man
programme.desc: Two identical twins, the younger one, a Disciple of Shaolin who's crafty tricks make up for his poor kung fu, and the elder, a vicious bandit with tremendous kung fu skills, cause havoc when they mix their identities to fool the Shaolin monks and a ruthless robber, who are both keen to catch the twins for different reasons.

programme.title: Ninja over the Great Wall
programme.desc: Ninja over the Great Wall takes place in the early nineteen-thirties when China was occupied by the Japanese imperial forces. Wa Chi Keung is a peasant who escaped the mass murder of his village by the Japanese. He joins his master in Beijing shortly before the old man's assassination by ninjas. What follows is a one man war on the Ninjas and Japan top bushido experts.
