The group also get their first chance to experience some practical training as they get hands-on with a variety of wildlife.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The Yorkshire Vet, Julian Norton, is called out to a local petting farm to help a bad-tempered goat with a suspected broken leg - but the goat is not keen on getting treatment! When Peter takes an emergency call from an anxious trainer, it could be the end of the line for a horse that has cut open its foot while grazing in a field.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Radio DJ Bree and her partner Sophia are looking for a bestie for their terrier, Whitney Houston. Barry and his daughter Lily are looking for a calm companion to join their family.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Julian needs as many extra pairs of hands as he can muster as he has to perform a caesarean section on a pregnant Great Dane. Later, young vet Matt marries his fiancee Katherine in front of all of his veterinary friends.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The student RSPCA Inspectors are now entering the last and toughest stage of their year-long training. They're investigating cases by themselves for the first time ever. If they make it through these final few months, they'll be offered a full-time position, but for now they're on probation with no guarantee of success.

programme.title: Mountain Babies
programme.desc: This day is spent high in the mountains of the world. Rock climbing goats and mountain lions are among the animals that are featured.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter heads up Sutton Bank for a lambing with a view. However, there's no time to admire the surroundings because a lamb is stuck and it is too late for a C-section. Julian meets a pug with an unusual name and an unusual problem.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Emily hopes that bringing a dog into their home will offer a calming influence to her Neurodiverse son Jacob. And will Digger the Jack Russell prove worthy of being emotional support for young Harper?

programme.title: Baby Animals From The UK
programme.desc: The destination is the United Kingdom. Tune in to catch a bunch of feisty Polecat kits create a furry blur as they play fight, go on an adventurous ramble with some baby Red Foxes, plus get up close and personal with a charming Irish Donkey foal.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter treats a ewe that is struggling to give birth to twin lambs, and also performs a complicated and risky surgery on a tawny owl to remove the bird's ruptured eyeball.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: At Jackie Barlow's farm, Mako the alpaca has a lump on his face that's the size of half a football! And Mako is louder than a football crowd, with Julian admitting he's one of his noisiest patients ever.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Skeldale Student vet Molly turns to the Yorkshire vet for help as she brings in her cat Marlo who appears to have been shot in the head. Julian has to perform emergency surgery. Farmer Chris Colbeck is worried about his sheepdog Floss, who was run over by a tractor on the farm. Can Peter fix her wounded leg so that Floss can get back to her flock?

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A much-loved trekking lama, Gus, has an excruciatingly painful problem. An orphaned kitten could have life-changing injuries. Julian's beloved Jack Russell, Emmie, gets into a skirmish. To relocate a male deer, Peter must use a highly dangerous dart gun. Julian dashes to save a beautiful, badly injured cow. Steve Green is nearly 90 years old and together with wife Jean he're still farming.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian Norton visits a local farm to de-horn some lively young bullocks. Back at the surgery he and Peter Wright try to save the life of a dog that has got a large bone wedged in its oesophagus.

programme.title: All Farmers Great and Small
programme.desc: Julian Norton visits the young people putting everything they have into their number-one passion - farming. The programme celebrates the hard work and dedication of four young farmers, as they make their mark on the Yorkshire countryside.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian heads to the Taylors' farm where there's a double sheep emergency - a new mum and an expectant mum have both prolapsed. Peter meets Katie Perry - a superstar of a collie who requires emergency surgery.

programme.title: Jungle Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place in some of the jungles of the world. Chimpanzees, orangutans and elephants feature.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian's patients include a horse with infected hooves, while Peter Wright is worried about a pedigree cat that is in labour and also has to deal with an angry monitor lizard. The two vets find time to attend the Great Yorkshire Show.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian and Peter have to cope with two night-time emergency call outs. New vet Esme performs her first emergency caesarean and a pack of bloodhound pups cause mayhem in the surgery.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Elderly Timmy, a Collie cross, is discovered in a house with a huge painful tumour on his face, but inspector Anthony Joynes refuses to give up on him. Inspector Helen Smith meets Archie, a stroppy Shih-Tzu that has become so matted, he can barely see or hear. Inspector Simon Evans pays a visit to two French Bulldog puppies, Yoda and Mogwai, that were found in Pontypool Park in Wales.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Greyhound Alinta needs to turn her life around after a hard start as a racing dog; Louise and her son Jack need a playful soul to fill their lives with joy. Will Bear, the cattle cross, be the one?

programme.title: More Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We are off round the planet getting face to face with zoo babies, great and small. Tiny hippos in the hippo pond, rhino calf romping around, and a roller coaster ride with a pair of baby marmosets.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: When footage of a dog being beaten by his owner comes to the attention of the RSPCA, inspector Mel Fisher is straight on the case. It doesn't take long for her to rescue the young German Shepherd and bring the owner to justice. In Sunderland, inspector Jaqui Miller has her hands full when three generations of dogs are signed over by their struggling owner, and help has arrived just in time.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode, farmer Richard Todd brings one of his much-loved semi-feral moggies into the practice. But 'Pretty Tom' isn't living up to his name. Peter believes the lump on Tom's face could be a life threatening tumour. To be safe, the mass must be removed urgently but Peter knows it will be extremely difficult surgery. Against all odds can Peter, with the help of Vet Helen, save Pretty Tom?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian races to help a pony with a large gash on her neck and Peter battles to save a sheep. A greedy cat has a stick stuck in his mouth and Julian faces a massive, messy job - pregnancy testing over 50 cows.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Mangalitsa pig breeder Lisa is worried about her boar Hal, who has a large lump on his neck. A famous client brings their dog to the practice. Matt is in uncharted waters as he heads to a local college to operate on one of their fish.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Are two dogs too many when the Prestia family meet a bonded pair? Will retired nuns Margaret and Antoinette find their final doggy companion? Can Justin the magician handle large puppy Oreo's tricks?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Family of five the Bascals are looking for a new buddy for their dog, while Karina and her son Alex meet a bonded pair of Jack Russell Chihuahua brothers.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Lanita and her two grown-up kids meet a dog with a rough backstory, mum of five Danielle wants a furry friend to keep her company and avid cyclists Jo and Jarvie are ready to join the dog club.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter faces a difficult calving at Ed McDonald's farm. The cow is an experienced mum and Ed is an experienced farmer, so Peter senses it's a serious problem.

programme.title: More Pet Babies
programme.desc: This time we spend the day with some of the world's most beloved pets. Kittens, puppies and baby guinea pigs are some of the babies we have fun with.

programme.title: Winter On The Moors Special
programme.desc: Called out to remote farms to tend animals in labour and the sick and injured, vets Julian Norton and Peter Wright must battle the weather to treat and save patients including owls and cattle.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: It's Sunday morning, but it's no day of rest for Julian as he heads to the Taylors' farm. One of their sheep has prolapsed a few days after he delivered her lamb, and Julian has his work cut out to receive another reward of freshly laid eggs.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Will Australian Shepherd Alfie and the Holmes Family find their new mate? Will 'stage-5-clinger' Missy be too much for a first time owner? Will shy shaggy Doug be the right fit for the Billich family?

programme.title: Zoo Babies
programme.desc: We are off to the zoo.We take a hidden camera into the den of red pandas, and then see them take their first steps. Baby bears enthrall us with their playful behavior, and baby baboons enjoy time in the water.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter rushes to help a cow, who after delivery, has accidentally pushed out her uterus. Julian goes head to head with Arnie the ram who is very intimidating for those who look his way, but unfortunately he is struggling with his own sight.

programme.title: Winter Babies
programme.desc: We look at playful youngsters who extract the most fun out of winter. Brown bear babies enjoy this time of the year along with baby snow monkeys enjoying time in hot springs. Tasmanian Devil babies seek out a cosy den.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter rushes to save a newborn calf who's going downhill fast. Julian visits Tazmin the huge eagle. Peter's old friend, Bison, the much-loved boxer, has hormone problems. Can Julian get a poorly ewe well enough to have lambs? Zoe's language skills are put to the test. Dexter the Ferret returns. He's known to nip, so will Julian keep his fingers intact?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian gets a panic-stricken call from Alpaca farmer, Jackie Barlow. Two of her alpacas, Gavroche and Francesca, have sneaked into the barn and gorged themselves on the food stash. They're struggling to breathe, foaming at the mouth and choking. At Skeldale, Julian faces one of his toughest challenges to date - Bertram the Bloodhound has a nasty tumour, as big as an egg, above his eye.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter desperately tries to deliver thirteen puppies who are drowning in their own fluid. Saving a sick school guinea pig is a big test for Julian. And on the Greens' farm, Jean throws a surprise party for Steve's 90th.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Is Lane the dachshund pup the perfect match for Arnav and his parents? Can lovebirds James and Melissa win over aloof Aspen, the Japanese Spitz? Finally, will scruffy sweet Caroline find good times with Jay and Christine?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Matt and David meet equine rock star Jon Bon Pony. Peter treats a farmer's trusty Labrador who's struggling to walk after cutting herself on a nail. Julian operates on a chicken with an infected leg. Robin aids a pregnant ewe.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: A pregnant ewe is rushed to the animal hospital from Cannon Hall Farm. David determines she needs an emergency c-section. Young vet Rohin gains valuable experience on the farm. Julian rushes a cat into surgery and enjoys some alpaca yoga.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A much-loved trekking lama, Gus, has an excruciatingly painful problem. An orphaned kitten could have life-changing injuries. Julian's beloved Jack Russell, Emmie, gets into a skirmish. To relocate a male deer, Peter must use a highly dangerous dart gun. Julian dashes to save a beautiful, badly injured cow. Steve Green is nearly 90 years old and together with wife Jean he're still farming.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Peter's called out to a cow with stomach problems, he calls in reinforcements from his new Grace Lane Practice. Julian has a surprise examining a pregnant dog. A frisky Shetland Pony and a lizard with a dead tail end are also treated.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Sammy the Jack Russell has the wiggliest bum ever, and could be the perfect complement to young Alex's dry reserve. Plus, neglect victim Martin the Staffy may finally find the caring home he deserves.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Rupert the adored trekking llama is lame and in agony. Can Julian save Rupert's career? Peter pregnancy tests cows. But will all of Arthur's prized herd be in calf? Ruben the lurcher was rescued by elderly local farmers, Jean and Steve Green. But his love of Jean's home cooking might be causing problems. Ellie May, a treasured moggie, is accidentally run over by her devastated owner.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian sets up a blood bank for baby alpacas, but collecting donations is harder than expected. Peter is woken at 2am by an emergency call-out for a pregnant cow, and must be at his sharpest to deliver the calf safely. A sheepdog undergoes treatment to remove a tumour, a cat is in need of castration, and Katie visits a bad-tempered pig with very sore eyes.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Star, a 3-legged sheep, might be given a new lease of life if Matt can fit her with a prosthetic leg. Julian meets Teddy, a 10-month-old dachshund and his owner Kerry, who believes Teddy saved her life when she went into cardiac arrest.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: It's a distressing day for Inspector Anthony Joynes after he's called to investigate the case of Harvey, a Border Collie so thin it had to be put to sleep on humane grounds. But there's more upset in store when Anthony turns up at Harvey's registered address and finds another dog just days away from death.

programme.title: Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
programme.desc: Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

programme.title: Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
programme.desc: Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

programme.title: Bread Masters
programme.desc: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town.

programme.title: Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
programme.desc: Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Guayabera World
programme.desc: In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: The Art of the Egg
programme.desc: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: The Famous Pastes of Spices
programme.desc: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
programme.desc: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
programme.desc: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: A Mayan League of their Own
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.title: A Day With Hugo
programme.desc: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Yucatán Meats
programme.desc: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
programme.desc: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: The Best Tacos In Mérida
programme.desc: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.desc: No matter who you're rooting for, savor these ballpark favorites while beating those major league prices.

programme.title: Suppertime Superstar
programme.desc: From casual weeknights to special occasions, be the star of the dinnertime with these crowd-pleasing meals.

programme.title: Bring Your Own Lunch
programme.desc: These handheld lunches for work or school are easy on the wallet and customizable for the whole family.

programme.title: The Big Game
programme.desc: Brackets are complete and all that's missing is food to fuel your team's run. Huddle around the kitchen as Frankie preps the ultimate watch party spread. These savory, spicy and sweet dishes are championship-worthy even if your bracket goes bust.

programme.title: Piece Of The Pie
programme.desc: There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle-free, cost-friendly pies.

programme.title: Salad Salad Salad
programme.desc: Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

programme.title: Super Squash
programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of squash: they're affordable, abundant, and they come in all shapes, sizes, colors, and textures. Frankie spotlights squash from summer through winter highlighting their amazing superhero traits.

programme.title: The Future is Flavor

programme.desc: Florida's Skunk Ape stalks and attacks a hunter in the swamp, evidence of the Lizard Man of Scape Ore Swamp is revealed, and a teenage boy in South Carolina survives an extraordinary alien abudction and lives to tell his story.

programme.title: Wolfman, Dogman, Wendigo
programme.desc: Detailed accounts of Wendigo, Dogman, Wolfman. Creature encounters from Michigan, Minnesota, and also Canada are explored.

programme.title: Appalachia
programme.desc: The dark hallows and dense forests of Appalachia harbor strange mysteries. Local residents will recount their encounters with the terrifying Sheepsquatch, the dark winged-creature, Mothman, and aliens from space.

programme.title: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking classes.

programme.title: The Haunted Mill Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mil, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: Haunted Crank Caves
programme.desc: Bex and Sean investigate some of the most haunted caves systems in the world: Crank Caves. Located in St Helens, myths and legends surround this labyrinth of tunnels and the team seek out paranormal claims of ghostly activity.

programme.title: Shadows From The Past
programme.desc: Explore Bishop's Palace in London, haunted by the Royal Executioner Bishop Bonner's victims from over 500 years ago. Discover evidence and tales of hauntings marking the Palace's dark history. In Rye, Sussex, encounter the ghost of a Queen Elizabeth handmaiden, forever searching for a lost pearl necklace, driven to suicide by shame.

programme.title: The Haunted Castle
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Ewloe Castle in North Wales, believed to be haunted by ghosts and spirits.

programme.title: Family Full of Ghosts
programme.desc: Bex and Sean investigate a haunted cottage hidden deep in the heart of Cheshire. Believed to be haunted by a family of ghostly spirits, many urban explorers have encountered paranormal activity inside of the building.

programme.title: Ghosts of The Asylum
programme.desc: Paul and Sean visit one very haunted Asylum in Manchester and come to face with ghostly souls that are haunting the building. The Asylum housed the criminally insane and it would appear, as the building closed, some of them never left!

programme.title: Haunted Grotto
programme.desc: Hidden secrets and a mischievous ghost are hiding in a haunted cave in Sefton Park. Ghost Dimension make contact with strange paranormal entities, that put on a full display of ghostly activity! Could this be the most haunted adventure yet?

programme.title: Chupacabra - Kraken
programme.desc: Evolutionary anthropologists evaluate strong new evidence for the existence of Bigfoot. Is a haunted wine box with roots in the Holocaust causing strange events and illnesses? Physicists examine the artifact for a physical or supernatural source.

programme.title: Haunted Spirits of The Vale Bar
programme.desc: In this gripping episode, Bex and Sean delve into the mysteries of The Vale Bar, a former home now transformed into a bustling pub in Walton Vale, Liverpool. With whispers of ghostly encounters from the owners and staff, the duo embarks on an investigation that unveils strange noises, unexplained taps, and potential spirit communication.

programme.title: Haunted Secrets of The Carlton
programme.desc: The team explore The Carlton, a location with a dark and mysterious past. As they investigate reports of strange noises, shadowy figures, and unexplained activity, they delve deeper into the eerie history surrounding the building. Will the spirits haunting The Carlton reveal their secrets, or will the team leave with more questions than answers?

programme.title: Most Haunted
programme.desc: The New York Times labeled Bramber in Southern England, the most haunted village. From Bramber Castle's ruins, delve into the tragic tales: starved noble children, medieval lovers' memories, a ghost-solving murder, a lover's accidental killing, and a Victorian author's unfulfilled death wish haunting his hometown.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Labyrinth Lodge in Liverpool in the UK is a haunted house in a cemetery. Originally it was a register office, recording births, deaths and marriages. But it seems some previous residents just don't want to leave. Paranormal investigator Jayne Harris is on hand to capture proof for current owners Sean and Bex, who are hoping to understand more about the strange goings on in their home.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Katy from Mold, in Wales is convinced that her Party Shop is haunted be previous tenants of the 17th Century building. Paranormal investigator Lee Roberts has been enlisted to see if he can capture proof and back up claims that a ghost called Sarah, a young servant girl, is still residing in the premises.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Danny Moss has been charged with investigating a haunted house in Middlesbrough in the UK. Rose grew up in the house in the 1970's and 80s which was believed to have been the site of a fatal fire years earlier. She witnessed her first ghost when she was just 7 years old.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The White Swan pub and hotel in Henley in Arden in the UK is reported to be a haunted hotspot. This former jailhouse with gallows has a gruesome history and owners Maria and Nigel believe a lady of the night who died in mysterious circumstances still roams the corridors.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The Old Picture House in Nottingham in the UK, was a cinema abandoned in 1959. Today it houses a museum of haunted artefacts. Steve and Marie have captured what they believe to be paranormal activity on a hearse dating back to the Victorian era. Intrigued by the findings, we have sent MJ Dickson to investigate and validate their claims.

programme.title: The Haunted Castle
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Ewloe Castle in North Wales, believed to be haunted by ghosts and spirits.

programme.title: Haunted and Cursed Magpie Mines
programme.desc: Haunted Magpie Mines are located in the Peak District of Derbyshire. Believed to be one of the most paranormal mines in the UK. Ghost Dimension investigate claims of paranormal activity and a curse that has been set on to the land. Will a ghost be caught on camera? and will any of the paranormal equipment make contact with the spirit world?

programme.title: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking classes.

programme.title: The Haunted Mill Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Stockport and investigate an abandoned Mil, Weir Mill, said to the most haunted Mill in the UK. Demonic figures haunt anyone that enters. Will the team survive the night with the spirits?

programme.title: I Hear a Baby Crying
programme.desc: The team investigate the Market Hotel in Bolton. Believed to be haunted by the lost soul of a previous landlord and a guest who likes to make herself known. They make contact with spirits from the other side and witness first hand paranormal activity.

programme.title: Shadow Menace Haunting Morley Market - Part 1
programme.desc: Sean heads to the town of Morley to investigate the infamous Morley Market. A place once bustling with people from years gone by, is now haunted by shadow figures and they appear to want to make themselves known.

programme.title: The Night Before the Storm
programme.desc: In this special episode, its the night before Sean and Bex are joined by their celebrity guest and they checkout The Black Horse in Pluckley Village to investigate the paranormal hauntings at the most haunted pub in the UK.

programme.title: Haunted Weir Mill
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team visit Weir Mill, the oldest and most paranormally active mill in Stockport. Dating back to 1790 this mill has seen accidents, suicides, murder and even occult practices. Will the team encounter the spirits or friendly, benevolent children or something darker and more malevolent that lurks within the maze?

programme.title: An Unexpected Haunted Adventure
programme.desc: The team head to Lydiate Abbey to investigate claims of a ghostly white lady and stumble upon a totally hidden gem deep in the woods, which has its own spirits haunting. With hidden priest holes and a building being reclaimed by the land. Be prepared for one of the scariest investigations ever.

programme.title: Witches and Vampires Haunting Saint James Cemetery
programme.desc: St James Cemetery is set behind Liverpool Cathedral and is claimed to be the worlds most haunted, with the remains of over 58,000 people buried at the location and multiple claims of paranormal sightings. Will the team survive the night unscathed? Will they encounter witchcraft or a vampire that is believed to roam the grounds to this very day?

programme.title: The Wheatsheaf Horror
programme.desc: Psychics claim to see the past as if it were unfolding before them. When Suzanna Hadwin visits the Wheatsheaf Pub in North England, she encounters a long-buried mystery. The owners hear whispers and find strange handprints, leading them to use a Ouija board. Their search uncovers evidence of an old murder-hidden behind the very walls of the pub, which soon turns against them.

programme.title: Field of Ghosts
programme.desc: Markie Beason has always sensed spirits in her home, but her family dismisses her fears-until the ghosts shift their focus to her. As the terrifying encounters intensify, Markie grows desperate for answers. When her father finally believes her, he calls in paranormal investigators to uncover the spirits' identities and help bring peace to their haunted home.

programme.title: Angels and Demons
programme.desc: When a demon haunts the home of Maryland single Mom Kathie Sheats , psychics, priests and paranormal investigators fail to resolve the issue. Only Kathie herself can conquer the dark entity ... with the help of an angel.

programme.title: Blood Visions
programme.desc: The Johnson family has found what they consider their perfect home in Michigan. But it turns out to be haunted, and a demon targets their son for possession. Only the power of prayer can restore peace and sanity.

programme.title: The Haunted Victorian
programme.desc: Edwin Gonzalez and Lillian Otero move into a dream Victorian home, but eerie footsteps and slamming doors soon plague them. When Edwin sees a full-body apparition, they seek help. Lillian's behavior darkens as an evil female spirit possesses her. She suffers physical attacks in her sleep, and as the hauntings escalate, they realize escaping may no longer be an option.

programme.title: Vision of Terror
programme.desc: After losing her husband in a tragic accident, Stacy Stowe hears ghostly sounds and assumes it's his spirit-until her daughter insists it's something evil. Dark figures prowl the home, and attacks escalate. A paranormal cleanser brings temporary peace, but a new psychic warns that unless Stacy closes the portal, the evil will never leave.

programme.title: Spirits of the Dead
programme.desc: Joanne and Jim Whitley's dream of running a horse-riding business turns into a nightmare when strange occurrences plague their New Hampshire farm. Their son hears eerie sounds, and Joanne senses a dark presence. As financial struggles mount, their horses fall mysteriously ill. When the spirit turns violent and threatens their child, Joanne calls on a Shamballa master to fight the evil force.

programme.title: Silver Star
programme.desc: Danny and Mike's attempt to find a missing girl leads them to a man with a criminal past; Delinda becomes enamored with the Polyphonic Spree, an unusual musical group, and its leader, Tim DeLaughter.

programme.title: My Beautiful Launderette
programme.desc: Sam learns one of her clients is laundering money for a drug cartel through the resort; Mike is convinced he has met the woman of his dreams and works hard to persuade her to date him.

programme.title: When You Got to Go, You Got to Go
programme.desc: When Ed is kidnapped, Danny and Mike franticly search the city for him, a task made more difficult by Ed refusing to let them call the police or pay the ransom.

programme.title: Sperm Whales and Spearmint Rhinos
programme.desc: A hotel guest is an apparent suicide, but further investigation by Delinda points to murder, so she sends Danny and Ed to search for the killer.

programme.title: The Lie Is Cast
programme.desc: Danny's generous act gets him into trouble with the police, leaving Ed to clean up the mess; Delinda enlists the aid of a singer to convince the chef that the restaurant should be open for lunch.

programme.title: Whale of a Time
programme.desc: A beautiful former co-worker pays a visit to Ed, but her presence puts everyone in danger; when Delinda and Nessa compete for the attentions of a high roller, their friendly competition quickly gets out of hand.

programme.title: Can You See What I See?
programme.desc: Ed decides to shake things up as the casino enters the slow season, so he orders the staff to swap jobs.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Sam's excitement about hosting a billionaire (Dean Cain) at the Montecito turns to dismay when her clients are caught cheating the horse-racing system, requiring Danny to come to her aid.

programme.title: To Protect and Serve Manicotti
programme.desc: When petty mobsters attempt to extort money from a local restaurant owner, Ed asks an old friend, Frank (Sylvester Stallone), to protect the owner.

programme.title: One Nation, Under Surveillance
programme.desc: When Danny's friend, an ex-Marine turned politician, gets caught in a scandal involving a runaway child, he vows to help, but quickly discovers that people are not always who they seem to be.

programme.title: Hit Me!
programme.desc: Ed relies on human ingenuity when cutting-edge technology fails to catch a thief in the act; Mary and Mike intervene when a cheating husband is caught red-handed.

programme.title: Hide and Sneak
programme.desc: Ed suspects that a Gestapo-like police unit has compromised the hotel's security system and is watching everyone, so he enlists Danny and Mike to expose the phantom mole.

programme.title: Letters, Lawyers, and Loose Women
programme.desc: Mary meets her secret admirer; when a philandering hotel guest (Dave Foley) loses his wedding ring at a local brothel, Mike agrees to help him find it.

programme.title: Magic. Carpet. Fred (Maxim Hot 100)
programme.desc: Colorful billionaire Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) returns to the Montecito with his girlfriend (Ashanti); a beguiling magician uses his skills to help Ed catch a slippery thief.

programme.title: Centennial
programme.desc: The new owner of the Montecito plans some big changes to the property and to the personnel.

programme.title: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Ed tries to get the Montecito reopened while working for a new boss and trying to lure back his former staff.

programme.title: Fake the Money and Run
programme.desc: Ed tries to keep the new boss out of the loop while he figures out who has been making counterfeit chips; Danny's accountant suggests he sell his father's house and refers him to an attractive real estate agent (Rachael Leigh Cook).

programme.title: Double Down, Triple Threat
programme.desc: When a card counter's daughter is kidnapped, Danny, Mike and Ed reunite with Dr. Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) to solve the high-stakes crime.

programme.title: Whatever Happened to Seymour Magoon?
programme.desc: Danny and Penny's relationship hits new levels; Jillian sprains her ankle and convinces Ed to walk the family dog at a local show; Mike must rescue Monica from her shower.

programme.title: The Big Ed De-cline
programme.desc: Ed's plan to rid himself of undue stress ends when he discovers he is a victim of identity theft.

programme.title: The Real McCoy
programme.desc: Despite Mike and Mary's warnings, Danny locates the mystery woman who appears in photos with his father and offers to pay her medical expenses.

programme.title: Everything Old Is You Again
programme.desc: Danny has a flashback to 1962 and being director of entertainment at the Jubilee Hotel and Casino.

programme.title: Bold, Beautiful and Blue
programme.desc: Danny, Monica and FBI Agent Portis review the security measures being taken to protect the Kashmir Sapphire, a priceless gemstone on loan and display at the Montecito.

programme.title: Mothwoman
programme.desc: When the Montecito hosts a comic book convention, fans mistake Monica (Lara Flynn Boyle) for the comic book heroine Mothwoman.

programme.title: For Sail by Owner
programme.desc: A stunning change of events thwarts a hostile takeover of the Montecito; a thug mugs Mike, who leaves Danny to seek his revenge.

programme.title: Down and Dirty
programme.desc: During a nationally televised poker tournament, Danny and Mike suspect someone is cheating and investigate security footage, despite protests from the show's producer.

programme.title: Bait and Switch
programme.desc: Danny and Ed must rely on amateur sex-video footage to help them track down the person who stole diamonds from the Montecito during the taping of a music video.

programme.title: The Bitch Is Back
programme.desc: With great fanfare, the Montecito prepares for the grand opening of Wolfgang Puck's restaurant.

programme.title: And Here's Mike With the Weather
programme.desc: The auditor's report shows a $2.9 million discrepancy when the Montecito staff applies for the annual license renewal; Danny's former Marine sergeant (Dale Dye) visits the hotel, and the two wind up in a bar fight.

programme.title: Urban Legends
programme.desc: NASCAR driver Jimmie Johnson acts as a celebrity judge at the Montecito's car show; Danny and Mike find, in a bathtub full of ice, a man with a kidney missing.

programme.title: Coyote Ugly
programme.desc: When Monica's friend, Norma Pitts (Sarah Ann Morris), finds a finger in the Montecito's new buffet, she has everyone worried that she will sue.

programme.title: Lyle & Substance
programme.desc: Danny apprehends a chip thief who claims he met someone who plans to blow up the Montecito.

programme.title: Like a Virgin
programme.desc: Mary nervously plans a wedding for one of Sam's biggest whales; unusual card-counters plague the casino.

programme.title: Cash Springs Eternal
programme.desc: Danny and Mike divide their time between investigating a string of robberies in the residential suites and posing for a beefcake calendar; Jillian panics when her therapist tells her that her marriage sets a bad example for Delinda.

programme.title: All Quiet on the Montecito Front
programme.desc: Danny and Delinda decide to keep their romance a secret; the department heads go on a paintball retreat.

programme.title: Chaos Theory
programme.desc: Ed and Jillian go on a retreat that proves to be anything but peaceful; Danny and Josh deal with a suspicious character who wants to make bets of $1 million per hand.

programme.title: Fidelity, Security, Delivery
programme.desc: Athlete Sasha Cohen stops by the Montecito; Delinda answers Dr. Derek's marriage proposal; Sam and Woody share a romantic weekend together.

programme.desc: Fredrik takes buyers on a Hudson River cruise to interest them in his new West Side development; Luis and a developer embark on a plan to create a massive unit overlooking Central Park, but one of Ryan's clients may stop them dead in their tracks.

programme.title: Don't Touch Me, Bro
programme.desc: Luis tries to lure Ryan back to the negotiating table after the two reach a stalemate over the Central Park South unit; Ryan must salvage a deal that falls through after the buyer is arrested; Fredrik will stop at nothing to impress a client.

programme.title: 50 Shades of Greystone
programme.desc: Luis will do anything to solidify his standing as a major player, even if it means teaming up with a rival; Fredrik receives devastating news; Ryan uses out-of-the-box thinking to come up with a way to lure brokers to an out-of-the-way listing.

programme.title: Bleecker and Bleaker
programme.desc: At the Metropolitan Tower, Luis and Ryan run into complications while co-listing; Ryan's fiancée, Emilia, gets in the middle of things; Fredrik lands a heavenly listing with a hellish downside.

programme.title: Planet of the Capes
programme.desc: Ryan tries the buyers' patience while trying out a new pricing strategy for a downtown duplex; Fredrik promises a buyer something his developer may not be able to deliver; Luis and a new co-lister dig a hole for themselves.

programme.title: No Sleep Till Brooklyn Sells
programme.desc: Fredrik reunites with a former client in the Williamsburg neighborhood; Luis hopes to repair his rocky relationship with a rebellious co-lister; Ryan tackles an enormous townhouse that may be too big for most New Yorkers.

programme.title: Murray Up and Wait
programme.desc: A telephone call breathes new life into a development project, but it comes with a catch Fredrik never saw coming; Ryan bends over backward for a potential buyer but receives nothing in return; Luis gets first dibs on a hot new Tribeca building.

programme.title: Tug of Warhol
programme.desc: For a new development in the NoHo neighborhood, Fredrik summons the spirit of a dead icon; after a failed shot, Luis chases down one of New York City's biggest developers; Ryan picks up a penthouse in the Flatiron District with a difficult co-lister.

programme.title: A More Modern Family
programme.desc: Ryan's relationship with his co-lister hangs by a thread, prompting him to try something new; Luis finds himself caught in the middle while trying to please a married couple; Fredrik hopes a rival will save him after the developer raises prices.

programme.title: Flagg It or Bag It
programme.desc: James and David host a backyard barbecue for their new family-oriented estate; Altman goes after a new modern home in his Bird Streets territory; Flagg tries to find a dream home in historic Hollywood Hills for actress Becca Tobin ("Glee").

programme.title: 24 Hours or Else
programme.desc: James and David experience difficulties with their Santa Monica gem, as the sellers have their own ideas about price and who the buyers should be.

programme.title: Swedish Invasion
programme.desc: James and David work with a long-time client Zach Vella to list an architectural gem, but Fredrik's arrival in Los Angeles is putting the pressure on them to get it sold.

programme.title: Medieval Time Machine
programme.desc: Altman lists a castle in Beverly Ridge; Flagg finds himself opposite Fredrik, trying to negotiate a deal while getting a fair price for his client; James and David are under pressure to get their latest Zach Vella listing sold.

programme.title: One for the 'Gram
programme.desc: Altman throws an epic launch event for a modern with a $48 million price tag and a social media twist; Tracy gets creative to find a buyer for her new WeHo modern; Los Angeles wildfires have a devastating impact on the market.

programme.title: Hollywood Royalty
programme.desc: Altman and Tracy co-list a historic Hollywood estate previously owned by Hollywood legend John Barrymore; James and David go all-in on their new East Coast traditional.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Ben Blakeley
programme.desc: Seemingly a kidnapping, Jayden Parkinson's disappearance garnered national headlines after the young teen went missing after telling friends and family she was pregnant.

programme.title: Tracking Down the Predator
programme.desc: In the wake of a chilling abduction in Remoulins, Nîmes investigators, aided by critical witness testimonies, embarked on a relentless pursuit of a known Belgian offender.

programme.title: Clare Wood
programme.desc: In April 2007, lonely Clare Wood met 40-year-old fairground worker George Appleton online. Initially, it seemed perfect, he appeared reliable and caring. However, her father and brother were wary of him, leading to friction in their relationship.

programme.title: Two Keys to Murder
programme.desc: In Newport Beach, California, millionaire medical innovator Bill McLaughlin is living a luxurious life inside the gated community of Balboa Coves - until he is shot six times in his own kitchen. When the investigation uncovers a sordid story of love affairs and stolen money, authorities think they're closing in on the killer. But a lack of evidence causes the case to go stone cold for 14 years.

programme.title: The Richmond Murders
programme.desc: In 1878, a widow is killed in her own home, and the killer is her own servant; the young servant does not only kill and dismember her employer, she also steals her clothes, her property and her identity.

programme.title: Mary Pearcey
programme.desc: Until its closure in 2016, Madame Tussauds' Chamber of Horrors was one of the museum's oldest and most popular attractions.

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: In the fall of 2013, a 23 years old man, volunteer in the army, is arrested for killing his brother.

programme.title: Employees Busted
programme.desc: Employees busted for breaking the law on the job.

programme.title: Fights & Wild Riots 2
programme.desc: A serial killer gets attacked in a courtroom by the family of one of his victims; a World Trade Organization meeting in Seattle sparks riots; extreme skateboarders clash with authorities.

programme.title: Body on the Shore
programme.desc: A missing woman's body is found washed up on the shore of a tidal estuary; CCTV, DNA and a cryptic note lead investigators to her ex-partner.

programme.title: The Huntington Beach Body
programme.desc: Huntington Beach, 1968. Boys on their way to school discover the brutalized body of a young woman in an oil field. Police are unable to identify her or her killer. It will take 52 years before DNA science is able to solve this double mystery.

programme.title: Carla's Last Valentine's
programme.desc: Valentine's Day, 1974. Carla Walker is raped and killed, leading to a cold case that takes 46 years to crack.

programme.title: Aim to Maim
programme.desc: In Kansas City, Missouri, a married woman falls for a street hustler and pays a devastating price. In Castlerock, Northern Ireland, a married dentist falls for a patient, and comes up with an unusual treatment plan to secure a fresh start.

programme.title: Faking It
programme.desc: In Ventura, California, a wife goes missing after a mysterious arrest, while in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, thousands of dollars stored in shoe boxes provides a vital clue to solve a murder.

programme.title: Point Blank
programme.desc: In Boone County, Iowa, a man on a farm believes that he's shot himself but can't figure out how, and in Pryor, Oklahoma, an affair turns deadly resulting in a house fire.

programme.title: Body of Evidence
programme.desc: In Rocky Mount, North Carolina, a mortician falls in love in his funeral parlor, while in Mustang, Oklahoma, a sexual obsession turns deadly.

programme.title: Deadly Games
programme.desc: In Westchester County, New York, a wife begins a fling with a co-worker which leads to an erotic game with a violent conclusion. In Wellesley, Massachusetts, a murder in a public park appears be the work of a serial killer.

programme.title: Officer's Vehicle Hit
programme.desc: Hazen, Ark., officers get hit while in pursuit; Richland County, S.C., officers search for missing kids.

programme.title: A Rough Part of Town
programme.desc: A female fugitive is located at a bar in one of the roughest parts of town; the Bounty Hunters must get in and out as fast as possible. Bounty Hunters track a crack addict fugitive through phone numbers off a stolen calling card.

programme.title: Gang-Infested
programme.desc: The Bounty Hunter locates the fugitive after a lengthy stake out in a friend's garage. While unsuccessfully tracking a female fugitive for almost a week, the Bounty Hunters receive a tip from a friend.

programme.title: Two Keys to Murder
programme.desc: In Newport Beach, California, millionaire medical innovator Bill McLaughlin is living a luxurious life inside the gated community of Balboa Coves - until he is shot six times in his own kitchen. When the investigation uncovers a sordid story of love affairs and stolen money, authorities think they're closing in on the killer. But a lack of evidence causes the case to go stone cold for 14 years.

programme.title: The Mystery of Missing Margaret Fleming
programme.desc: The story of a teen named Margaret, who vanished while in the care of her father's family friends following his death.

programme.title: Takedown with Chris Hansen
programme.desc: Over the past two decades, Chris Hansen's investigations have led to hundreds of would-be sex criminals being stopped in their tracks. Amazingly, after 500 arrests and hundreds of millions of video views, men continue to try to meet children online. So, his mission continues.

programme.title: Murder of Taylor Wright
programme.desc: Private investigator Taylor Wright vanished before a court case with her ex-husband. Detectives later uncovered that her best friend Ashley McArthur murdered Taylor after stealing money Taylor expected returned the day she disappeared.

programme.title: Obstruction
programme.desc: Woman with expired license plate tags is "done paying taxes".

programme.title: Hotel Meltdown
programme.desc: Officers respond to a 911 call from hotel staff regarding a demanding woman.

programme.title: Sunk in the Lake
programme.desc: A drought at a French lake reveals a sunken Toyota holding the body of a U.K. expat who's been missing for two years; her controlling husband becomes police's prime suspect.

programme.title: Will I Be Accepted?
programme.desc: As freedom looms for some and time stretches for others, one question lingers in the minds of the inmates in Institution A4 - will I be accepted?

programme.title: Henry Steiger
programme.desc: Last seen at her daughter's first birthday party but not reported missing until over 4 months later, Cassandra Robinson's disappearance quickly turned into a murder investigation when her body was discovered hidden in a barrel in a storage unit.

programme.title: No Obvious Motive
programme.desc: Muriel Reigada's abduction triggered a massive search by Orleans police, lasting 31 days and seven hours before culprits were identified.

programme.title: Lorraine Long
programme.desc: After the death of her husband, 62-year-old Lorraine Long decided to try online dating. In 2009, she met Robert Wiesner, and their relationship quickly flourished. However, friends and family had concerns about Lorraine's new partner.

programme.title: House of Lies
programme.desc: Keith Gentry is shot in his sleep in the middle of the night, and left to be found by his wife, Darlene. The Texas Rangers are then brought in to investigate the murder, wading through discrepancies and lies as they narrow in on their suspect.

programme.title: The Bermondsey Horror
programme.desc: In 1849, a man suddenly disappeared in Bermondsey, discovering that he had been brutally murdered.

programme.title: In The Shadow Of Jack
programme.desc: At the time of Jack The Ripper, London was home to some of the most terrible individuals the city has ever seen.

programme.title: False Pretense
programme.desc: More than a year after the death of Harmonie Marin, her boyfriend is arrested and accused of her murder.

programme.title: Employees Busted
programme.desc: Employees busted for breaking the law on the job.

programme.title: Dangerous Drivers 3
programme.desc: A speeding drunk driver slams into a pedestrian; an elderly driver parks her car inside a DMV office; a man driving under the influence becomes trapped under a truck.

programme.title: Body in the River
programme.desc: When a fisherman is murdered and dumped in the River Thames, forensics link three men to the scene; but evidence lost in the river makes convicting his killers challenging.

programme.title: The Mystery of the Headphones
programme.desc: A killer evades justice for the murder of Diana Hanson for 38 years until genetic genealogy can identify him.

programme.title: Stabbing in Sacramento
programme.desc: 40 years after the sexual assault and murder of 20-year-old Robin Brooks in Sacramento, California, determined cold case detectives collaborate with scientists using revolutionary forensic techniques to identify her killer and put him behind bars.

programme.title: The Price of Love
programme.desc: In Hewitt, TX aspiring minister Matt Baker, 34, returns home to discover his wife Keri, 31, has overdosed on pills and alcohol. Matt claims he tied her up for sex then left to rent a movie.

programme.title: Saints and Sinners
programme.desc: A wicked church minister, and a teacher falls for a student.

programme.title: Steamy Lessons
programme.desc: A pregnant wife killed execution style and an EMT intent on taking a life.

programme.title: Body Park
programme.desc: Two mysterious New Jersey murder cases where the victims are found in parks.

programme.title: Dead Pool
programme.desc: Two Pennsylvania murder cases involving cheating spouses with evil minds.

programme.title: Intoxicated Motorcyclist
programme.desc: Daytona Beach officers search for a wanted man; Indian River Co. officers look for an intoxicated motorcyclist.

programme.title: Flight Risk
programme.desc: With a D.U.I., this fugitive is a habitual traffic offender and has numerous warrants out for "failure to appear". With charges of intent to sell methamphetamine, a fugitive poses as a high flight risk.

programme.title: The Bad-Tempered Boyfriend
programme.desc: Erin Chorney, 18, vanished. Police suspected her abusive boyfriend, Michael Bridges. Undercover officers got Bridges to confess; he's arrested.

programme.title: Nicole White
programme.desc: When young mother Nicole White met Jonathan Harris online, he seemed like her ideal rugged man. CCTV from their second date at Jeepers Bar showed a great start, but Harris's mood changed. They drove off in Nicole's car, but she never made it home.

programme.title: The Campus Killer
programme.desc: Katherine Foster found shot at UA. Campus guard suspected, then cleared. Cold case reopens 20 years later after confession by a friend during AA.

programme.title: Donna Perry
programme.desc: In Spokane three prostitutes were violently killed. Evidence suggested they'd been approached by a man wanting sex who had then used great strength to subdue and kill them. They had the suspects DNA, but detectives had no idea who the killer was.

programme.title: Murder of Clark Calquhoun
programme.desc: When 53-year-old Clark Calquhoun mysteriously vanished, his family feared the worst. A relentless investigation eventually uncovered the horrifying crime behind his disappearance and brought long-awaited answers.

programme.title: Drunk at the Airport
programme.desc: A man trying to board a flight is stopped by staff when they observed apparent signs of intoxication.

programme.title: Hotel Meltdown
programme.desc: Officers respond to a 911 call from hotel staff regarding a demanding woman.

programme.title: Amy Fisher
programme.desc: In 1992, 17-year-old Amy Fisher became known as the Long Island Lolita when she shot her lover, Joey Buttafuocco's, wife in the head. The victim, Mary Jo, gives her first-hand account of the shooting and what she thinks of Amy and Joey today.

programme.title: Surviving Prison
programme.desc: How do inmates survive within the strict confines of Singapore's only women's prison?

programme.title: Rachel and Diane Staudte
programme.desc: This episode examines the notorious "Antifreeze Murders" that took place in 2012. Diane and Rachel Staudte murdered two members of their family and attempted to kill a third before police got involved.

programme.title: Masons of Horror
programme.desc: Branded as the "Builders of Horror," the disappearance of Jocelyne and Jean-Claude Saint Aubert sent shockwaves through their tranquil neighborhood.

programme.title: Carly Ryan
programme.desc: Carly Ryan thought she'd found her dream boy in 18-year-old musician Brandon Kane. They chatted online for 18 months under her mother's watch. Unbeknownst to them, both Brandon and his stepfather were personas created by 50-year-old Garry Newman.

programme.title: Summer of Fear
programme.desc: Random shootings, rapes, and robberies leave almost all of the residents of Phoenix, Arizona scared. On top of that, authorities are seemingly powerless against serial killers that are waging a war of terror on the streets of this Arizona city.

programme.title: Finding Dr Crippen
programme.desc: Having killed his wife and buried her in the basement, Dr Crippen believed he had escaped on a ship to Canada.

programme.title: The Brides In The Bath Killer
programme.desc: George Smith had many aliases. He needed them for his many wives who he would soon murder in order to claim the inheritance.

programme.title: Deady Vengeance
programme.desc: On September 2nd 2015, the body of 2 years-old Méline is found in her home. Her father confesses to the murder.

programme.title: Rachel and Diane Staudte
programme.desc: This episode examines the notorious "Antifreeze Murders" that took place in 2012. Diane and Rachel Staudte murdered two members of their family and attempted to kill a third before police got involved.

programme.title: All in the Family
programme.desc: Relatives of cops have unpleasant run-ins with law enforcement.

programme.title: Maximum Mayhem
