programme.title: Lost Souls
programme.desc: This week TAPS is in the Pacific Northwest to investigate former insane asylum, the Northern State Hospital. Jason and Grant meet the skeptical caretaker, who wishes to dispel the stories of ghostly activity, but when the team is confronted with strange sounds and shocking evidence, they are left to determine whether or not there might be a little truth to the local tales. Then TAPS heads to Seattle's Underground Tunnels, a subterranean labyrinth below the city streets.

programme.title: Spirits of San Francisco
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS investigates the historic Presidio in San Francisco. Both employees and members of the military have reported ghostly encounters at this former military fortress. Strange tapping noises, phantom footsteps and sightings of a ghostly female apparition in Spanish attire are just a few of the chilling stories. The TAPS team is left to wonder if there are former soldiers still walking the halls.

programme.title: Ghostly Houseguest
programme.desc: On this episode TAPS is called in to help out a family with an extremely sensitive case. When Krista Gibbons lost her sister she quickly took in her young niece, but soon after the family began hearing the sounds of footsteps in the hall and even witnessed the sight of a black limbless mass wandering throughout the house. The family wondered if their loved one had returned or if this ominous figure was something more sinister.

programme.title: Houses of the Holy
programme.desc: For the first time ever TAPS comes to the aid of a priest whose home is a source of unexplained activity. Both Reverend Jennings and her parishioners have heard footsteps in the hall ways, the sounds of crying children and have seen objects moving by themselves. An unusual mark scorched into her bedroom floor baffles the team.

programme.title: Salem
programme.desc: TAPS travels to the infamous town of Salem, MA for a pair of baffling cases to uncover what vengeful spirits might still roam this site of centuries-old witch trials and executions. The Lyceum Restaurant was formerly the home of Bridget Bishop, the first woman in Salem executed for suspected witchcraft. Witnesses report frequently seeing the apparition of a woman dressed in period clothing.

programme.title: Sanaturium Live Results
programme.desc: This week, TAPS revealsinvestigation highlights and startling evidence captured during the six hour live broadcast from The Waverly Hills Sanatorium. WhenTAPS, along ECW wrestlerElijah Burke,made a return trip to thehospital,nothing could prepare them for what they found.During the investigation Jason and Grant attemptto communicate with the spirit of a young boy who roamsthe halls.

programme.title: Revelations
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS sits down with Destination Truth's Josh Gates for an in-depth discussion with TAPS. Jason and Grant will discuss how TAPS came to be and will provide insight and answers to the most chilling and baffling cases. They will talk about their favorite investigations and delve into some hot button issues - like Steve's biggest fears. Then the team takes time to answer important questions from viewers.

programme.title: Fort Miffin
programme.desc: In the first episode of a brand new season of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the historic battle field of Ft. Mifflin to uncover the truth behind some ghostly claims. Ft. Mifflin was once the site of bloody battles in both Revolutionary and Civil Wars. Today, visitors and employees tell chilling tales of their brushes with the afterlife. Some claim to have seen apparitions of soldiers, while others report hearing a woman's terrified scream coming from an empty room.

programme.title: Two to Tango
programme.desc: An urgent call from Dave Tango's father sets the scene for the next case. William Tango, an ex-cop and amateur ghost hunter, was baffled by unexplainable events he experienced on a recent trip to the Burlington County Prison in Mt. Holly, New Jersey. The TAPS team soon discovers William is not alone. Once the site of numerous executions, the prison maintains an unmistakable feeling of dread.

programme.title: Words From Beyond
programme.desc: For the past nine years unexplainable sounds at the Clapp Library have put Jacques, the night custodian, on edge. The unmistakable sound of books sliding off of shelves and dark shadows moving through the stacks are just some of the eerie events plaguing the library. Desperate to prove to other employees that he's not going crazy, Jacque calls in TAPS to find some answers. During the investigation Jason and Grant hear a strange sound coming from the balcony area.

programme.title: The Fear Cage
programme.desc: This week the TAPS team heads to the historic Confederate campgrounds of the Cashtown Inn. This old hotel was once the crossroad for Confederate troops on their way to the battle of Gettysburg. The basement of the hotel was later used as a makeshift triage unit, where injured soldiers were often subject to barbaric and crude amputations. Today, hotel guests report countless bizarre experiences, from unexplained sounds in the middle of the night to apparitions roaming the hotel.

programme.title: Ghostly Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Wright-Patterson Air Force Base
programme.desc: This week, when overwhelming reports of paranormal activity plague the Wright - Patterson Air Force Base, TAPS gets enlisted to help the military. For the past ten years, the air force base has been host to strange experiences. Recent renovations at the base have resulted in escalating activity. At the Arnold House, personnel have reported hearing children's voices and footsteps walking up the stairs. And, in Building 70, ghostly apparitions have put everyone on edge.

programme.title: Ghostly Conversation
programme.desc: This week, TAPS heads to the Mt. Washington Hotel in New Hampshire to be the first paranormal group to investigate this legendary resort. The expansive property sits on top of a massive limestone deposit, known to be a catalyst for paranormal activity. The caretakers here have experienced everything from doors that open and close by themselves to full body apparitions.

programme.title: Spirits of the Old West
programme.desc: On this episode, TAPS saddles up and heads west to investigate the legendary Goldfield Hotel in Goldfield, Nevada. This hotel from a bygone era is host to several stories of murder and tragedy. The horrific story of Elizabeth, a woman who was chained to radiator and left for dead, has left many to believe her troubled spirit still haunts the halls. While investigating the second floor, Jason and Grant pursue a solid black mass darting through doorways.

programme.title: Haunted Asylum
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the abandoned Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum. Built in 1858, the asylum was able to accommodate over two thousand patients ranging from deranged violent criminals to the children of the clinically insane. The chilling reports of unexplained sounds, shadowy figures and violent attacks are thought to be the result of restless and tortured spirits still roaming the halls.

programme.title: House of Spirits
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Widow's Watch
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Garden State Ghost
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Fort Delaware
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: Iron Island
programme.desc: Plumbers, Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson moonlight as Ghost Hunters, leading an intrepid team called T.A.P.S. (The Atlantic Paranormal Society) through investigations of churches, inns and infamous jails.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Simsbury, CT to the old Pettibone Tavern to solve the legendary story of the ghost of Abigail. The tavern has been a stop off for George Washington, Harriett Beacher Stowe, John Adams. It was used as a stop off for slaves during the underground railroad. Pettibone's daughter Abigail, was married to a sailor.

programme.title: The Boy in the Brothel
programme.desc: TAPS heads to North Kingstown, Rhode Island to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a local restaurant. Linda, the skeptical owner of the Hoofinfeathers Carriage Inn, is hoping to uncover the truth behind the bizarre stories plaguing her establishment. The reports of disembodied voices and phantom-like apparitions have frightened some of her guests and terrorized her staff.

programme.title: Speaking with the Dead
programme.desc: This week, TAPS returns to Buffalo, NY to investigate the abandoned remains of the Buffalo Central Terminal. Once lively, it was a hub of transportation, but in 1979, the last train left the station and the terminal closed its doors for good. Today, the terminal has started to undergo substantial renovations which some believe stirred up the ghostly entities that dwell there.

programme.title: Ghost of the Sunshine State
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Ocala, Florida to investigate an old inn. The Inn has seen numerous stories from a housekeeper being knocked and held down on the floor to the sighting of a cigar smoking man. Full-bodied apparitions have been spotted everywhere and employees have mentioned on several occasions tripping and falling down the stairs only to be stopped in mid-fall by something and saved from crashing through the wall or window.

programme.title: Oak Alley Plantation
programme.desc: TAPS heads to New Orleans to investigate an old Creole Plantation in the heart of the bayou. Oak Alley Plantation was settled by French settlers and became a booming operation that produced sugar cane and pecans. In the alley of oak trees the sounds of a carriage is heard coming up the lane and sometimes even dust blows up giving the appearance that a carriage is moving towards the home. This is a place where rich history is surrounded by the grim realities of life way back when.

programme.title: Bottled Spirits
programme.desc: This week, a frightened, young mother asks TAPS to help her terrorized son. The first time Heather brought her son Aiden home she noticed what sounded like a man whispering coming through on his radio. This home has been replaced with ghostly shadows and toys that inexplicably turn themselves on at night.

programme.title: Home Town Haunts
programme.desc: This week, TAPS follows up a TAPS Family investigation that may have turned up the paranormal activity in a residential home to 11. Troy LeBlanc's 19th century 4400 sq.ft. Victorian home is with two separate living quarters-Troy lives in the upstairs portion, his parents downstairs. When he first bought the house, there were constant footsteps coming from all over the house and doors would fly open and hit Troy.

programme.title: U.S.S. Hornet
programme.desc: TAPS heads to The Bay area to investigate an aircraft carrier rumored to be the most haunted ship in the Navy, the USS Hornet. A person supposedly committed suicide in the room and a 75-pound wrench was moved by something not human. It is said; on the main hangar there is a helicopter that served in Vietnam. It is rumored that the pilot still walks out of it and then disappears. There are all types of paranormal activity throughout this ship.

programme.title: Live Halloween Results: Haunted Farmhouse
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Topsfield, Massachusetts to investigate an old haunted farmhouse. The owner, Linda is afraid to sleep in her old home that she has raised 3 children in. In the attic, a hand touched Linda, and she fell down the stairs. Doors shut and lock by themselves trapping people. They yell for help, but know one hears them. During the investigation, Jason and Grant have hanger thrown at them twice.

programme.title: All Access
programme.desc: Fresh off the success of the 2008 live Halloween investigation of Fort Delaware, Josh Gates hosts the second roundtable discussion with the members of TAPS. Sitting in the Soldiers' Barracks of Fort Delaware, Josh revisits old shows and asks questions about the technology, techniques, and future of TAPS. Among many other things, we hear about Steve's penchant for touching anything he sees, Tango's inability to turn down a dare, and the correct way to operate a K2 meter.

programme.title: Recycled Souls
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Clovis, California to investigate a run down Sanitarium. Joining the team will be a fellow TAPS member from Northern California, Amy Bruni who has investigated here before. Reports of shadows appear to come right at you only to disappear. During renovations, 911 calls would mysteriously manifest from the home only to not have any phones to speak of in the whole building.

programme.title: Spirits on the Water
programme.desc: TAPS goes to the Maritime Museum of San Diego to investigate the oldest active ship in the world, the Star of India, and her slipmate, the steam ferryboat Berkeley. The Star of India was built back in 1863 on the Isle of Man, originally christened as the Euterpe. On her first voyage, to India, the iron windjammer suffered a collision and her crew mutinied. The second trip didn't go even that well - she was trapped in a cyclone and her first captain died at sea.

programme.title: Portmouth Harbor Light House
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Portsmouth Harbor Lighthouse and Fort Constitution on Coast Guard Property. Caption Joshua card, an old lighthouse keeper, haunts the walkway to the lighthouse wearing a pea coat and hat. Near the powder magazine there has been sightings of a green mist where 14 people died in a massive forth of July explosion. The scene is historic and it's rumored that their spirits still haunt the fort.

programme.title: Betsy Ross House
programme.desc: A family living in a Revolutionary War era house in Pennsylvania fears for their child and urgently calls on the TAPS team for help. Jason and Grant have some extreme K2 hits and their own first hand experience with a shaking bed to confirm the many frightening claims. They leave the Hannum family with tools to help them deal with the entities that share their home

programme.title: Star Island
programme.desc: The TAPS team braves the wintery waters of the Atlantic to investigate Star Island off of the coast of Portsmouth, NH. Founded as a fishing village in the 1600's the island is ripe with activity and home to a suicide pact gone wrong. Jason and Grant collect some shocking EVP's and are joined by Kristyn Gartland who takes on the challenge of investigating one of the most dangerous claims.

programme.title: Edith Wharton Estate
programme.desc: TAPS is the first team to investigate The Mount in Lenox, MA, the astounding estate of famous author Edith Wharton. Claims of a jealous spirit, a crouching apparition, disembodied screams, and countless reports of footsteps are just some of the many reports haunting the century-old site. The TAPS team is challenged to cover all of the ground and to find out if Edith Wharton herself remains on the estate she once considered her retreat.

programme.title: Club Dead
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels south to Ybor City, Florida to the historic Cuban Club. Once the center of Cuban social life, the commemorated building is now the center of paranormal activity. While investigating Grant makes contact with an entity in the theatre and Britt Griffith joins the team in gathering enough evidence to confirm the club is still active with ghosts.

programme.title: Soul Searching
programme.desc: For the first time ever, TAPS revisits Belcourt Castle in Newport, Rhode Island to investigate claims surrounding a deceased friend. It's been ten years since TAPS investigated the 19th century castle and they are back with more sophisticated equipment to tackle old and new claims that persist in the manor. While investigating Jason and Grant catch a thermal hit that defies explanation and Kris and Amy catch an EVP that could be the ghost of former castle owner Mr. Tinney himself.

programme.title: Titanic Terror
programme.desc: TAPS gets on board the Titanic Exhibit at the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta to investigate paranormal claims that have traveled around the world with the artifacts. A TAPS family member group reached out to the team to determine if it's really paranormal activity, or just the tragic tale of the sinking ship that haunts the exhibit. A unique challenge for the team, Kris questions how to approach the case and Jason and Grant encounter some physical contact with an invisible force.

programme.title: Crossing Over
programme.desc: TAPS calls in the GHI team to investigate the Spalding Inn, a historic property in Whitefield, New Hampshire owned by Jason and Grant. For over 80 years, numerous guests have reported seeing mysterious black masses, hearing strange voices, and being touched by something not visible. During their investigation, GHI team members Robb and Dustin chase a mysterious force through the kitchen, while Barry and Joe confront an elusive entity in the carriage house.

programme.title: Garden State Asylum
programme.desc: The TAPS team travels to New Jersey to investigate the infamous Essex County Hospital. The century-old site is reportedly haunted by some of the estimated 10,000 souls that died there. Numerous witnesses have reported seeing the apparition of a nurse, hearing voices calling for help, and even being physically grabbed. While investigating the miles of tunnels that run underneath the hospital, Jason and Grant capture a thermal image which defies explanation.

programme.title: Inhuman Entity
programme.desc: The TAPS team answers a call from a family in Blackstone, Massachusetts being plagued by a demonic entity. The Ladouceurs had always experienced strange events in their beloved home, but once major renovations began the benign activity turned violent. During the investigation, the team experiences a series of bizarre encounters including Jason being physically attacked.

programme.title: I Am Not Guilty
programme.desc: The TAPS team investigates the home of Dr. Samuel Mudd, an alleged conspirator to the assassination of Abraham Lincoln. Mudd was convicted for his role in the plot even though the evidence was highly circumstantial. Today, apparitions and other strange activity have been witnessed inside, and directly outside, the house. Through their investigation, the team uncovers evidence that Mudd may be trying to prove his innocence from beyond the grave.

programme.title: Civil War Spirits
programme.desc: The site of the bloodiest battle of the Revolutionary War sets the stage for an unforgettable investigation by TAPS. For decades, residents and visitors of Thornbury Farm have experienced horrifying events including the voice of a moaning child and the apparition of a soldier with a bloody limb. The team's overnight investigation yields shocking findings, including direct contact with a paranormal presence.

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: TAPS calls in Bruce Tango, father of Dave Tango, to help investigate a place close to his heart, the Union County Courthouse, a historic property in Elizabeth, NJ, Over the years, many staff members have reported phones ringing without anyone on the lines and seeing apparitions roaming the halls who is known to be of Hannah Coldwell or the four men who died at the hands of capital punishment, who haunt the halls of these historic building.

programme.title: Little Drummer Boy
programme.desc: TAPS has received an urgent call for help from a Chicago community center whose patrons are being chased away by a variety of menacing spirits. The Benton House is a historic set of two buildings that have served the city of Chicago for a century. Through the years, a number of residents have expired on the property from devastating illness.

programme.title: A Bat Out of Hell
programme.desc: This week TAPS heads to Thousand Island, NY to investigate a 4-acre private island and is joined by the " King of Rock and Roll" himself, Meatloaf. The 4-acre private island owned by the Claudia family houses a four-story, ten-bedroom mansion and a three-story, seven-bedroom boathouse. The immediate family of six resides in the boathouse while the mansion serves as guest quarters for visitors. The property has been in the family for fifty years and has always had a haunted history.

programme.title: Glimmer Men
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship. The USS Salem spent decades sailing the oceans of the world as a witness to untold death and damage. In 1953, a large earthquake struck the Ionian Islands in Greece, completely devastating the communities and killing hundreds. The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

programme.title: Fort Henry
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

programme.title: Congress Theatre
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Hauntings
programme.desc: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

programme.title: New Hampshire Gothic
programme.desc: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

programme.title: Pensacola Lighthouse
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Mark Twain House
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Unexplained Phenomena
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Hindenburg Crash Site
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Alcatraz Island
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Fort Ticonderoga
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Shamrock Spirits
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Phantom of Jersey
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Touched By Evil
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Bee Hive
programme.desc: Three women face financial woes and look to dealing for local drug lord Zeus. Jealousy, intimidation, and greed set in, when Zeus sees that they are selling and pushing faster than he ever could and suspects they are cutting in on him.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Shotlanta
programme.desc: Mozzy, driven by a desire to lift his family out of poverty in Jamaica, emigrates to Atlanta. He quickly rises in the ranks of the city's drug trade, determined to achieve wealth and security for his mother and sister. However, his ruthless pursuit of success puts him on a dangerous path, where the line between ambition and destruction blurs.

programme.title: Boyz for Life
programme.desc: When the notorious "Fufu: The Furious Frenchmen" steals Escobar's last stash from the LAPD evidence room, mismatched detectives Larry and Bernie are on the case. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect witness Julia, navigating LAPD bureaucracy and a cast of quirky characters. This action-comedy blends thrilling chases, unexpected romance, and heartwarming moments of unlikely friendship, proving that even in the face of international villainy, laughter and brotherhood can prevail.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert, but is hindered by her reckless mother Shonte. When the opportunity arises for both her and her mother to go, they're surprised to find out they have been invited to meet and greet with her favorite artist. What would be a dream of joy, quickly turns into a horrific nightmare.

programme.title: Flew'd Out
programme.desc: Tiara is an up and coming social media influencer after going viral for posting a mans reaction online after denying him sex. In an attempt to grow her online profile, she accepts a date from a man named Josiah for an out of town excursion. Over time, Josiah's intentions become more elaborate, deranged, and sinister. Will Tiara make it out alive?

programme.title: Lacee: Rise 2 the Top
programme.desc: After a run in the girl group LACEE, Karin decides to step out on her own as a solo artist. As she preps for her solo debut, a former lover brings out a new artist that will compete, for the reigning spot as the new R&B diva.

programme.title: Battered Emotions
programme.desc: Rasheada has accepted that her battle with breast cancer is inevitable but her spiritual fight is still as strong as ever. She continues her upbeat facade for friends and family, but is unsure how long it will be until she can no longer compete with her emotional life's journey. Her sister, Tara, and her best friend, Bunny, struggle with their own issues of inner demons and domestic violence, while trying to support Rasheada through her battle.

programme.title: Risk it All
programme.desc: Sierra, a gifted but overlooked painter, struggles to balance her artistic dreams with the reality of a stable life alongside her devoted but practical husband, Marcus. When a powerful and seductive art collector offers her the recognition she's always craved, Sierra is drawn into a world where ambition blurs moral lines and desire turns dangerous. As passion, obsession, and betrayal collide, she must decide how much she's truly willing to sacrifice to be seen.

programme.title: Deadly Squatters
programme.desc: Eugene and Laura return home from vacation to find that two young siblings have taken up residence in their home, and have now claimed legal rights as squatters. Forced to share their home with two strangers, they must play their wicked games and survive psychological terror as the legal system takes its time.

programme.title: A Love Letter to the Beatles
programme.desc: This joyous, fan-funded documentary celebrates The Beatles' enduring legacy through the eyes of their global fanbase. Eight years in the making, it traces their journey from The Quarrymen to global icons, exploring how their music transcends generations and borders, uniting fans and offering profound meaning.

programme.title: A Deadly Friend
programme.desc: When Carmen meets a new friend at school named Magic, she helps raise her spirits and allows her to stand up for herself. When her single father Drew starts seeing the school principal, Magic convinces Carmen to disrupt their relationship, pulling the veil on Magic's sinister nature.

programme.title: Her Best Revenge
programme.desc: After a tragic death, five fraternity brothers reunite at a vacation home, while the shadow of a death from their past lingers over them. A mysterious figure begins to send them threatening messages. Their secrets and loyalties are put to the test and they must uncover the truth about what happened that night five years ago.

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Blake, a man on the verge of marriage who becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of deception and revenge orchestrated by his vengeful ex, London. As their past resurfaces, he is forced to confront hidden secrets and navigate London's sinister manipulations, leading to explosive confrontations and heart-pounding suspense.

programme.title: The Kitty Hallow Killer
programme.desc: A serial killer is on the loose in Houston killing pedophiles and rapists. When Mason and Jessica get into a horrible car accident on their wedding day, Jessica wakes up with no memory of her life or even her husband. As her memories start to come back in pieces, she is afraid that her husband, Mason, could be The Kitty Hallow Killer.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Makin Moves
programme.desc: No matter how hard you try to make it out the streets, something always tries to pull you back in.

programme.title: Homeboys
programme.desc: Two young men grew up together with childhood goals. They graduated college and tried to begin their professional lives. When one of the homeboys decided to take matters into his own hands. The situation caused the only family he has to have targets on their backs, and it is only a matter of time before things go left.

programme.title: The Betrayal 3: Neva Ending
programme.desc: Blood is not always thicker than water, and not all friends are as loyal as you think. Four different relationships display love, hurt, and betrayal.

programme.title: My Plus Size Bachelorette
programme.desc: Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart. With her friends rallying around her, they encourage Symone to embrace her single status and embark on a journey of self-discovery and love.

programme.title: Knee Deep The Series: Gotti's World
programme.desc: Gotti, a rising kingpin in Dallas , looks to restructure his organization by adding women to his leadership

programme.title: Gimme the Loot
programme.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman's club, "Gimme the Loot" that's funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if "The Loot" is really worth it.

programme.title: Love Kills
programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Trouble
programme.desc: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Ceceilius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam's jealousy spirals into a dangerous obsession, fueled by terrifying dreams and a mysterious woman, Robin. With a wedding on the horizon and secrets unraveling, love and betrayal collide, leading to a shocking conclusion where nothing is as it seems.

programme.title: Bloodguilt
programme.desc: David and best friend Uriah run a marketing firm together. When he meets Uriah's wife Bathsheba, he begins a dangerous affair that could unravel everything the two friends have built.

programme.title: Room Available
programme.desc: When Emily rents a room from a seemingly kind landlord, she discovers his house hides deadly secrets - including past tenants, jealous lovers, and a dark obsession that may cost her life.

programme.title: All Natural
programme.desc: A man with bad luck in relationships finally meets Mrs. Right, but she makes a hair-raising decision that challenges him to love her through the thick and thin.

programme.title: Kingdom Men
programme.desc: Pastor Gerald's job is on the line if he doesn't increase the attendance of the men in the church. He decides to have a men's retreat hoping it will fix everything. Little did he know that he's in for the fight of his life. He realizes God didn't call him to increase the men at the church but help them.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Tamar has been called to become a minister, and for most, this would be an honorable moment, but for Tamar, it is the worst thing that could happen. Tamar is the daughter of prominent Deacon Jessup, and is a lesbian. Taught that her desires are not that of God, Tamar has suppressed them for the last 16 years and has never dated a woman. When the Future Minister's Ministry opens for a new class, Tamar finds herself falling for the only other woman in the class.

programme.title: Love and Coffee
programme.desc: The love is hot when Breanna meets coffee shop owner Malcom, but his fear of commitment might put it on ice.

programme.title: Da Neighborhood Dopemane
programme.desc: Struggling with his finances working as a mechanic, CrimMane chooses the dope track as his side hustle, until a client offers him a dangerous proposition.

programme.title: Don't Shoot
programme.desc: After the unarmed shooting of William King, a college bound black teen, by two white officers, a city is on fire as it seeks justice in these times of racial division.

programme.title: For All Have Sinned
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, Mano embarks on a violent path that stems from his grief and causes him to spiral. He lives by the mantra of Romans 3:23 "for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God." When a local church members attempts to reach him, he finds a way to navigate his pain and grief.

programme.title: Together Again
programme.desc: Draya finds out that even a therapist needs a therapist when Dr. Serena pays her an unexpected visit; the ladies are blackmailed at the penthouse.

programme.title: Got Til' It's Gone
programme.desc: After her visit with Dr. Serena, Draya is ready to end the penthouse project, but not before more drama ensues.

programme.title: Feedback
programme.desc: Left to rot, Dr. Draya Logan is on a mission to gain her freedom while simultaneously keeping tabs on Gina, Jordan, and Syleena.

programme.title: Control
programme.desc: Draya gives Mayor Dupri an ultimatum that could grant her the freedom she desires, changing everything for the women.

programme.title: Come Back to Me
programme.desc: Draya is back, and trying to move on, but finds herself revisiting her past life when she gets a special visitor.

programme.desc: With her career in shambles, Dr. Draya Logan launches The Penthouse Project, inviting three high-profiled wives to use her penthouse for extramarital affairs.

programme.title: Miss You Much
programme.desc: When Draya finds out what Linc has done to Jordan, she rallies the women together for a fail-proof plan involving Mona Dee.

programme.title: Son of a Gun
programme.desc: In the midst of planning for her new show, Draya finds herself at odds with the one person who has had her back through it all.

programme.desc: The women struggle with a lack of revenue; Natasha makes a sweet deal to avoid a pitfall on a big case; Miranda falls in love with Tina's ex fiancé who is also her dentist.

programme.title: MeToo
programme.desc: A huge movie star comes to the office to defend himself against allegations of misconduct involving a hot young actress; Tina works on her Facebook obsession; Trixie receives a prophecy from the heavens above.

programme.title: Women's Appreciation Day
programme.desc: Natasha plans the first annual Woman's Appreciation Day with the girls; a vicious war erupts with the female lawyers next door over Natasha's missing lucky stapler.

programme.title: Baby Fever
programme.desc: Miranda believes she may be pregnant; the girls attend mothering classes; Tina decides to compete for a good-looking man's affections by getting serious about fitness.

programme.title: Love Tree
programme.desc: Natasha is smitten by a handsome tow truck driver named Hands; Trixie struggles with anger management.

programme.title: How Low Can You Go?
programme.desc: Natasha's big limbo cruise ship trial begins; a judge tries to get close to Trixie; Tina gets serious about fitness.

programme.title: Grapes of Wrath
programme.desc: Lacey has mastered the art of the deal, but as she builds influence, she's also making rivals on both sides of the law; as the lines of her business blur, one mishap or unexpected event may be all it takes for her operation to crumble.

programme.title: Suspicious Vineyards
programme.desc: Othello and the twin enforcers meet with the billionaire husband of Daniel's alleged rape victim; Britney gets a call in the middle of the night that leads to a horrifying discovery; Daniel despairs in county lockup while Lacey tries to post bail.

programme.title: Blood on the Leaves
programme.desc: An unnerved Lacey goes to the county jail, only to make a shocking discovery; Othello goes the extra mile to get leverage for a client who's getting low-balled on a mega real estate deal.

programme.title: Through the Grapevine
programme.desc: Lacey takes on a new case, but has ulterior motives; Daniel tells Lacey about a possible new witness, but Lacey doubts his credibility.

programme.title: You Reap What You Sow
programme.desc: Othello secures another win for the firm, but when he gets too close to Lacey, things don't go as expected; Lacey announces she's defending Deputy Garcia, but it proves to more than she bargained for.

programme.title: New Wine
programme.desc: Lacey's enemies plot their revenge; Othello considers a compelling offer; Mark gets stunning news about Zoe; With the pressure mounting, Lacey begins to unravel.

programme.desc: With Governor Barclay now at her mercy, things start to turn around for Lacey; Britney meets with Alphonso in jail and offers to represent him; Judge Sears vents at Peter Corbin's lack of results around Lacey.

programme.title: Family Truckster Restoration Part 1
programme.desc: Nick Rutter walks you through step-by-step on how to remove stubborn bug splatter from your vehicle along with tips and techniques for using a waterless wash as well as a clay bar.

programme.title: Better Than Stock
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno are working on a 2006 Dodge Ram with a ton of problems...but why just make the repairs? Go better than stock!

programme.title: Wheels For Hope
programme.desc: Matt visits the Wheels for Hope Garage in Raleigh, NC and sees first hand how this organization is changing lives.

programme.title: Budget Rear End
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno upgrade the Dana 35 rear end in a 2000 Jeep TJ to a much stronger Ford 8.8 one and do it for under $500.

programme.title: Warning Lights
programme.desc: Every light on your dashboard means something. Matt and Bruno diagnose and repair a vehicle that came to the shop to them with warning lights.

programme.title: Road Ranger
programme.desc: Nobody likes to fix a truck on the side of the road. That's why there's roadside assistance. Matt and Bruno take a stock F250 and turn it into a purpose-built Road Ranger.

programme.title: Jeep Build-Off Day 1
programme.desc: With two days and a ton of truck parts anything can happen. Matt and Bruno put together build teams to see who can complete the toughest rig.

programme.title: Jeep Build-Off Day 2
programme.desc: The Jeep Build-Off continues as the guys get a chance to finish their Jeeps and take them on a Geocaching race for all of the marbles.

programme.title: Jeep Build-Off Day 3
programme.desc: The Jeep Build-Off continues as the guys get a chance to finish their Jeeps and take them on a Geocaching race for all of the marbles.

programme.title: Oddballs and Icons
programme.desc: Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free '55 Chevy he knows it's a too good of a deal to pass up.

programme.title: A Tale of Two DeLoreans
programme.desc: When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two dramatically different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time. It's nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

programme.title: Hot Rods and Porsches
programme.desc: Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer. Then, a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

programme.title: Mopar to Midair
programme.desc: Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!

programme.title: Unboxing a Mustang
programme.desc: Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle swap meet where there's rusty gold and an old Jeep waiting for him.

programme.title: Love Hurst
programme.desc: An iconic Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop. Meanwhile, a cold call takes Tony to a Chevelle project that creates more questions than it answers and the owner needs some help figuring out what to do with it.

programme.title: Oddballs and Icons
programme.desc: Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free '55 Chevy he knows it's a too good of a deal to pass up.

programme.title: A Tale of Two DeLoreans
programme.desc: When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two dramatically different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time. It's nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

programme.title: The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears' Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears', through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called "the most beautiful car ever made"; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can sup

programme.title: Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don't tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8's; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man's life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool '50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting's trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW's, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Big Tigger v. Monster Muscle
programme.desc: Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian "Big Tigger" Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. programme.title: Exotic Car Hunter
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don't just show up on a dealer's floor, they're hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Andrew Jones' Super Jeep
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Jekyll and Hide
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country's greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt '59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Hot Rods and Porsches
programme.desc: Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer. Then, a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

programme.title: Mopar to Midair
programme.desc: Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!

programme.title: Unboxing a Mustang
programme.desc: Tony digs out a rare Mustang that's been hidden under dusty boxes for decades, but the owner has another surprise in store. Then Tony gets a chance to size up a Model A truck at an auction preview before he heads to the famous Spring Carlisle swap meet where there's rusty gold and an old Jeep waiting for him.

programme.title: Love Hurst
programme.desc: An iconic Hurst Oldsmobile emerges from years in storage and roars back to life in the shop. Meanwhile, a cold call takes Tony to a Chevelle project that creates more questions than it answers and the owner needs some help figuring out what to do with it.

programme.title: Oddballs and Icons
programme.desc: Tony helps prep a quirky, rare British TVR for sale and makes a play for one of the most elusive Camaros ever built, the legendary ZL1. When Tony is offered a rust-free '55 Chevy he knows it's a too good of a deal to pass up.

programme.title: A Tale of Two DeLoreans
programme.desc: When a client puts out the call for a DeLorean, Tony finds two dramatically different contenders: one showroom-clean, the other frozen in time. It's nostalgia versus perfection as Tony helps figure out what's the best route for his client to take.

programme.title: Hot Rods and Porsches
programme.desc: Tony helps an owner move a custom Mercury to none other than Joe Zolper as a potential buyer. Then, a lead sends Tony to a dusty garage hiding a nearly untouched Porsche RS America with just 5,000 original miles.

programme.title: Mopar to Midair
programme.desc: Tony teams up with the Auto Archeologist, Ryan Brutt, to uncover one of the rarest Dodge Demons in existence. Then Tony follows the trail to make an offer on a movie-star, an Eleanor Mustang. With this deal, the sky's the limit!

programme.title: Big Yellow Taxi
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a '35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on 'borrowed' taxi ride.

programme.title: Peach State Challengers
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a "car club" and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are "family" and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Lambo Racer
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he's touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Boston's (Un)Common Collection
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston's collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: C&O at the Beach
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country's coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it's a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag'N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Kenny Roger's Family Values

programme.title: SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we'll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn't always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Motor Masters
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder's take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: HOT ROD HOLY GRAIL
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: CORVETTE SINK HOLE

AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: ROAR AT THE SHORE
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: CARS AND MUSIC STARS
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. From Indy to Nashville, Ray finds he has a lot in common with the Borchetta brothers. This celebrity-filled episode features musicians Tim McGraw, Cassadee Pope and IndyCar driver Josef Newgarden.

programme.title: DRAGSTER DIPLOMACY
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: SMOKIN JOE

programme.title: BOARD TRACK BATTLES

Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Scerif

programme.title: Magnus Walker's Secret Porsche Collection

No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Central Main and Dessert
programme.desc: For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four-course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.title: North West Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multipart venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north-west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Scotland Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Scotland Main and Dessert
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Scotland Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates. Food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

programme.desc: Emily Scott is the chef proprietor of Cornwall's renowned 'St Tudy Inn'. Her two rivals are from across the sea on Jersey. Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, 'No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred 'Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

programme.title: South West Mains and Dessert
programme.desc: Emily's David Bowie-inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes, and she uses Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Meanwhile, Joe has also sourced his ingredients locally.

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. They are joined by one half of the synthpop duo The Communards, Reverend Richard Coles.

programme.title: Wales Starter and Fish Courses
programme.desc: Tom "Westy" Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant "The Classroom" in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheridan formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

programme.title: Wales Main and Dessert

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four-course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter and Fish
programme.desc: The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post-gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main and Dessert
programme.desc: Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist Donna Taggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland recreate their four-course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There is also a guest judge: rapper Loyle Carner.

programme.title: The Finals: Starter
programme.desc: The chefs battle to get their starter course to the Abbey Road banquet and don't disappoint with dishes dedicated to everything from Tom Jones to grime. The rivals are cooking to impress Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton, and Andi Oliver.

programme.desc: Some of the finest chefs in the UK compete to cook a fish course worthy of serving at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road Studios. Along with the show's panel of expert judges, the rivals need to impress guest judge Kanya King.

programme.title: The Finals: Main Course

As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worthy of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

programme.title: The Finals: Dessert
programme.desc: Some of the country's finest chefs compete over the final place cooking at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road studios. Each rival will need to cook a dessert to impress a panel of expert judges, along with guest judge Peter Hook, Joy Division and New Order bassist, and pioneer of Britain's Madchester scene.

programme.title: The Finals: Banquet
programme.desc: The chefs must cook in an unfamiliar kitchen and scale up their dishes to provide the highest calibre of dining for a full banquet room of diners. Their guests are celebrities and unsung heroes who have helped create British music's unparalleled global reputation.

programme.title: Scotland Starter
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's top chefs, Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee, and Graham Campbell - attempt to impress this week's veteran judge. Having missed out last year, returning finalist Jak is determined to make it to the banquet.

programme.desc: Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell are battling to plate up a perfect main course for this week's veteran chef. Self-taught Jimmy is honouring his mum with his rendition of her Chinese beef stew.

programme.title: Scotland Dessert
programme.desc: Today it's the Scottish chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course. Only two can cook for the judges tomorrow, and with one chef in the lead after a triumphant main, the pressures on for the other two to plate up perfection.

programme.desc: Three of the south-west's finest chefs, Jude Kereama, Josh Eggleton and Dominic Chapman attempt to impress a veteran judge with their starters. As the only newcomer, Jude is determined to plate up a winning dish, but he faces stiff competition.

programme.title: South West Main

programme.title: South West Dessert
programme.desc: The south-west chefs have one last chance to impress as they face the dessert course. Only two chefs can go through to cook for the judges with everything to play for, who will plate up perfection and who will be sent packing?

programme.desc: Stephen Gomes, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael are challenged to plate up perfect starter courses for this week's veteran judge. It's the first time in the Great British Menu kitchen for all three chefs, so who will triumph and who will fall?

programme.desc: It's a battle for the main course with the Welsh chefs going head-to-head. With all three chefs paying homage to Welsh lamb; Adam with a refined dish, Phil with a dish dedicated to his Mum and Stephen with a lamb dish celebrating the WI.

programme.title: Wales Dessert

programme.title: Wales Judging

programme.title: North West Dessert

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: A Great Divide
programme.desc: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

programme.title: Brother Orange
programme.desc: In 2014, BuzzFeed writer Matt Stopera's phone was stolen from a bar in New York City. A year later, photos of storefronts and a man next to an orange tree mysteriously appeared in his iPhoto stream. Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World's Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 7, Canada (Part 2)
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer's Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow 'Leader Shirt'?

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven't given up yet.

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 11, Romania
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines
